Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT workflows using IICS and/or Informatica PowerCenter.
Develop data integration solutions for cloud and on-premises applications.
Build and optimize mappings, mapplets, tasks, task flows, and workflows.
Extract, transform, and load data from multiple source systems into target data warehouses.
Collaborate with business analysts, data architects, and stakeholders to understand business requirements.
Perform unit testing, system testing, and deployment of ETL solutions.
Monitor production jobs and troubleshoot performance and data quality issues.
Implement data validation, reconciliation, and error-handling mechanisms.
Create and maintain technical design documents and operational procedures.
Follow data governance, security, and best development practices.

As a Senior within the Actuarial managed services team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.

iduals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years of experience in valuation / reporting / pricing or modelling function in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
Good analytical skills
Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

Overseas exposure (especially Australia/UK/US/Europe market experience)

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. As a SAP - MM - Senior Associate, you will focus on implementing, configuring, and maintaining the SAP Procurement module to streamline and automate procurement processes, including purchasing, supplier management, contract management, and inventory management. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for planning and executing SAP Implementation, Development, and Support activities related to SAP Materials Management. You will handle all Purchasing and Inventory Management tasks, providing solutions and functional specifications to meet client requirements. Your role will involve creating presentation decks, process flows, and configuration documents, confirming alignment with client standards and requirements.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and configuration of SAP Procurement modules to streamline purchasing and supplier management processes
- Planning and executing SAP Materials Management activities, including purchasing and inventory management
- Configuring SAP MM and delivering work products that align with client standards and requirements
- Conducting AS-IS studies, gap analysis, and blueprinting for SAP MM projects
- Integrating SAP MM with Extended Warehouse Management and other SAP modules
- Creating presentation decks and process flows for client workshops using Microsoft Visio
- Developing Process Definition Documents and Business Process Procedures for proposed solutions
- Managing procure-to-pay functional workstreams for SAP S/4HANA Brownfield projects
- Addressing module-specific functional conversion items such as vendor master harmonization and invoice consistency
- Applying SAP MM and Ariba integration expertise to support business continuity during migrations
- Driving fit-gap sessions and functional delta analysis using S/4HANA tools
- Utilizing AI and automation tools to optimize processes and enhance user experience
- Preparing test scripts and conducting testing post-MM upgrades
- Regularly interacting with onsite teams and clients to provide status updates and maintain relationships

Description:
The Role
We are looking for a marketing intelligence leader who combines marketing and pipeline expertise with data science and AI to proactively monitor and optimize performance. This role will lead the development of predictive models that identify emerging risks and opportunities, diagnose performance drivers, and translate insights into actions that improve campaign, pipeline, and business outcomes.
 Location- Bangalore/Noida
Role- Individual Contributor
Shift- 2.00pm-11.00pm IST

Key Responsibilities
Marketing & Pipeline Performance Intelligence
Analyze performance across campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, and ROI.
Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities across campaigns, channels, audiences, segments, and pipeline.
Diagnose what is driving performance and where intervention is needed.
Translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
Data Science & Proactive Monitoring
Lead the design and deployment of predictive, forecasting, pacing, and anomaly-detection models to proactively monitor marketing and pipeline performance.
Build scalable early-warning capabilities that detect meaningful changes and emerging performance risks and opportunities.
Use advanced analytics to understand what changed, why it changed, and what is likely to happen next.
Campaign Optimization & Partnership
Partner closely with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Campaign Strategy, and Digital Experience to translate insights into action.
Recommend opportunities to optimize campaign strategy, audiences, channels, investment, execution, and activation.
Measure the impact of optimization actions and incorporate learnings into future analyses and models.
AI & Analytics Automation
Apply AI and automation to accelerate monitoring, forecasting, diagnostics, and insight generation.
Automate recurring analytical processes and build scalable performance intelligence solutions.
Partner with Marketing Operations and technology teams to operationalize models and analytics.
Executive Insights
Translate complex analytics into clear, decision-ready business insights and recommendations.
Communicate what is happening, why it matters, and what action should be taken.
Provide leadership with a proactive view of the marketing and pipeline risks and opportunities that require attention.
Qualifications
8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, performance intelligence, or advanced analytics.
Hands-on data science experience designing, building, validating, and deploying predictive and proactive monitoring models, including forecasting and anomaly detection.
Deep understanding of B2B marketing and pipeline performance, including campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, attribution, and ROI.
Proven ability to diagnose performance drivers and translate model outputs and analytical insights into actionable marketing recommendations.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using AI, automation, and modern analytics platforms.
Strong business acumen, problem-solving, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership skills.
Success in This Role
Marketing identifies performance risks and opportunities earlier.
Teams understand where performance is changing, why, and what action to take.
Predictive monitoring reduces reliance on retrospective reporting.
Marketing gains greater visibility into campaign effectiveness and pipeline creation, progression, and conversion.
AI and automation enable faster, more scalable performance intelligence.
Leadership receives clear recommendations connecting marketing activity to pipeline and business outcomes.

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Job Title: - Associate Manager/Project Leader Model Building
Requisition ID:
Job Location: -Gurgaon/Bangalore/Pune/Hyderabad
Job Summary: -
Data Scientist with good hands-on experience of 3+ years in developing state of the art and scalable Machine Learning models and their operationalization, leveraging off-the-shelf workbench production.
Job Responsibilities: -
1. Hands on experience in Python data-science and math packages such as NumPy, Pandas, Sklearn, Seaborn, PyCaret, Matplotlib
2. Proficiency in Python and common Machine Learning frameworks (TensorFlow, NLTK, Stanford NLP, PyTorch, Ling Pipe, Caffe, Keras, SparkML and OpenAI etc.)
3. Experience of working in large teams and using collaboration tools like GIT, Jira and Confluence
4. Good understanding of any of the cloud platform – AWS, Azure or GCP
5. Understanding of Commercial Pharma landscape and Patient Data / Analytics would be a huge plus
6. Should have an attitude of willingness to learn, accepting the challenging environment and confidence in delivering the results within timelines. Should be inclined towards self motivation and self-driven to find solutions for problems.
7. Should be able to mentor and guide mid to large sized teams under him/her
Job Requirements: -
1. Strong experience on Spark with Scala/Python/Java
2. Strong proficiency in building/training/evaluating state of the art machine learning models and its deployment
3. Proficiency in Statistical and Probabilistic methods such as SVM, Decision-Trees, Bagging and Boosting Techniques, Clustering
4. Proficiency in Core NLP techniques like Text Classification, Named Entity Recognition (NER), Topic Modeling, Sentiment Analysis, etc. Understanding of Generative AI / Large Language Models / Transformers would be a plus
Qualification: -
- B-Tech or BE in Computer Science / Computer Applications from Tier 1-2 college with 3+ years of proven experience in the field of Advanced Analytics or Machine Learning
OR
- Master’s degree in Machine Learning / Statistics / Econometrics, or related discipline from Tier 1-2 college with 3+ years of experience
Must have Skills: -
Real-world experience in implementing machine learning/statistical/econometric models/advanced algorithms
Breadth of machine learning domain knowledge
Experience in application of machine learning algorithms (classification, regression, deep learning, NLP, etc.)
Experience with a ML/data-centric programming language (such as Python, Scala, or R) and ML libraries (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, etc.)
Experience with Apache Hadoop / Spark (or equivalent cloud-computing/map-reduce framework)
Skills that give you an edge: -
Strong analytical skills to solve and model complex business requirements are a plus. With life sciences or pharma background.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst

Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).

automated template deployment.

cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE /
NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP
neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error
monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming
parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.

Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

Description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
The role involves converting 3D CAD models and engineering data into high-quality 2D illustrations, exploded views, assembly illustrations, installation/removal procedures, and procedural graphics.

The illustrations must comply with applicable technical documentation standards and support the development of Interactive Electronic Technical Publications (IETP), Repair Parts and Illustrations List (RPIL), Illustrated Parts Data (IPD), and Component Maintenance Publications (CMP).

Qualifications and Experience
B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation Engineering, or an equivalent discipline.
3-5 years of relevant experience in technical illustration and engineering documentation.
Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, CATIA, or equivalent tools.
Strong understanding of technical drawing and documentation standards, including ATA iSpec 2200 and S1000D.
Proven experience in creating technical illustrations compliant with S1000D standards.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent technical illustration tools.
Experience in Illustration Content Number (ICN) management and associated technical publication workflows.
Experience with RPIL, Repair Parts Support (RPS) development, and IPD illustrations is highly advantageous.
Familiarity with IETP standards and Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) deliverables is highly desirable.
Experience working with engineering databases and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools such as Teamcenter, SAP, Agile PLM, Windchill, or 3D Via.
Proficiency in workflow and work-tracking tools such as JIRA.

Key Responsibilities
Create accurate 2D technical illustrations from 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, and technical references.
Develop detailed illustrations, including exploded views, assembly views, section views, detail views, and installation/removal procedures.
Produce procedural graphics and illustrations for technical manuals, maintenance manuals, service manuals, assembly instructions, and parts documentation.
Develop illustrations for IETP, RPIL, IPD, and CMP deliverables.
Use Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, IsoDraw, or equivalent software to create high-quality, vector-based technical illustrations.
Interpret CATIA 3D models to understand product structures, components, assemblies, and engineering designs.
Ensure accuracy in geometry, orientation, proportions, and component relationships.
Apply appropriate line weights, colour shading, hatching, callouts, symbols, arrows, and graphical conventions in accordance with applicable standards.
Analyse complex engineering data, including drawings, specifications, CAD models, bills of materials (BOMs), schematics, wiring diagrams, and Service Bulletins, to develop technically accurate illustrations.
Collaborate with engineers, technical authors, designers, subject-matter experts, and the wider Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) team to clarify technical information and validate content.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a skilled Senior Regulatory Reporting Professional to support the delivery of technology-enabled regulatory reporting services for digital asset clients. The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
Your Key Responsibilities
Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.
Broader Banking Regulatory Reporting Exposure: Apply relevant exposure to banking regulatory returns, including capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, ICAAP reporting, balance sheet reporting, and regulatory disclosures, where applicable to the clients operating model.
Regulatory Change, Awareness & Reporting Logic: Monitor relevant regulatory developments, interpret reporting instructions, assess data and process impacts, and coordinate timely updates to reporting logic, templates, procedures, controls, and technology workflows.
Data Sourcing & Analytical Reviews: Perform complex data extraction, validation, variance analysis, and root-cause exception investigations across large datasets to ensure data completeness and integrity.
Control Governance & Audit Readiness: Embed rigorous quality controlsincluding maker-checker reviews, clear audit trails, evidence retention, and sign-off protocols—across all reporting cycles.
Automation & Process Improvement: Identify reporting process inefficiencies and support automation initiatives using tools such as SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
Analytics & Responsible AI Awareness: Apply awareness of responsible AI and analytics use cases to support anomaly detection, exception analysis, reporting commentary, and workflow monitoring.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment: Provide technical coaching and review support to junior team members while coordinating seamlessly across cross-functional partners and U.S.-based stakeholders.
Time-Zone Flexibility: Willingness to operate during late/extended hours to ensure seamless hand-offs with U.S.-based stakeholders and meet strict global submission deadlines.
Al fluency - Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Ideally, you’ll also have
4–6 years of relevant experience, including 2–6 years in a senior role within regulatory reporting or financial services.
Hands-on experience with U.S. regulatory filings, financial condition reporting, customer liability reporting, permissible investments, transaction reporting, and Money Transmitter License (MTL) submissions.
Hands-on experience in FFIEC 031 , FRY 9C , FRY 15 , FFIEC 041/051 , FR 2062a , Basel & Liquidity reporting , COREP/FINREP , Money Transmission reporting .
Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field is preferred; CA, CPA, CFA, MBA, or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
Strong end-to-end understanding of regulatory reporting production cycles, data validation, reconciliations, variance analysis, workpaper preparation, and review controls.
Solid working knowledge of financial statement analysis, regulatory capital concepts, ICAAP reporting, and applicable regulatory compliance frameworks.
Exposure to banking regulatory reporting frameworks, including capital adequacy, ICAAP reporting, liquidity risk reporting, balance sheet schedules, and regulatory disclosures, would be beneficial.
Proven ability to translate complex regulatory mandates into business requirements.
Knowledge of reporting platforms and data tools, along with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Snowflake, or Looker, would be an added advantage.
Awareness of Generative AI tools and workflow automation to support data extraction, exception analysis, and reporting efficiency would be an advantage.
Strong control mindset, including practical experience with maker-checker reviews, robust audit trails, evidence retention, issue management, and key risk/control testing.
Advanced data analytics skills, with the ability to query large datasets, perform root-cause analysis on exceptions, and communicate structured findings clearly.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effectively managing relationships across onshore/offshore teams, product managers, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating strong ownership, continuous improvement, and agility in adapting to evolving regulatory landscapes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required. U.S. visa readiness or international travel willingness is preferred but not mandatory.

Hunger and passion for learning new skills

Job Description: SAP BTP Security Administrator
Position Overview:
We are looking for an experienced SAP BTP Security Administrator with 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in SAP BTP administration and security management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing administration, custom authentication, authorization, connectivity, and overall BTP administration while ensuring seamless integration with customer IDPs and SAP ID Service.
Key Responsibilities:
1. SAP BTP Security [Mandatory]
Manage authentication and authorization for SAP ID Service and custom IDPs.
Administer SAP BTP Identity Access Governance (IAG) for role and policy management.
Configure trust and federation between UAA and SAP Identity Authentication Service (IAS).
Hands-on experience & knowledge with Corporate Identity Provider (IDP) integration, authentication, user provisioning, and Single Sign-On (SSO) configurations.
Establish trust manually between UAA and any SAML-based IDP.
Configure custom identity provider login for Cloud Foundry environments.
Manage user provisioning from SAP ID Service for multi-environment subaccounts.
Shadow user management.
Hands-on experience in provisioning SAP S/4HANA roles to SAP BTP, ensuring secure user access, authorization mapping, and role synchronization.
Knowledge of integrating SAP BTP applications with IAS through application mapping, trust configuration, corporate IDP integration, and SAML/OIDC-based authentication.
2. SAP BTP Administration [Mandatory]
Perform BTP Basic Setup and manage global account/subaccounts.
Handle BTP service provisioning and administration.
Configure and manage BTP connectivity (Destinations, SAP Cloud Connector, and Authentication Mechanisms).
Perform BTP transport management and oversee application administration.
3. BTP Cloud Connector Administration [Good to have]
Manage SAP Cloud Connector configurations for secure on-premises connectivity.
Manager SCC certificates
5. Ticket Handling & Shift Support
Handle incident and service request tickets related to SAP BTP security and administration.
Should be ready to work in 24/7 shift support and on need basis.
Required Qualifications & Skills:
Education & Experience
Graduate in Information Technology / Computer Science or a related field.
5 to 7 years of relevant experience as an SAP BTP Administrator with a strong focus on security.
Technical Skills:
SAP BTP Security (Authentication, Authorization, Trust & Federation).
SAP Identity Authentication Service (IAS) & Identity Provisioning Service (IPS).
SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect for authentication.
SAP BTP IAG (Identity Access Governance) administration.
SAP Cloud Connector setup and management.
Cloud Foundry CLI (CF CLI) for identity and access management.
Soft Skills:
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a 24/7 environment.
Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
Additional Information:
Location: Karadi, Pune / Remote.
Shift Timing: 24/7 Shift Support (also ready to stretch on need basis)
Employment Type: Full-time

About Fractal
What makes Fractal a GREAT fit for you? When you join Fractal, you ll be part of a fast-growing team that helps our clients leverage AI together with the power of behavioural sciences to make better decisions. We re a strategic analytics partner to most admired fortune 500 companies globally, we help them power every human decision in the enterprise by bringing analytics, AI and behavioural science to the decision.
Our people enjoy a collaborative work environment, exceptional training and career development as well as unlimited growth opportunities. We have a Glassdoor rating of 4 / 5 and achieve customer NPS of 9/ 10. If you like working with a curious, supportive, high-performing team, Fractal is the place for you.
How You Will Make an Impact/ Job Responsibilities:
Experience: 6 to 8 years
Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines using AWS/Azure/GCP DevOps tools and services.
Configure and maintain build agents, release pipelines, and automation scripts for deployment processes.
Utilize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles to automate the provisioning and management of Azure resources using tools like ARM templates or Terraform

Description:
Role & responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced and driven Manager - Talent Acquisition (Leadership Hiring) to lead end-to-end recruitment for senior and leadership-level positions across the organization. This is currently an Individual Contributor (IC) role, requiring strong stakeholder management, executive search capabilities, market intelligence, and a consultative hiring approach. Based on business needs and performance, the role may evolve into a people management position with team leadership responsibilities in the future.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership Hiring
Manage end-to-end recruitment for leadership and critical positions across business functions.
Partner with senior business leaders to understand talent requirements, organizational priorities, and succession needs.
Develop and execute targeted search strategies to identify and engage high-caliber leadership talent.
Build and maintain strong leadership talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and talent intelligence research.
Stakeholder Management
Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders.
Drive hiring discussions, calibration meetings, and offer negotiations for senior-level hires.
Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Influence hiring decisions through data-driven insights and market trends.
Talent Acquisition Excellence
Design and implement innovative sourcing strategies, including executive search methodologies.
Track and report key recruitment metrics and leadership hiring effectiveness.
Ensure compliance with internal hiring policies and recruitment governance.
Collaborate with HR Business Partners and business leaders on workforce planning initiatives.
Employer Branding & Market Intelligence
Strengthen the organization's leadership hiring brand through networking and industry engagement.
Stay updated on industry trends, talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and competitor movements.
Build strong external networks with industry leaders, executive search firms, and professional associations.
Future Team Leadership Opportunities
Mentor and guide recruiters as needed on leadership hiring best practices.
Support capability building within the Talent Acquisition function.
Potentially lead and manage a team of recruiters based on business growth and organizational requirements.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
8+ years of Talent Acquisition experience with significant exposure to leadership and niche hiring.
Proven experience in hiring for Director, VP, AVP, General Manager, and other leadership positions.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and leadership teams.
Strong expertise in executive search, talent mapping, and passive candidate engagement.
Preferred Skills
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Strong negotiation and offer management capabilities.
Data-driven decision-making and analytical mindset.
Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
High level of ownership, accountability, and business acumen.
Experience in technology, product, digital, consulting, or corporate leadership hiring is preferred.
Key Competencies

Executive Presence
Strategic Thinking
Stakeholder Management
Consultative Hiring
Talent Market Intelligence
Decision Making
Communication & Influencing
Relationship Management
Problem Solving
Results Orientation
Success Measures
Leadership hiring closure rate and quality of hire.
Time-to-fill and stakeholder satisfaction.
Leadership talent pipeline strength.
Candidate experience and offer-to-join ratio.
Contribution to strategic workforce planning and talent acquisition initiatives.

Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, and root cause analysis.
Proficiency in CAD software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar) is preferred.
Experience with ERP/MRP systems is an advantage.
Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

F&B and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our F&B Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish.

Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards.
Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Position Overview
We are looking for an energetic and result-oriented Sales Representative to develop sales and distribution in the assigned territory.
The candidate will be responsible for appointing and developing Stockists/Distributors, generating Primary & Secondary Sales, increasing retail coverage, opening new outlets, and achieving monthly sales targets.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop potential Stockists / Distributors in the assigned territory.
Assist in appointment and activation of new Stockists/Distributors.
Generate Primary Sales from Stockists/Distributors as per assigned targets.
Drive Secondary Sales through regular retailer and market visits.
Visit retailers, wholesalers and dealers according to the assigned beat plan.
Generate regular orders from existing and new retail outlets.
Open new retail outlets and increase numerical distribution in the territory.
Ensure availability and visibility of company products at retail outlets.
Develop new markets, towns and sales opportunities within the assigned area.
Build strong relationships with Stockists, Distributors, Wholesalers and Retailers.
Ensure adequate stock availability with Stockists/Distributors.
Implement company schemes, promotions and new product launches in the market.
Monitor competitor products, pricing, schemes and market activities.
Follow up with distributors for orders, supplies and payments where required.
Maintain daily market visit, order booking and sales reports.
Achieve monthly Primary Sales, Secondary Sales, Outlet Coverage and New Outlet Opening targets.
Candidate Profile
* Experience: fresh or 1-2 years in Field Sales / General Trade / Distribution Sales.
* Experience in FMCG / Food / Consumer Products / General Trade preferred.
* Good understanding of Primary and Secondary Sales.
* Experience in retailer/dealer development and stockist handling preferred.
* Good knowledge of the local market and surrounding areas.
* Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Target-oriented and willing to travel extensively in the assigned territory.
* Candidate should be comfortable with daily field visits.
* Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will primarily be measured on:
* Primary Sales Achievement
* Secondary Sales Achievement
* New Stockist / Distributor Development
* New Outlet Opening
* Productive Calls / Daily Market Coverage
* Retailer Order Generation
* Product Availability & Visibility
* Achievement of Monthly Sales Targets

Description:
Group Company: JSW Steel Limited
Designation: Shift Incharge
Job Brief: JSW Steel Limited is seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to oversee and manage the operations of the Blast Furnace department during assigned shifts. The role demands a strong leadership presence to ensure the efficient, safe, and continuous functioning of blast furnace processes, aligning with the companys commitment to operational excellence and safety standards. The ideal candidate will coordinate with cross-functional teams, monitor production parameters, troubleshoot operational issues, and implement process improvements to optimize output and maintain product quality in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
Responsibilities:
Lead and supervise all activities within the blast furnace department during the assigned shift, ensuring adherence to production schedules and quality standards.
Monitor and control blast furnace operations, including temperature, pressure, and raw material feed rates, to maintain optimal process conditions.
Ensure strict compliance with safety protocols and environmental regulations to maintain a safe working environment for all personnel.
Coordinate with maintenance teams to schedule and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance activities to minimize downtime.
Analyze operational data and generate shift reports highlighting performance metrics, deviations, and improvement opportunities.
Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process efficiency, reduce costs, and improve product quality.
Train, mentor, and evaluate shift personnel to build a competent and motivated team capable of meeting production targets.
Respond promptly to operational emergencies and troubleshoot technical issues to restore normal operations swiftly.
Collaborate with quality control and engineering departments to resolve production challenges and implement best practices.
Ensure proper documentation and record-keeping of all shift activities, incidents, and maintenance work.
Skills:
Blast Furnace Operation Management
Process Optimization
Safety and Environmental Compliance
Team Leadership and Development
Preventive and Corrective Maintenance Coordination
Operational Data Analysis
Emergency Response and Troubleshooting
Production Planning and Scheduling
Quality Control Collaboration
Technical Documentation and Reporting
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field from a recognized institution.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in blast furnace operations or heavy manufacturing environments, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or shift leadership role.
Required work experience

Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Accountant to manage daily accounting operations, GST compliance, ledger reconciliation, financial reporting, and documentation. Candidates with experience in steel, manufacturing, or trading industries will be preferred.
Key Responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day accounting entries, journal vouchers, and general ledger maintenance.
Handle accounts payable, accounts receivable, and vendor/customer reconciliations.
Prepare bank reconciliation statements (BRS) and monitor outstanding balances.
Assist in GST returns, TDS compliance, and input tax credit reconciliation.
Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and payment documents.
Maintain inventory and stock reconciliation records related to steel purchases and sales.
Monitor freight, transportation, and other operational expenses.
Prepare monthly MIS reports, expense statements, and account summaries.
Support internal audits, statutory audits, and month-end closing activities.
Work on accounting software/ERP such as SAP, Tally, and MS Excel.
Candidate Requirements
Graduate in Commerce (B.Com); M.Com or MBA Finance preferred.
25 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance.
Good knowledge of GST, TDS, accounting principles, and reconciliations.
Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software/ERP.
Experience in steel, manufacturing, or trading companies will be an advantage.
Strong analytical skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.

AboutCompany:
We Are JK Lakshmi Steel

From the foundation to the frame.

For over 40 years, JK Lakshmi has held India's buildings together from the ground up. Our cement is in homes, schools, hospitals, bridges and roads across the country, trusted by the families who live in them and the engineers who design them.

Now we're adding the part that holds them up.

Steel is what keeps a structure standing. It carries the weight of every floor, every wall and every life inside. That's too important to leave to chance, so we're bringing the same discipline that built the JK Lakshmi name in cement to everything we make in steel: TMT bars, wires, structural channels and pipes.

We're not new to building India. We're simply taking the next step. What we did for cement, we're now doing for steel: raising the standard, checking every stage, and making sure the name on the product means something.

We're in your cement. Now we're in your steel.

The Clinic Centre Head is accountable for the overall performance of the clinic – owning revenue, customer experience, and operational excellence. Track daily/weekly MIS and ensure KPIs are met.

Conduct regular reviews and performance appraisals.
Build a culture of accountability, service, and sales focus.

4) Customer Experience
Ensure every client receives a consistent, high-quality experience.
Resolve escalations and ensure high NPS & client retention.
Implement loyalty and referral programs.

5) Compliance & Reporting
Adhere to company SOPs and statutory requirements.
Ensure proper documentation for audits and reviews.
Provide regular performance updates to regional leadership.

Build local tie-ups (RWAs, corporates, gyms, wellness camps) for footfall generation.
Partner with marketing & BTL teams for city-specific activations.

6–10 years of experience in healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or retail services.

Description:
Role & responsibilities :
Conduct comprehensive physiotherapy assessments and develop individualized treatment and rehabilitation plans.
Provide physiotherapy interventions for orthopaedic, neurological, cardiopulmonary, sports, geriatric, paediatric, and post-operative conditions, as applicable.
Deliver bedside physiotherapy, early mobilization, respiratory care, mobility training, and functional rehabilitation for admitted patients.
Monitor patient progress and modify treatment plans based on clinical requirements.
Manage inpatient and outpatient referrals, follow-ups, and continuity of rehabilitation care.
Educate patients and caregivers on exercises, posture, mobility, home rehabilitation, and preventive care.
Maintain accurate clinical records and comply with hospital protocols, infection control, and patient safety standards.
Coordinate with consultants, nursing staff, and other healthcare professionals for integrated patient care.
Participate in clinical audits, quality improvement initiatives, NABH-related activities, and departmental development.
Contribute to health camps, awareness programs, research activities, and continuous professional development.
AboutCompany:
Jindal Power Limited (JPL) is a leading Indian power company with a diverse energy portfolio encompassing thermal and renewable sources. With an impressive installed capacity of 4300 MW, JPL has been instrumental in meeting the nation's growing power demands. Pioneering the establishment of an Independent Power Plant (IPP) in 2007 with its 4x250 MW thermal power unit in Chhattisgarh's Raigarh district, JPL has continued its expansion in Tamnar with a 2400 MW (4X600 MW) thermal power plant.
JPL energy portfolio includes 3400 MW at Tamnar, Chhattisgarh and 600 MW at Simhapuri Andhra Pradesh & 300 MW at Shirpur, Maharashtra. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best practices, JPL has set new standards in India's power sector.
The company's vision is to emerge as a significant player in the industry, contributing to the nation's development. Committed to renewable energy sources, JPL aims to substantially increase the share of power generated through sustainable means. As the 5th largest integrated power producer in India, based on million units of generation, and with three captive mines, JPL stands as a key player in the sector. The company envisions establishing benchmarks in renewable energy, carbon emissions, and environmental protection. Furthermore, JPL is a trailblazer in community development and welfare initiatives.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
- Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management.
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page (RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high.
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc., to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants.
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation and Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner.
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc., amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies.
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV).
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS, PowerBi, Compass, Salesmate.
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise / Month Wise / Day Wise.
Transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition.


Qualifications

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.

About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.

7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
As a Senior Senior Full-Stack Engineer , you will work as a full-stack engineer with a primary focus on building modern, responsive frontends using React and robust backend services using .NET Core. You will architect end-to-end solutions, write clean and maintainable code, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality features. This role also involves providing technical leadership, reviewing code, mentoring junior developers, and contributing to architectural decisions that shape the future of our digital platforms.
Responsibilities
Develop, maintain, and optimize full-stack applications using React (frontend) and .NET Core (backend).
Build and enhance scalable APIs, microservices, and cloud-based components using Azure services.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-impact features.
Ensure code quality through code reviews, best practices, and adherence to clean architecture principles.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to performance, scalability, and security.
Stay updated with modern frameworks, tools, and industry standards to help evolve the tech stack.
Contribute to architectural planning, technical design, and long-term engineering strategy.
Mentor junior developers and support a culture of continuous learning within the team.
Requirements
Strong hands-on experience with .NET Core and backend development.
Advanced proficiency in React and modern frontend development workflows.
Solid experience building SPAs, RESTful APIs, and cloud-native applications.
Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern frontend tooling.
Experience working with Azure services and cloud-based architectures.
Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development practices.
Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Nice to Have
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized deployments.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, or automation tools.
Prior experience in a senior or technical lead position.
Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies or similar development processes.
Familiarity with other modern frontend frameworks (Angular, Vue).
