Description:
The Associate Manager CSR and Health Programs will lead CSR partnership development, program design, and implementation support in the health sector across Assam and the Northeast
The role focuses on translating emerging public health needs and policies into investment-ready proposals and program models, while fostering robust multi-stakeholder collaborations

Responsibilities
CSR Partnership Facilitation
Identify and engage with CSR partners whose mandates align with public health and healthcare delivery

Develop tailored, investment-ready proposals that address emerging needs in healthcare infrastructure, access, awareness, and workforce development

Maintain a structured pipeline of leads, proposals, and donor progress tracking dashboards
Health Sector Needs Assessment & Intelligence
Conduct field assessments, data analysis, and consultations to identify investment gaps and thematic priorities (e
g
, maternal and child health, mental health, NCDs, digital health)

Draft thematic briefs, sector snapshots, and concept notes to support donor engagement

Track public health trends, government programs (NHM, Ayushman Bharat), and regional data to inform CSR program planning

Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Management
Build and manage relationships with CSR leaders, foundations, public health departments, NGOs, and healthcare institutions

Convene strategic roundtables, dialogues, and workshops with key stakeholders

Collaborate with domain experts to ensure technical alignment in project design and execution

CSR Enablement & Approvals
Lead end-to-end processes including donor due diligence, proposal reviews, budgeting, and MoU formalization

Set up streamlined onboarding and activation protocols for new CSR-supported programs

Support corporates in aligning their CSR mandates with public health goals and government priorities

Monitoring, Reporting & Knowledge Management
Develop and update performance dashboards and donor reports

Document learnings, case studies, and programmatic outcomes for knowledge sharing and impact visibility

Maintain internal repositories and support external communication and governance efforts

Mandatory Qualification And Experience
Technical Skills
Strong understanding of CSR regulations under the Companies Act, 2013

Knowledge of public health systems, flagship schemes (NHM, Ayushman Bharat), and CSR-donor frameworks

Experience in proposal development, budgeting, and CSR-funded program structuring

Ability to analyze healthcare data and design scalable health interventions

Exposure to government-facing or donor-supported programs is preferred

Behavioral Competencies
High ownership and solution-oriented execution

Strong communication and stakeholder negotiation skills

Ability to manage multi-stakeholder platforms with strategic agility

Learning agility, adaptability, and professionalism

Executive presence and cross-functional collaboration ability

Eligibility Criteria
Masters degree in Public Health, Health Policy, Public Administration, Development Studies, or related fields

37 years of relevant experience in CSR partnerships, public health programs, or healthcare-focused donor engagement

Proven experience in proposal writing, program coordination, and multi-stakeholder collaboration

Prior work experience in Assam or Northeast India will be an added advantage

Strong command over English; knowledge of Assamese or other regional languages is beneficial

Performance Metrics
Number and quality of CSR-health partnerships facilitated

Volume of CSR investments mobilized for health programs

Quality and timeliness of proposals, reporting, and documentation

Effectiveness of engagement forums (workshops, dialogues, roundtables)

Alignment of programmatic interventions with regional public health priorities and impact outcomes

How to apply
Email your CV and a brief cover letter to hiring@csrbox
org

We have been helping over 55 companies to implement CSR projects through our flagship initiatives in education, employability and entrepreneurship. Description:
Position: Area Sales Manager (Depot In-charge)
Function: Retail
Location: Guwahati (Lower Assam)
Department: Sales

Role Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Area Sales Manager (ASM) to lead and manage the sales operations of a dedicated Depot within a specified territory. The ASM will be responsible for driving the sales volume, value, and growth targets by leading and motivating a team of frontline sales personnel. You will be instrumental in expanding the retail distribution network, tracking competitive activities, and monitoring local market trends to identify opportunities for growth and improvement. The ASM will also have full accountability for the performance of the Depot and will oversee its day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales Performance & Target Achievement:
Lead and manage the sales operations of a single Depot, ensuring the achievement of monthly and annual sales targets (volume and value).
Develop and implement effective sales strategies and action plans to drive growth in the territory.
Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions as necessary to meet business goals.
Foster a high-performance culture within the sales team, setting clear objectives and expectations.
Team Management & Development:
Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of frontline sales personnel, ensuring optimal performance and development of team members.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching and training to improve sales effectiveness.
Build a strong, cohesive team with a focus on collaboration and achieving sales targets.
Market Analysis & Competitor Tracking:
Continuously monitor the local market landscape and competitor activities to identify trends and business opportunities.
Provide insights to senior management regarding market changes and competitive strategies.
Analyze sales data and market trends to adjust sales strategies accordingly.
Distribution Network Expansion & Management:
Identify opportunities for expanding the retail distribution network within the territory.
Develop and implement effective distribution management schemes to maximize coverage and penetration.
Ensure the optimal allocation and management of resources within the Depot.
Customer Relationship Management:
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.
Act as a liaison between customers and the organization, addressing their needs and concerns proactively.

Professional Qualifications:
Essential:
Bachelors degree (Graduate)/MBA (Marketing)

Experience Requirements:
10-12 years of hands-on experience in sales management through a channel network, preferably within the paints, building materials, tyre or related industries.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets in a highly competitive market.
Strong experience in managing a sales team and Depot operations independently.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Age Range: 30-35 years

Personality Traits:
Dynamic and Goal-Oriented: Able to work in a fast-paced environment with a focus on results and business growth.
Strong Leadership and Managerial Skills: A natural leader with the ability to inspire and manage teams effectively.
Customer-Centric: Excellent interpersonal skills with a customer-first approach to sales and service.
Analytical Thinker: Strong ability to analyze sales data and market trends to drive informed decisions.
Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally with various departments.
AboutCompany: Berger Paints India Limited (BPIL) is one of India's foremost paint companies, currently ranked as second largest on the basis of consolidated sales turnover in Indian paint industry.

AboutCompany:
GIBBON INFRASTRUCTURES PVT. LTD.
Company Profile
Renewable Energy | Solar Power Solutions | Civil Construction & Infrastructure Development
1. About the Company
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. is an infrastructure and renewable energy company engaged in the solar power industry since 2021, alongside civil construction and infrastructure development activities. The company is committed to delivering reliable, technically sound, and cost-effective solutions that address the growing demand for sustainable energy and quality infrastructure.
With a focus on professional project execution, customer satisfaction, and responsible business practices, the company undertakes solar power installations and civil construction works for residential, commercial, institutional, and other project requirements.
Through its presence in the renewable energy sector and its involvement in construction activities, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. aims to contribute to India's clean energy transition and infrastructure development.
2. Solar Power & Renewable Energy Division
Since 2021, the company has been engaged in solar power solutions, supporting the adoption of renewable energy through rooftop solar installations and commercial solar projects. Its activities include project planning, system supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and associated technical services.
The company undertakes solar projects across a range of capacities, from 3 kW residential rooftop systems to large-scale projects of up to 100 MW, subject to project scope and technical requirements.
Key Areas of Expertise
Residential rooftop solar power systems.
Solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana.
Commercial and industrial solar power projects.
On-grid, hybrid, and off-grid solar solutions.
Solar photovoltaic (PV) system design and installation.
Supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of solar systems.
Solar project coordination and technical support.
Assistance with project documentation and relevant utility coordination.
The company works with solar equipment brands including Premier, Pahal, Adani, Vikram Solar, INA, Microtek, and Citizen, subject to project specifications and availability.
3. Civil Construction & Infrastructure Division
In addition to renewable energy, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. undertakes civil construction and infrastructure-related works. The company recognises the importance of sound engineering practices, proper planning, quality materials, and efficient execution in delivering durable and dependable infrastructure.
Scope of Activities
Civil construction and building works.
Plain Cement Concrete (PCC) and Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) works.
Structural and allied construction activities.
Site preparation and development.
Foundation and related civil works.
Construction support for solar power installations.
Other civil and infrastructure works as per project specifications.
The company seeks to execute projects in accordance with applicable technical requirements, contractual obligations, safety practices, and agreed project schedules.
4. Our Vision
To establish Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. as a trusted organisation in renewable energy and infrastructure development by delivering sustainable solutions, maintaining professional standards, and creating long-term value for clients and stakeholders.
5. Our Mission
To promote the adoption of clean and renewable energy.
To deliver reliable and efficient solar power solutions.
To undertake civil construction works with a focus on quality and durability.
To maintain transparency, accountability, and professionalism in business operations.
To develop long-term relationships through customer satisfaction and dependable project delivery.
To contribute to sustainable development through responsible construction and energy solutions.
6. Our Core Values
Quality: Maintaining appropriate standards in materials, workmanship, and project execution.
Integrity: Conducting business with transparency, accountability, and ethical practices.
Reliability: Focusing on dependable solutions and professional service delivery.
Safety: Promoting safe working practices across project sites and operations.
Sustainability: Supporting renewable energy adoption and environmentally responsible development.
Customer Focus: Understanding client requirements and providing solutions aligned with project objectives.
7. Our Approach to Project Execution
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. follows a project-oriented approach based on understanding client requirements, planning resources, coordinating technical activities, and executing works in accordance with agreed specifications.
For solar projects, the approach may cover site assessment, system design, equipment selection, installation, testing, commissioning, and associated documentation. For civil construction projects, the approach focuses on work planning, material and resource coordination, construction quality, site safety, and timely completion.
8. Commitment to Sustainable Development
The company recognises the growing role of renewable energy and dependable infrastructure in economic and social development. By operating across solar power and civil construction, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. seeks to support energy efficiency, infrastructure improvement, and sustainable growth.
The company remains committed to strengthening its capabilities, developing professional partnerships, and delivering value-driven solutions for its clients.
9. Conclusion
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. combines its experience in the solar power industry since 2021 with its involvement in civil construction and infrastructure works. Through a commitment to quality, technical competence, responsible execution, and customer satisfaction, the company aims to build lasting relationships and contribute meaningfully to India's renewable energy and infrastructure sectors.

Description:
Account Manager Wireline Services

Do you want to be part of a diverse Account team, and propel growth across our Baker Hughes Wireline Business

Are you excited to win business and develop strategies
Join our Baker Hughes Wireline Account team!
Our Wireline division, a Baker Hughes business, has been supporting industries for over 100 years, celebrating many successes and first to market innovations along the way. Our Account team ensures our innovative products perform safely and efficiently, for all our customers. We deliver state of the art solutions time and time again that provide exemplary functionality and high-level technical support.

In Baker Hughes Wireline we strive to change energy, meeting the world s growing demand for energy, and the world s demands for energy to be cleaner, safer and more efficient. Our Wireline technologies help industry advance on the path to net-zero and to a sustainable energy future.
Partner with the best
Job Title: Account Manager, Wireline Services
The Account Manager will be a customer facing role, responsible for winning business within the end user and projects space in India.
They will develop a customer interface roadmap with a short, medium, and long-term perspective but also with the intensity of turning leads into actual orders. This is a unique role to contribute to real opportunities, with real solutions and real equipment.
As the Account Manager, you will be reporting to Country Sales Manager- India, and will be responsible for:
Growing Wireline Business in Northeastern part of India.
Positioning the Baker Hughes Wireline business as a critical Wireline partner for all customer present in region.
Leading account (End Users, EPCs, OEMs, Licensors) engagement and strategy.
Leading Billing and collection to ensure cash flow.
Managing and developing a solid pipeline of end user and project opportunities.
Executing on assigned Account targets and driving Account growth.
Providing regional market intelligence, competitive intelligence, and customer intelligence within the designated area.
Reporting on all regional activities related to market awareness and new project updates.
Negotiating contracts in collaboration with the commercial operations and risk management teams, and proactively leading negotiations on the most significant aspects of the assigned opportunities.
Demonstrating commercial and technical expertise in the Wireline market and maintaining knowledge of the market trends and product needs.
Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:
Have a degree in an engineering discipline or similar, with work experience in the wireline business.
Have excellent technical knowledge of Wireline Services across all industry sectors.
Have excellent interpersonal and presentation skills.
Be able to communicate at all levels within the organization and effectively influence others without authority.
Have the ability to coordinate and negotiate across several projects
simultaneously with varying complexity.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills and be fluent in English.
This role requires on-site presence.
Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive
Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.
Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
Comprehensive private medical care options
Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
Tailored financial programs
Additional elected or voluntary benefits

DJ Baruah Engineers Architects is inviting applications for the position of Graduate Engineer (Civil) at our Jorhat office.
We are a professional architectural and engineering firm based in Jorhat, Assam, working in the fields of architectural design, civil engineering, structural planning, interior design, building permission drawings, and turnkey construction projects . Our project portfolio includes residential buildings, commercial buildings, interior projects, institutional buildings, hotels, resorts, and other architectural works across Assam.
We are looking for a sincere, disciplined, and technically sound Civil Engineering graduate who is willing to learn, take responsibility, and work closely with our design and construction team.
Position
Graduate Engineer (Civil)
Location
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects 2nd Floor, Above Naffy Restaurant, Baruah Chariali, Opposite Westside Shopping Mall, Jorhat, Assam
Eligibility
The candidate should have:
B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Basic knowledge of building construction, RCC works, finishing works, and site execution
Basic understanding of drawings, plans, sections, elevations, and structural details
Knowledge of AutoCAD will be preferred
Basic knowledge of estimation, quantity calculation, and BOQ preparation will be an added advantage
Good communication skills and willingness to work in a team
Freshers may apply
Job Responsibilities
The selected candidate will be involved in:
Reading and understanding architectural and structural drawings
Preparing basic quantity calculations and material estimates
Assisting in site supervision and construction monitoring
Coordinating with architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, and site workers
Checking site work as per approved drawings and specifications
Preparing site reports, measurement sheets, and work progress updates
Supporting the team in building permission drawings, BOQ preparation, and project documentation
Maintaining proper technical records and project files
Learning office standards, construction detailing, and professional project workflow
Candidate Profile
We are looking for someone who is:
Serious about building a career in civil engineering and construction
Ready to learn both office-based technical work and site execution work
Punctual, honest, and responsible
Able to follow instructions and maintain professional discipline
Interested in residential, commercial, interior, and turnkey building projects
Comfortable working in a structured office environment
Experience
Freshers can apply. Candidates with 0 to 1 year of experience will be preferred.
Interview Location
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects Jorhat Head Office

Description:
Research Associate Job Summary
As a Research Associate at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a crucial role in conducting extensive market research and analysis to support the development and publication of syndicated market reports. You will collaborate closely with our research team to gather and analyze data, identify market trends, and provide valuable insights to our clients. This position requires strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and a passion for staying updated on market developments.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct comprehensive research on various industries and markets to gather relevant data and information.
Analyze market trends, competitive landscapes, and emerging opportunities to provide insights that contribute to the development of high-quality reports.
Collect and interpret quantitative and qualitative data from diverse sources, including industry databases, research reports, company websites, and government publications.
Collaborate with the research team to define research objectives, methodologies, and timelines for each project.
Conduct primary and secondary research, including interviews, surveys, and data mining, to gather accurate and up-to-date information.
Evaluate and validate data quality, ensuring its reliability and relevance to the research objectives.
Analyze research findings using statistical techniques and data visualization tools to create insightful and visually appealing reports.
Prepare well-structured, concise, and informative written reports that effectively communicate research findings and recommendations to clients.
Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to enhance the quality and relevance of research reports.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, and editorial, to ensure timely delivery and effective promotion of syndicate reports.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, economics, marketing, market research, science and technology or a related field.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to interpret complex data and draw meaningful insights.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
Detail-oriented mindset with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Self-motivated and proactive approach to research, with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated on industry trends.
If you are a highly motivated individual with a keen interest in market analysis, we invite you to join our dynamic team as a Research Associate. Together, we will contribute to the production of insightful syndicate market reports that enable our clients to make informed business decisions in a rapidly evolving market landscape.

Description:
Digital Marketing Executive Job Summary
As a Digital Marketing Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a crucial role in driving digital marketing strategies to promote our reports, expand our online presence, and engage our target audience. You will be responsible for developing and executing digital marketing campaigns, managing social media platforms, optimizing website content, and analyzing campaign performance. This position requires a strong understanding of digital marketing channels, excellent communication skills, and a passion for leveraging digital platforms to reach and influence potential customers.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement digital marketing strategies to promote market research reports and increase brand visibility and engagement.
Plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across various channels, including search engines, social media, email, and display advertising.
Manage and maintain social media platforms, creating compelling content and engaging with the audience to drive brand awareness and foster community engagement.
Monitor and analyze key performance metrics, such as website traffic, conversion rates, and engagement levels, to identify areas for improvement and optimize marketing efforts.
Conduct keyword research and optimize website content to improve search engine visibility and drive organic traffic.
Collaborate with internal teams to create persuasive marketing materials, including landing pages, blog posts, email newsletters, and promotional videos, to align digital marketing efforts with overall business goals.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging digital marketing technologies to implement innovative strategies and techniques.
Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to identify opportunities for differentiation and competitive positioning.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in marketing, digital marketing, communications, or a related field.
Solid understanding of digital marketing channels, including SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing, content marketing, and display advertising.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create engaging content and effectively communicate with the target audience.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and metrics to make data-driven decisions and optimize campaign performance.
Creative mindset with a keen eye for design aesthetics and the ability to create visually appealing digital assets.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
If you are a results-oriented individual with a passion for digital marketing and the ability to drive impactful marketing campaigns, we invite you to join our team as a Digital Marketing Executive. Together, we will leverage digital platforms and strategies to promote our market research reports, engage our audience, and drive business growth in a competitive market landscape.

Description:
Sales Executive Job Summary
As a Sales Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a pivotal role in driving sales growth and expanding our client base. You will be responsible for generating new business leads, nurturing client relationships, and closing sales deals. This position requires strong sales acumen, excellent communication skills, and a deep understanding of the market research industry. If you are a self-motivated and results-driven individual with a passion for sales and a knack for building strong client relationships, we invite you to join our dynamic team
Key Responsibilities
Identify and pursue new business opportunities by proactively generating leads and establishing connections with potential clients.
Conduct market research and analysis to identify target industries and sectors for sales prospecting.
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients to foster loyalty and secure repeat business.
Deliver persuasive sales presentations and product demonstrations to prospective clients, showcasing the value and benefits of our syndicated market research reports.
Understand client needs, provide customized solutions, and effectively communicate the unique value propositions of our reports to drive sales conversions.
Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement effective sales strategies, campaigns, and promotional materials.
Utilize CRM systems and sales tools to track sales activities, manage leads, and monitor the sales pipeline.
Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation.
Attend industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events to expand professional networks and generate new sales leads.
Collaborate with internal teams, including research, marketing, and customer support, to ensure client satisfaction and seamless execution of sales processes.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
Proven experience in sales, preferably within the market research industry or a related field.
Strong sales acumen with a track record of achieving sales targets and driving business growth.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively articulate the value propositions of our syndicated market research reports.
Exceptional negotiation and closing skills, with the ability to handle objections and secure sales deals.
Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients.
Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools to manage leads and track sales activities.
Self-motivated and results-driven mindset, with the ability to work independently and meet sales targets.
Excellent time management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
Knowledge of the market research industry, including the understanding of research methodologies, report types, and client needs, is preferred.
If you are a driven sales professional with a passion for driving business growth and a strong understanding of the market research industry, we invite you to join our team as a Sales Executive. Together, we will leverage your sales expertise to expand our client base, increase revenue, and deliver valuable market insights to our clients.

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.

A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.

Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills

Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Store upkeep & maintenance

He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions

Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Responsible for providing short-term, specialized patient care, diagnostic monitoring, and minor surgical procedures that do not require overnight hospitalization.

Clinical & Patient Care
Outpatient Consultations (OPD): Conduct primary medical examinations, take comprehensive patient histories, and assess acute or chronic illnesses.
Daycare Management: Supervise and manage short-stay patients undergoing procedures like IV fluid therapies, chemotherapy sessions, dialysis, blood transfusions, or prolonged diagnostic monitoring.
Minor Procedures: Perform or assist in minor surgical or medical procedures such as wound suturing, dressings, incision and drainage (I&D), foreign body removal, and catheterization.
Diagnostic Interpretation: Order and evaluate basic clinical investigations (e.g., blood tests, X-rays, ECGs) to formulate quick and accurate treatment plans.
Emergency & Stabilization
Acute Care & Triage: Identify critical shifts in a patient's vital signs or general condition during their short stay.
Emergency Management: Administer first-line emergency medical care and stabilize patients experiencing sudden medical crises before coordinating transfers to higher care centers.
Operations & Administration
Multidisciplinary Liaison: Coordinate closely with nursing staff, specialist consultants, and administrators to ensure seamless patient care and timely discharges.
Medical Documentation: Maintain highly precise Electronic Medical Records (EMR), including admission notes, procedure records, drug charts, and discharge summaries.
Referrals & Follow-ups: Structure comprehensive discharge guidelines and schedule routine outpatient follow-up care.

Qualifications & Licensing
Degree: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) from a recognized medical council.
Licensure: Valid and active registration with the relevant State Medical Council or National Medical Commission (NMC)

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Responsibilities:
All incoming materials test as per approved Inspection and Test Plan and Standards.
Ensure Quality of work executed is as per the relevant technical specification / standards.
Coordinating for all external lab test as per approved Inspection and Test Plan.
Develop and implement the Quality Assurance Plan (QAP) and Inspection Test Plan (ITP) for the BLT project.
Establish procedures for material testing, workmanship assessment, and documentation control.
Site visit in daily basis to check the site work as per our project contract method and maintain proper process to execute the work with required quality.
Weekly/Monthly Quality Walk with client/PM for continual improvement and compliance within target date.
Client Handling, Communication resolve issues (if any) with immediate effect.
Customer feedback by conducting client meeting.
Ensure Audit compliance within stipulated time.
Checking all materials jointly with client to ensure the brand, manufacturing, quality of materials is okay as per our project contract. Also conduct testing (in house & third-party lab. Test) of all materials for checking the quality.
Conduct regular quality audits, inspections, and site walkthroughs to identify defects or deviations.
Ensure proper testing of concrete, steel, and other materials at approved laboratories.
Implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for quality-related non-conformances.
Visit all RMC vendors resources, check all materials, calibration certificates of all equipment’s, conduct mix design to reduce concrete cost.
Maintain all test reports, monthly progress report, all quality registers, files and co-ordinate with office management.
Conduct quality training to supervisors, site engineers and all labours to execute work as per out contract process and maintain the quality of work and improve the skills.
Ensure timely identification and communication of QA/QC issues to project team by raising internal NCR/observation through monthly Quality meeting.
Conducting training among the staff and workers on ongoing activities.
Work closely with execution, procurement, and design teams to maintain quality compliance.
Conduct training sessions for site engineers, supervisors, and workers on quality practices.
Ensure proper implementation of QA standards across subcontractors and vendors.

Description:
Senior Resident Paediatrics

Role Overview
The Senior Resident Paediatrics is a full-time, post-MD/DNB clinical and academic tenure position at a leading university-run super speciality teaching hospital and medical college integrating compassionate care, advanced medicine, teaching and research. The role delivers round-the-clock paediatric and neonatal care across the wards, emergency, NICU, PICU and outpatient services, while supporting the training of undergraduate and postgraduate medical students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of the Department of Paediatrics through the assigned unit faculty and supervises Junior Residents, interns and nursing teams on duty. It is a tenure position of up to 3 years under National Medical Commission (NMC) norms, suited to a qualified paediatrician seeking clinical depth alongside teaching and research exposure.

Work Mode
Work mode: work from hospital (fully on-site), with working days per hospital/NMC norms, including duty, on-call and emergency rosters as assigned by the department. No travel requirement has been specified for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Provide first-line senior clinical care to neonates, infants, children and adolescents admitted to paediatric wards, NICU and PICU, including daily rounds and clinical decision-making.
Assess, stabilise and manage paediatric and neonatal emergencies, including resuscitation, shock, respiratory distress, seizures, sepsis and poisoning.
Lead neonatal resuscitation at high-risk deliveries and caesarean sections in coordination with the obstetrics team.
Perform and supervise essential procedures such as endotracheal intubation, umbilical and peripheral vascular access, lumbar puncture, intraosseous access and surfactant administration, as clinically indicated.
Initiate and monitor respiratory support, including oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation, under faculty guidance.
Conduct paediatric outpatient and specialty clinics, including growth and development assessment, nutrition counselling, well-baby care and follow-up of high-risk newborns.
Implement immunisation services in line with the national immunisation schedule and Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) recommendations, including counselling of parents.
Take on-call and emergency duties as per the departmental roster, ensuring timely handover and continuity of care across shifts.
Teach and mentor MBBS students, interns and Junior Residents through bedside teaching, case presentations, skills sessions and assessments under competency-based medical education.
Maintain accurate, timely and legally sound medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, consent, discharge summaries and death certification.
Communicate clearly and compassionately with parents and families on diagnosis, prognosis and treatment plans, including breaking difficult news and obtaining informed consent.
Adhere to infection control, antimicrobial stewardship, patient safety and quality protocols, and participate in clinical audits and mortality and morbidity reviews.
Participate in departmental academic activities and clinical research, including journal clubs, seminars, case reports and approved research projects.
Coordinate with paediatric surgery, obstetrics, radiology, laboratory and other super speciality teams for multidisciplinary care and timely referrals.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical college recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MD (Paediatrics) or DNB (Paediatrics) from an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited institution, completed with results declared by the date of joining.
Valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, with the postgraduate qualification registered or eligible for registration.
Age below 45 years at initial appointment, as per prevailing NMC norms for Senior Residents in broad specialties.

Required Experience
Experience range: 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB paediatric clinical experience. Freshly qualified MD/DNB Paediatrics doctors are eligible to apply.
Relevant experience: postgraduate residency in Paediatrics with substantial rotations in NICU, PICU, paediatric emergency and general paediatric wards in a tertiary care or teaching hospital.
Preferred experience: prior work as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in Paediatrics in a medical college, teaching hospital or multi-specialty tertiary care hospital.
Industry preference: medical colleges, university teaching hospitals, super speciality hospitals and high-volume tertiary paediatric or neonatal care centres.

Technical and Functional Skills
Neonatal resuscitation and stabilisation in line with Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) and National Neonatology Forum (NNF) guidelines.
Paediatric emergency and critical care management in line with Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) principles, including airway, breathing and circulation support.
Working knowledge of respiratory support: oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation.
Procedural competence: intubation, umbilical venous and arterial catheterisation, intraosseous access, lumbar puncture, surfactant administration and exchange transfusion.
Fluid, electrolyte and nutritional management, including parenteral nutrition in neonates and critically ill children.
Management of neonatal jaundice, prematurity, sepsis, respiratory distress, malnutrition, diarrhoeal disease and common infectious diseases of childhood.
Interpretation of blood gases, laboratory results and paediatric and neonatal imaging.
Growth monitoring, developmental assessment, immunisation practice and preventive paediatrics.
Clinical documentation on hospital information systems or electronic medical records, and adherence to evidence-based IAP and NNF protocols.
Bedside teaching and assessment methods under competency-based medical education.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Compassionate, family-centred communication with children and parents, including counselling under stress and breaking difficult news.
Composure, sound judgement and rapid decision-making during emergencies and night duties.
Team leadership on duty, guiding Junior Residents, interns and nursing staff with clarity and respect.
Collaboration with faculty, nursing, allied health and other clinical departments.
Strong professional ethics, integrity, patient confidentiality and respect for child rights and safeguarding.
Teaching aptitude, patience and a willingness to mentor learners.
Time management, reliability on rosters and accountability for patient outcomes.
Cultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate with patients from diverse linguistic and social backgrounds.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Valid NRP, PALS and Basic Life Support (BLS) certifications.
Fellowship or certificate training in Neonatology, Paediatric Critical Care or a related paediatric subspecialty.
Publications, case reports or conference presentations in Paediatrics or Neonatology.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and exposure to medical education workshops.
Membership of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) or National Neonatology Forum (NNF).
Exposure to hospital quality, accreditation and patient safety programmes.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate has completed MD or DNB Paediatrics at a reputed NMC-recognised medical college or NBEMS-accredited hospital with a high patient load, and has trained across neonatal, paediatric intensive care, emergency and general paediatric services. Candidates with 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB experience as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in recognised teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary care centres are preferred, as are those with a stable, verifiable work record. The role suits doctors building a career in academic paediatrics or preparing for super-speciality training, as Senior Resident experience in a recognised teaching institution is relevant to NMC eligibility norms for teaching faculty positions.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is offered as a competitive annual CTC (Total Cost to Company) in Indian Rupees (), commensurate with qualification, experience and institutional norms. Benefits follow institutional policy and are shared with shortlisted candidates at the offer stage. The role offers structured clinical exposure across neonatal and paediatric critical care, protected involvement in teaching and research, and the experience of working in a super speciality academic environment.

Application Instructions
Send your resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – Paediatrics", via email to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message, or by WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include copies of your MBBS and MD/DNB certificates, your medical registration, a summary of NICU and PICU exposure, and your current notice period. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete the screening questionnaire and appear for an interview.

Description:
Role Overview
The Senior Resident General Surgery is a full-time, post-MS/DNB clinical and academic position in the Department of General Surgery of a leading super speciality teaching hospital and medical college run by a renowned university. The role combines hands-on operative surgery, round-the-clock emergency and trauma care, ward and outpatient management, and structured teaching of undergraduate and postgraduate students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of Department and works under the supervision of Professors, Associate Professors and Assistant Professors, while supervising Junior Residents, interns and the unit's clinical team. The position bridges postgraduate training and an independent teaching-faculty career, building the Senior Residency experience recognised under National Medical Commission (NMC) regulations.

Work Mode
Work from hospital (on-site at the teaching hospital), duty days per NMC norms, including rostered on-call, night and emergency duties; no regular travel is expected.

Key Responsibilities
Perform elective general surgical procedures as primary surgeon or first assistant, including hernia repair, appendicectomy, cholecystectomy, and breast, thyroid and soft-tissue surgery, with consultant supervision as appropriate.
Manage acute surgical emergencies and polytrauma, including resuscitation, primary and secondary survey, emergency laparotomy and timely escalation to consultants.
Conduct surgical outpatient clinics, evaluating new and follow-up patients and planning investigations, conservative treatment or surgery.
Lead daily ward rounds, preoperative assessment and optimisation, and postoperative care, with early recognition and management of complications.
Obtain valid, documented informed consent and counsel patients and families on diagnosis, procedure, risks and expected outcomes.
Perform and assist in laparoscopic procedures, such as diagnostic laparoscopy, laparoscopic appendicectomy and laparoscopic cholecystectomy, progressively building minimal access skills.
Carry out bedside and minor procedures, including incision and drainage, biopsies, chest tube insertion, central venous access and suprapubic catheterisation.
Teach and assess MBBS students and postgraduate residents through bedside clinics, lectures, case presentations, skills-lab sessions and competency-based medical education (CBME) activities.
Supervise and mentor Junior Residents and interns, overseeing clinical decisions, handovers, duty rosters and logbook entries.
Maintain accurate and timely case records, operative notes, discharge summaries and medico-legal documentation in the hospital information system.
Apply and promote patient safety, infection prevention and control, the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, antimicrobial stewardship and accreditation standards.
Coordinate with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology and other specialities for multidisciplinary care of complex surgical patients.
Contribute to clinical audits, morbidity and mortality meetings, journal clubs, research projects and publications of the department.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from an institution recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MS (General Surgery) from an NMC-recognised institution, or DNB (General Surgery) awarded by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS), recognised as per prevailing NMC regulations.
Permanent registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, and eligibility to register with the Sikkim Medical Council.
Age within the NMC upper limit for Senior Residents in broad specialities, currently 45 years.

Required Experience
Experience range: 03 years of post-MS/DNB experience in General Surgery; freshly qualified MS/DNB General Surgery graduates are eligible. Preferred: 1–3 years as Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist in General Surgery at an NMC-recognised medical college or a tertiary-care multispeciality hospital. Relevant experience includes a documented operative logbook with procedures performed as primary surgeon, independent first-line management of surgical emergencies and trauma, and exposure to undergraduate teaching. Experience in high-volume emergency surgical services is valued.

Technical and Functional Skills
Open general surgery: inguinal and ventral hernia repair, appendicectomy, breast and thyroid surgery, excision of soft-tissue swellings and wound management.
Emergency surgery: laparotomy for perforation, obstruction and abdominal trauma, bowel resection and anastomosis, and stoma creation.
Minimal access surgery at basic to intermediate level: safe port placement, diagnostic laparoscopy, and laparoscopic appendicectomy and cholecystectomy.
Trauma care aligned with ATLS principles, including primary and secondary survey and bedside FAST interpretation.
Perioperative care: fluid and electrolyte balance, surgical nutrition, sepsis management, thromboprophylaxis and pain control.
Interpretation of ultrasound, CT, MRI and laboratory investigations for surgical decision-making.
Working knowledge of infection prevention and control, biomedical waste management, medico-legal procedures and hospital information systems.
CBME-based teaching, logbook supervision and formative assessment of students and residents.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Sound clinical judgement and composure under pressure; clear, empathetic communication with patients and families, including breaking difficult news; teamwork and leadership within the surgical unit; commitment to teaching and mentoring; ethical, professional conduct with medico-legal awareness; disciplined time management across clinical, academic and on-call duties; resilience during demanding rosters; and respect for a culturally diverse patient population.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
ATLS or an equivalent trauma course, and current BLS/ACLS certification; FMAS, FIAGES or other structured laparoscopic training; completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) and Basic Course in Medical Education (BCME); MRCS or FRCS examination progress; membership of the Association of Surgeons of India (ASI); thesis-based or indexed-journal publications and conference presentations; prior teaching experience in a medical college; and the ability to communicate in Hindi, with working knowledge of Nepali an advantage.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate trained at an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited teaching hospital with substantial elective and emergency surgical volumes, and shows a consistent academic record through MBBS and MS/DNB. Prior Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist tenure at a reputed government or private medical college or a tertiary-care hospital strengthens the application. The career trajectory should point towards academic surgery or a teaching-faculty role, with stable tenures and verifiable references.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is competitive and aligned with the candidate's qualifications, experience and institutional norms for Senior Residents. The role offers broad elective, emergency and teaching exposure in an academic setting. Leave, academic support and any other benefits follow institutional policy and NMC norms, and will be detailed at the offer stage.

Application Instructions
Send your updated resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – General Surgery", by email to careers@execvera.com, LinkedIn message, or WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include your MBBS and MS/DNB details, medical council registration number, a summary of your operative logbook, current employer and notice period in days, current and expected annual CTC in , and any certifications or publications. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview and document verification.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Senior Resident

Department Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT)

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super Speciality Teaching Hospital.

Employment Type Full-Time | Resident Medical Officer (Teaching Hospital)

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Senior Resident in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim, is a pivotal training and operational role for postgraduate-qualified doctors seeking structured hands-on experience in forensic medical practice within a university teaching hospital. The incumbent will contribute to undergraduate MBBS teaching, forensic laboratory operations, mortuary supervision, and medico-legal documentation under the guidance of senior faculty. This role serves as a critical stepping stone toward an academic career as Assistant Professor, fulfilling the NMC-mandated Senior Resident experience requirement in a recognized medical institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and tutorial classes in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as assigned by the Head of Department.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes, practical demonstrations, and case-based learning sessions for MBBS students and interns.
Assist senior faculty in postgraduate teaching activities including seminars, journal clubs, and case presentations.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required to ensure uninterrupted academic programme delivery.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Collect, record, and maintain accurate patient and case information in accordance with institutional and medico-legal documentation standards.
Assist in forensic laboratory activities including collection of forensic samples such as viscera, blood, and tissues for toxicological analysis.
Ensure proper preservation and timely dispatch of forensic samples for toxicology analysis, adhering to institutional and legal protocols.
Maintain strict chain of custody for all forensic evidence ensuring proper labelling, packaging, documentation, and secure transfer at every stage.
Supervise mortuary operations and enforce safety protocols including infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling procedures.
Assist in medico-legal autopsy procedures under the supervision of faculty, including documentation of findings.
Support preparation of medico-legal certificates, injury reports, and other forensic documentation as required.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required, ensuring continuity of clinical and forensic operations.

C. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Maintain meticulous records of all forensic cases, samples, and medico-legal proceedings handled by the department.
Participate in departmental quality improvement initiatives and NABH compliance activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes, workshops, and departmental academic activities.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Department or senior faculty.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (or equivalent recognized qualification) from a permitted/recognized medical college or institution, as per NMC guidelines.
Regulatory & Compliance Requirements
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission is mandatory.
Appointment must comply with current NMC guidelines for Senior Resident positions in recognized medical institutions.
Must complete or be willing to complete the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (NMC-mandated) during the tenure.
Preference for candidates seeking to fulfill NMC-recognized SR experience for future Assistant Professor eligibility.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Forensic & Clinical Skills
Forensic sample collection & handling
Toxicology sample preservation & dispatch
Chain of custody maintenance
Mortuary supervision & safety
Post-mortem assistance & documentation
Medico-legal record keeping

Academic & Technical
UG MBBS lecture & clinical teaching
Practical demonstration skills
NMC regulatory awareness
Medical documentation & reporting
Forensic laboratory procedures
Biomedical research basics

Interpersonal & Soft Skills
Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal & written communication
Detail-oriented & organized
Ethical & professional conduct
Team collaboration skills
Composure in forensic environments

Job Summary
ATREE is seeking an Analyst to work closely with the Policy Lead to review, analyses, study, conduct consultations, and draft recommendations on mountain-specific policies related to biodiversity conservation, landscape restoration, and bio-resource use in the project landscapes and States.
You will be a key member of a team led by the Director -The Himalaya Initiative. You will represent ATREE to external stakeholders, including government departments in the project states, IHR states, and at the national level, and will collaborate closely with regional teams in the IHR and at ATREE headquarters in Bengaluru.
Responsibilities
Support the Policy Lead in delivering the policy component of the AMP-Himalaya project, including timely reporting and tracking of success indicators.
Review rangeland, forest, and agroforestry policies and identify opportunities to strengthen mountain-specific approaches across the three landscapes.
Support development and advocacy of state-level policy action plans on restoration and agroecology (Sikkim), OECM/CCA (Arunachal Pradesh), and rangeland and pastoral governance (Ladakh).
Support the Policy Lead in mapping key stakeholders in policy-making and comparing existing policies to identify gaps, overlaps, and mountain-specific needs across the three landscapes, keeping the analysis current.
Conduct FGDs, expert interviews, and workshops on mountain-specific policies, following FPIC and inclusive community-engagement protocols and supporting equitable participation of women and marginalized groups.
Identify practices or policies detrimental to climate and ecosystem resilience, and develop case studies of successful mountain-specific models or practices.
Support drafting of policy recommendations and briefing papers, and their presentation to a multi-stakeholder panel for review and feedback, delivered on schedule to support the Policy Lead.
Support the advocacy campaign to raise awareness and capacity strengthening activities, including training government officials, policymakers, community leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.
Be part of the team compiling a comprehensive report and toolkit documenting the process, findings, recommendations, and outcomes for the IHR, and share it with stakeholders.
Support the team in creating the Legal-Institutional Framework and Modules for OECMs/CCA in Arunachal Pradesh, under the guidance of the Policy Lead and external legal counsel where required.
Support collaboration with ATREE s Academy for Conservation Science and Sustainability Studies and contribute to the project s digital knowledge commons, helping capture and curate policy-relevant data, analysis and case studies.
Write reports and support in contributing to the learning and reporting plan, and in coordinating with landscape, thematic, research, MEL and communications teams.
Represent ATREE in national and international forums and apply a proactive, strategic approach within and outside ATREE to deliver measurable policy impact.
Qualifications
Masters in a related field, i.e., environmental science, social sciences, natural science, ecology, natural resources management, public policy, law, or a related interdisciplinary field.
Experience Required
1 to 2 years of overall experience in policy work, with some experience in the mountains.
Strong networking skills and ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders.
Strong understanding of policy processes in government systems.
Understanding of, and commitment to, Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) and ethical community engagement protocols when working with indigenous and local communities in the IHR.
Sensitivity to gender and social inclusion considerations, with the ability to support equitable participation of women and marginalized groups in FGDs, consultations and workshops.
Excellent written and verbal English skills; knowledge of Hindi and/or a Himalayan regional language is an advantage; where not proficient, willingness to work through local translators/facilitators is required.
Proficient in analytical skills, report writing, and documentation.
Willingness to travel extensively across project locations in the Himalaya.
Skills to organize and communicate across levels of an organization and across geographies.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work closely with team members.
Desirable Skills
Familiarity with data collection, coding, and analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Kobo Toolbox, or similar) for organizing consultation and FGD findings.
Prior exposure to national or regional mountain/biodiversity policy frameworks (e.g., National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem, State Biodiversity Action Plans) gained through coursework, internships, or prior roles.
Comfort with digital documentation and knowledge-management platforms for curating and organizing policy-relevant data and case studies.

Job Summary
Lead - Policy
ATREE is seeking an experienced professional to lead reviews, analyses, studies, consultations, and recommendations on mountain-specific policies related to biodiversity conservation, landscape restoration, and bio-resource use in the project landscapes and States. The policy vision will be guided by global, regional, national, and state mountain policies from IHR.
You will be a key member of a versatile team led by the Director - The Himalaya Initiative. You will represent ATREE with external stakeholders, including government departments in the project states, IHR states, and at the national level, and will collaborate closely with regional teams in the IHR and at ATREE headquarters in Bengaluru.
In the Himalaya, ATREE s strategy is to work towards a future where resilient mountain and downstream societies sustainably enjoy the natural endowment of the Indian Himalayan Region (IHR) while protecting and preserving its rich biodiversity. ATREE has developed a 10-year strategy called The Himalaya Initiative (THI), focused on the IHR amid increasing biodiversity loss, environmental degradation, and climate change.
Project AMP-Himalaya is funded by the Rural India Supporting Trust (RIST), co-financed by Conservation International and Global Conservation, within the THI strategy, for a 5-year project period. The project aims to conserve biodiversity, restore landscapes, and foster human well-being in the Indian Himalayan Region. Three key areas prioritized to achieve the goal in the IHR are: 1) Assessment, Monitoring, and Conservation of Biodiversity; 2) Restoration of Multi-functional Landscapes; and 3) Nature-based Rural Livelihoods and Climate Change Resilience. Integral to these priorities are: creating digital knowledge commons to accelerate participatory management and local stewardship; strengthening human resources through training programs for local youth leaders and expanded environmental education opportunities; and creating conditions to develop and implement multi-level, mountain-specific policies that prioritize biodiversity conservation and natural resource management at scale.
The project is being implemented in 3 distinct landscapes located in 3 states and 1 union territory of IHR, namely: the Khangchendzonga Landscape covering the Darjeeling hills of North Bengal and Sikkim state; the Trans-Himalayan Landscape representing a high dependence on rangelands with agro-pastoral and pastoral systems in Ladakh; and Arunachal Pradesh with the largest, greenest, ethnically diverse and most biodiversity-rich landscapes.
Responsibilities
Develop and lead the roadmap and strategy, in collaboration with the THI Director, for the policy component of the AMP-Himalaya project, including annual workplans, timely donor and project reporting, and tracking policy outcomes and success indicators.
Lead and drive the process of reviewing existing policies related to biodiversity, forests, rangelands, agroforestry, restoration, bioresource use, nature-based livelihoods, and climate resilience, including stakeholder mapping to identify gaps, overlaps, and mountain-specific policy approaches across the three project landscapes.
Develop and advocate state-level policy action plans across all three landscapes, restoration and agro-ecology (Sikkim), OECM and CCA (Arunachal Pradesh), and rangeland and pastoral governance (Trans-Himalaya, Ladakh), ensuring balanced policy engagement across landscapes.
Lead in conducting FGDs, expert interviews, and multi-stakeholder workshops, following FPIC and inclusive community-engagement protocols and ensuring equitable participation of women and marginalized groups; use findings to flag policies/practices harmful to climate and ecosystem resilience and document successful mountain-specific case studies.
Develop and lead a roadmap for presentation of policy recommendations and briefing papers for key stakeholders for validation, and compile a comprehensive IHR policy report and toolkit for dissemination to stakeholders.
Create and lead the development of Legal-Institutional Framework and Modules for OECM/CCA in Arunachal Pradesh, partnering with external legal counsel engaged by ATREE for specialized legal drafting where required.
Develop and lead policy engagement and advocacy campaigns to raise awareness and strengthen capacity, including training government officials, policymakers, community leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.
Collaborate with ATREE s Academy for Conservation Science and Sustainability Studies and the project s digital knowledge commons to align policy work with ongoing research, fellowships and knowledge generation.
Contribute to the learning and reporting plan; provide technical guidance to Policy Analysts and Consultants; coordinate with landscape, thematic, research, MEL and communications teams.
Represent ATREE in national and international forums and apply a proactive, strategic approach within and outside ATREE to deliver measurable policy impact.
Qualifications
PhD in a related field, i.e., social sciences, environmental/natural sciences/natural resources management, public policy, law, economics, or a related interdisciplinary field.
A background in law, public policy, or economics is preferred in addition to the environmental/natural sciences; where specialized legal drafting is required (e.g., the Legal-Institutional Framework for OECMs/CCA), this will be carried out in partnership with external legal counsel engaged by ATREE.
Experience Required
5-6 years of professional experience in policy development and analysis, with substantial experience in mountain policy frameworks and a strong focus on the Himalaya.
Strong networking skills and demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders.
Strong understanding of policy processes in government systems.
Demonstrated understanding of, and commitment to, Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) and ethical community engagement protocols when working with indigenous and local communities in the IHR.
Sensitivity to gender and social inclusion considerations, with the ability to help ensure equitable participation of women and marginalized groups in FGDs, consultations and workshops.
Excellent written and verbal English skills; knowledge of Hindi and/or a Himalayan regional language is an advantage; where not proficient, willingness to work through local translators/facilitators is required.
Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated ability to coordinate teams, motivate colleagues and engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.
Proficient in analytical skills, report writing, and documentation.
Willingness to travel extensively across project locations in the Himalaya.
Experience working with nonprofits in the Conservation / Environment / Sustainability / Biodiversity space highly desirable.
Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating across teams and geographies to deliver on a set of goals.
Strong organizational, interpersonal and leadership skills with the ability to motivate and lead small teams.
Desirable Skills
Working knowledge of international and regional mountain and biodiversity frameworks, including the CBD Global Biodiversity Framework, ICIMOD/Hindu Kush Himalaya frameworks, and UNFCCC/NDC processes.
Experience in grant management, resource mobilization, proposal writing, and donor engagement.
Experience using digital knowledge and communication tools, including data visualization and dashboards, to translate technical findings into accessible briefs and toolkits.
