Job Title: Manager Strategy Consulting (Corporate Deals Technology)
Department: PwC Acceleration Center – Strategy Consulting
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview:

Join PwC’s Corporate Deals Technology (CDT) team to partner with global corporate clients and drive technology strategy that fuels business value and deal success in complex M&A transactions. Our CDT practice leverages deep industry knowledge and thought leadership to deliver consulting services focused on the technology elements of the value chain, enabling scalable and profitable business transformations.
As part of the Strategy platform, CDT supports corporate clients across industries by:

Developing M&A Technology Strategies for integrations, separations, carve-outs, and divestitures through collaboration with C-suite executives.
Conducting Technology Due Diligence to assess IT landscapes, identify risks, and uncover value creation opportunities.
Advising on Integration and Divestiture Planning to align technology strategies with business and operational goals.
Designing Future-State Technology Models and Architectures that support strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities:
As a Manager, you will lead a team of experienced consultants solving complex business challenges from strategy through execution. Your responsibilities will include:
Leading and supporting teams across the deal spectrum, including IT due diligence, integration, and separation activities.
Managing project delivery, guiding teams, and engaging in client and leadership communication.
Overseeing solution design and implementation, ensuring high quality deliverables within timeline and budget.
Planning and developing integration and separation plans covering Day One readiness, business process, and systems alignment.
Developing financial models related to IT synergies, one-time costs, standalone operations, and stranded costs.
Recommending enterprise architecture, solutions, and systems informed by industry best practices and past experience.
Advising on IT integration, separation, and carve-out strategies across various IT domains.
Mentoring and coaching senior associates and associates to consistently deliver impactful work.
Contributing to business development initiatives by identifying and researching opportunities with new and existing clients.
Building strong internal relationships and strengthening your personal brand within PwC.

Preferred Knowledge & Skills:

Must-Have:

Proven experience in IT M&A including IT due diligence, integration, separation planning, and execution.
Expertise in IT Strategy and Digital Transformation initiatives.
Technical proficiency in key IT pillars such as Application Rationalization, Infrastructure/Cloud Strategy, Cybersecurity, and ERP Transformation.
Demonstrated ability to lead large teams through end-to-end client engagements.
Strong project management, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
Solid data and cost modeling capabilities.
Proficiency in leveraging Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) for efficient research and analysis.

Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.

Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization Workiva Implementation,Blackline Implementation.

Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening

Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Description:
Job Summary
Meet the Team At Splunk and Cisco, we believe in turning data into answers. We are a team of passionate innovators in the Customer Success Experience organization, committed to our customers success, our product s evolution, and, most importantly, each other s growth. Together, we help clients navigate the complex landscape of modern cyber defense and redefine how the world interacts with machine data.
Your Impact
As a Professional Services Architect (Security), you will be the technical and strategic authority for our Security portfolio and a Trusted Advisor to our customers. You will architect solutions across our SIEM and SOAR ecosystems, including Splunk Enterprise Security, UEBA, and SOAR. You isn t just deploying software; you are architecting outcomes that protect organizations from the next generation of threats, with the opportunity to take ownership of your work, learn from industry leaders, and play a vital role in a team that celebrates collective success. This role requires regional travel of up to 30%.
Responsibilities
Architect Complex Solutions: Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of security deployments, from initial strategy and integration to ongoing optimization.
Drive Innovation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to influence product roadmaps and develop new strategies that redefine how customers monitor their infrastructure.
Act as a Trusted Advisor: Engage at all levels, from C-suite stakeholders to technical engineers, to ensure operational success and strategic alignment.
Empower the Customer: Enable client teams to manage, scale, and solve complex security challenges independently.
Foster Growth: Champion a culture of continuous improvement, mentoring team members and contributing to a collaborative, high-performance environment.
Minimum Qualifications
5+ years of experience in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), security consulting, or security sales engineering.
Proven success implementing and architecting SIEM software.
Strong background in Cloud IaaS (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and 3+ years of experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes and Docker).
Proficiency in at least two of the following: Python, Java, .NET, PHP, Ruby, Node.JS, Objective-C; comfortable working across both Unix and Windows command lines.
Experience with automation/orchestration tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef, or Terraform).
Preferred Qualifications
A high sense of urgency and the ability to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical problems into business-value conversations.
A self-starter mindset with a passion for continuous learning and professional development.
Experience creating technical documentation (architecture diagrams, white papers, etc.).
Bonus: Knowledge of Splunk administration or statistical and analytical modeling.

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Servicessolving real client challenges through connected collaboration. Well help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a SAP-BODS-Senior Associate, you will specialize in providing consulting services for data and analytics solutions using SAP technologies. You will analyze client requirements, design and implement data management and analytics solutions, and provide training and support for effective utilization of SAP data and analytics tools. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will work closely with clients to understand their data needs, develop data models, perform data analysis, and create visualizations and reports to support data-driven decision-making, helping them optimize their data management processes, enhance data quality, and derive valuable insights from their data to achieve their strategic objectives.
As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, asking questions, and using these moments as opportunities to grow. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage your experience in data migration and SAP BODS to provide advisory services, design data migration solutions, and support data cleansing activities.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client data migration requirements and legacy data structures to design effective migration solutions
- Collaborating with SAP functional and technical consultants to address data migration needs and challenges
- Designing and implementing data migration frameworks using SAP Data Services and Information Steward
- Managing data migration processes, including building, testing, and executing migrations with SAP SDS LSMW and SAP Migration Cockpit
- Conducting preload and post-load validation of migration results and advising on data cleansing requirements
- Performing migration dress rehearsals, cutover tasks, and providing post go-live support
- Developing data models and performing data analysis to support data-driven decision-making
- Creating technical specification documents for data services jobs based on migration experience and programming knowledge
- Supporting data cleansing and validation activities using tools like Information Steward, Excel, and SQL
- Providing advisory services to clients on data management strategies and techniques
- Utilizing Snaplogic for data migration from source systems to S/4 HANA
- Building and maintaining client relationships to understand and address their data management needs

Manager – Finance, Compliance & Accounts
You are responsible for supporting the company’s financial operations, accounting processes, statutory compliances, financial reporting and audit requirements. The role ensures timely and accurate financial information, effective monitoring of budgets and cash flows, adherence to applicable statutory and institutional requirements, and smooth coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities:
I. Accounts Closing:
F Personally execute monthly and annual closing: trial balance, P&L and Balance Sheet preparation.
F Perform ledger scrutiny to identify and correct mis-postings and period-end errors.
F Carry out reconciliations: bank, inter-company, GL-to-sub-ledger, vendor and customer balances.
F Book provisions, accruals and prepayments; reverse in subsequent periods.
F Coordinate with auditors; provide records for timely annual audit completion.
II. Statutory Compliance:
F Compute, deduct and remit TDS, GST, PF, Professional Tax and other statutory dues personally. Prepare and file returns: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, TDS/TCS, PT, PF challans, etc.
F Maintain records and documentation for statutory and audit requirements.
F Monitor regulatory changes; update internal processes and coordinate action.
III. Budget Preparation & Monitoring:
F Coordinate with academic and administrative departments; consolidate the annual operating and capital budget.
F Present consolidated budget to Management with analysis of key assumptions.
F Track actuals vs. budget; prepare variance reports with explanations.
IV. Cash Flow Management:
F Prepare weekly/monthly cash flow forecasts tracking fee collections and payment commitments.
F Monitor inflows and outflows; flag variances or shortfalls to the Management.
F Coordinate with banks to ensure sufficient funds for remittances, payments and payroll.
F Align collection schedules and payment timelines with available liquidity
V. Accounts Payable:
F Verify invoices personally: three-way matching (PO, GRN, invoice), GL coding and approvals.
F Compute and deduct TDS at applicable rates; remit within statutory timelines.
F Process domestic and foreign vendor payments per approved procedures.
F Perform vendor balance reconciliations; follow up on outstanding or aged items.
6. Import & Export Finance & Trade Operations
F Handle end-to-end accounting and documentation for cross-border transactions, including commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, and bills of entry.
F Manage banking instruments including Letters of Credit (LC), Bank Guarantees (BG), foreign remittances, and export proceeds realization (EDPMS/IDPMS).
F Accurately account for and reconcile import duties, customs charges, freight, insurance, and other landed costs.
F Track foreign currency (forex) transactions, revaluations, and exchange rate fluctuations/adjustments.
F Coordinate with Custom House Agents (CHA), freight forwarders, and shipping lines.
7 Financial Systems, Projects & Stakeholder Coordination
F Post accounting entries and maintain financial records in SAP FI&MM and related systems.
F Support financial transition for New School Project; establish requisite processes and controls.
F Coordinate with the Trust, RIL systems, vendors, auditors and statutory authorities.
8 Human Resources (HR) & Payroll
F Oversee monthly salary computation, attendance/leave integration, and wage disbursements.
F Manage employee PF/ESI registrations, contractor/labor laws, and full-and-final (F&F) settlements.
F Handle onboarding documentation, personal file maintenance, and grievance resolution support.
9. Other Responsibilities
F Any other duties as assigned by the Senior Management or Board.

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or a related field or relevant certifications (e.g., CA (Inter), CMA or MBA in Finance is preferred with experience 6-10 years of relevant experience in Finance, HR, Accounts and Compliance in an Manufacturing Industry is preferred.
2. Must have personally performed accounts closing, statutory filings, budgeting, cash flow preparation and AP processing – not just overseen these functions.
3. Prior team coordination experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite.
4. Strong working knowledge of accounting principles, Income Tax (TDS), GST, PF and PT provisions.
5. Hands-on experience with SAP FI&MM; proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
6. Meticulous attention to detail; ability to manage deadlines and communicate effectively with stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Owns NSX-T design validation and migration execution, including logical switching, distributed routing, and Tier-0/Tier-1 gateway cutover, for VCF9 migration waves.
Leads network cutover activities during migration waves typically the critical path sequencing cutover windows in coordination with the Senior Migration Engineer and Migration Architect.
Monitors tickets, responses, and resolutions for network events tied to migration waves; gathers and analyzes bandwidth and NSX flow data.
Documents scheduled maintenances, network topologies, NSX segment/gateway configurations, and connectivity mappings in the designated tool.
Opens service requests to vendors for hardware/software problems; works with Service Providers for proper handling of outages, maintenances, or other problems during cutover windows.
Communicates cutover status and network risk to customers and the Migration Coordinator/PMO via tickets, emails, and calls.
Ensures NSX and network alerts are detected, acknowledged, and resolved in a timely manner during and after cutover.
Documents planned and unplanned network events and changes; follows change and escalation processes for unique, complex, or critical network cutover changes and customer outages.
Validates rollback readiness for network cutover activities in partnership with the QA/Validation Engineer.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced API Automation Tester with 5-10 years of experience in API Testing, Automation Testing, and Selenium Automation. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in designing and implementing automation frameworks, validating REST/SOAP APIs, and ensuring end-to-end quality of web applications through robust test automation solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain API automation test frameworks and scripts.
Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Validate RESTful and SOAP APIs using automation tools and frameworks.
Develop and execute automated test scripts using Selenium for web applications.
Create test plans, test cases, and test data for API and UI testing.
Analyze automation test results, identify defects, and track issues through resolution.
Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and product teams.
Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure automation coverage and improve testing efficiency.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous quality improvement.
Required Skills
API Testing
Strong hands-on experience in API Testing.
Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs.
API validation using Postman, Swagger, and automation frameworks.
Knowledge of JSON, XML, and API authentication mechanisms (OAuth, JWT, Basic Auth).
Experience with API automation using Java/Python frameworks.
Automation Testing
Experience in designing and developing automation frameworks.
Strong understanding of Data-Driven, Hybrid, and Keyword-Driven Frameworks.
Experience with TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, or similar frameworks.
Test execution, reporting, and defect management expertise.
Selenium Automation
Hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver.
Page Object Model (POM) Framework implementation.
Cross-browser automation testing.
Handling dynamic web elements and synchronization techniques.
Programming Skills
Java or Python programming experience.
Strong OOP concepts.
Collections, Exception Handling, and Multithreading knowledge.
CI/CD & Version Control
Jenkins / Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
Continuous Integration and Continuous Testing practices.
Database Testing
SQL Queries.
Database validation and backend testing.
Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Preferred Skills
Rest Assured.
Karate Framework.
Playwright automation.
Docker and Kubernetes basics.
Performance testing exposure using JMeter.
Cloud exposure (AWS, Azure).
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
5-10 years of experience in Software Testing and Test Automation.
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Job Description: AEO / SEO / GEO Specialist, Trivitron Digital.ai

Location: Chennai / Mumbai / Bangalore (Onsite only)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 4-8 years

Reports to: Head of Growth / Digital Transformation

About Trivitron Digital.ai (TDAI):
Trivitron Digital.ai is an AI-powered health technology platform. It is a joint venture between Trivitron Healthcare and
ResoHealth. Our products include LIS, RIS, HIS, CRM, LIMS, Claims IQ, peri-operative AI and an AI Health Companion.
Hospitals, diagnostic labs and wellness providers across India, the GCC and emerging markets use them.

The Role:
People now look for information in two places: traditional search engines and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini,
Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. We want TDAI and our customers to be the trusted answer in both. In this role youll
own organic visibility for TDAIs brand and products. Youll also help our hospital, diagnostics and wellness customers grow
their own search and AI visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

1. SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
Own technical, on-page and off-page SEO for TDAI’s websites and product pages
Do keyword research for B2B healthtech terms (e.g., “LIS software India”, “hospital management system UAE”)
and for patient-facing searches made to our customers
Build high-quality backlinks from healthcare, health IT and industry publications in India and the GCC
Run local SEO (Google Business Profile, directories, citations) for multi-location hospital and diagnostic chains
2. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Structure content so it gets picked up for featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice search and AI Overviews
Implement schema markup (MedicalOrganization, Hospital, MedicalTest, FAQ, Product, Organization)
Build FAQ and Q&A content hubs that answer real buyer and patient questions
3. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Track and improve how TDAI and our customers are cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Claude
Build entity authority through Wikipedia/Wikidata, knowledge panels, authoritative mentions, PR and citationworthy
content (research, benchmarks, reports)
Set up prompt-level tracking for brand share-of-voice in AI answers and report on it
4. Customer Growth Services
Audit and improve search and AI visibility for hospital, diagnostics and wellness clients
Create playbooks for doctor profiles, test/package pages, location pages and review management
Connect visibility to business outcomes: appointments, test bookings, leads and footfall
5. Content, Compliance and Collaboration
Work with content, product, clinical and sales teams on content that is accurate and meets E-E-A-T standards
Follow healthcare content norms: medical review, no misleading claims, and data privacy (DPDP Act, UAE regulations)
Track and report on rankings, organic traffic, AI citations, DA/DR, leads and conversions

What You Bring:
4–8 years in SEO, with hands-on exposure to AEO/GEO or AI search visibility
Experience in healthcare, healthtech, diagnostics, hospitals or B2B SaaS (strongly preferred)
Strong command of Ahrefs/SEMrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and schema tools
Familiarity with AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, Otterly, Peec AI, or your own tracking methods)
Working knowledge of HTML, structured data, site architecture and CMS platforms (WordPress, headless CMS)
Excellent written English; regional languages or Arabic are a plus
A proven track record of moving rankings, traffic and leads, with case studies to show

KPIs:
Organic traffic and qualified leads from search
Rankings for priority keywords (India and GCC)
Brand mentions and citations in AI answer engines
Featured snippets and AI Overview inclusions
DA/DR and growth in high-quality backlinks
Measurable visibility gains for customer accounts

Responsible for proactively soliciting and managing large group/catering related opportunities with significant revenue potential.
Manages group/catering opportunities not handled by an Event Booking Center (EBC).
Actively up-sells each business opportunity to maximize revenue opportunity.
Achieves personal and team related revenue goals.
Verifies business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery.
Responsible for driving customer/guest loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer/guest experience.
Provides service to customers in order to grow the account on behalf of the company.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Understanding Market Opportunities Driving Revenue
- Targets group/catering accounts, markets, or segments with heavy emphasis on proactive solicitation and account saturation.
- Partners with group/catering counterpart to effectively manage the business opportunity.
- Responds to incoming group/catering opportunities for the property that are outside parameters of the .
- Handles all opportunities if property does not participate in an EBC.
- Identifies, qualifies and solicits new group/catering business to achieve personal and each property s revenue goals.
- Focuses efforts on group/catering accounts with significant potential sales revenue.
- Develops effective group/catering sales plans and actions.
- Designs, develops and sells creative catered events.
- Maximizes revenue by upselling packages and creative food and beverage.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for each property based on market conditions and individual property needs.
- Uses negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close on business and negotiate contracts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Handles complex business with significant revenue potential as well as significant customer expectations.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings.
Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for group/catering sales opportunities.
- Supports brand s Service and Relationship Strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Provides excellent customer service in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes brand s Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Executes and supports the business Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.
- Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
- Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the property and brand.
- Gains understanding of the property s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.
Building Successful Relationships
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (eg, , Market Sales, Strategic Accounts) to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Uses sales resources and administrative/support staff.
Additional Responsibilities
- Utilizes intranet for resources and information.
- Conducts site inspections.
- Creates contracts as required.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (eg, generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and executing purchasing strategies, including supplier selection, negotiation, and contract management, to ensure supply chain stability and cost-effectiveness. As a Purchasing Manager / Assistant Purchasing Manager, you re not just overseeing the purchasing process - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Diploma or degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Hospitality, or related field
Minimum 5 years of purchasing or procurement experience, preferably in a hotel or hospitality environment
Proven ability to source, negotiate, and manage supplier relationships to ensure quality and cost-efficiency
Strong understanding of inventory management, stock control, and procurement systems
Experience in budgeting, cost analysis, and tracking purchasing performance
Familiarity with local procurement regulations, health and safety standards, and sustainability practices
Highly organized with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing operational needs
Ensure that purchasing activities comply with relevant laws, regulations and company policies and uphold the hotels ethical standards.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Oversee procurement operations: Manage purchasing and inventory of general merchandise to ensure adequate stock levels
Align with internal stakeholders: Collaborate with the Chef and hotel management to align purchases with hotel needs and specifications
Manage supplier relationships: Secure competitive pricing, place orders, and ensure timely delivery of goods
Ensure quality control: Review shipments to confirm products meet order specifications, grade, and quality standards
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment
Risk Management: To identify and manage supply chain risks, including supply disruptions, price volatility, and compliance issues.
Market Analysis: A comprehensive grasp of market trends and the capacity to anticipate price shifts and supply dynamics to inform prudent purchasing decisions.

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Customer Support Associate for the Cross Border. The role involves shipment tracking, customer coordination, issue resolution, SLA monitoring, and operational support for international shipments across Saver and Express services. The candidate will work closely with operations, carriers, clients, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth shipment movement and enhanced customer experience.

Coordinate with operations, hubs, carriers, and last-mile teams for shipment updates.
Handle customer queries related to shipment status, delays, exceptions, and delivery concerns.
Ensure timely resolution of escalations and customer complaints.
Monitor SLA adherence and highlight ageing or delayed shipments.
Maintain accurate records of shipment activities and customer interactions.
Verify shipment documentation and support compliance requirements.
Share daily operational reports and exception trackers with stakeholders.
Coordinate with internal teams for reattempts, appointment deliveries, and shipment recovery.
Support newly onboarded clients with process coordination and issue handling.
Identify process gaps and suggest operational improvements.
Required Skills:
Good communication and coordination skills.
Basic understanding of logistics and supply chain operations.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good knowledge of MS Excel and reporting.
Customer-centric approach with attention to detail.

Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.

Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
- Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Main Purpose of Job:

To manage the Noodle or Chocolate Manufacturing lines of the factory with regard to Electrical & Automation Maintenance and ensuring No unplanned downtime. Supply (may include in-house generation) and distribution of electricity to ensure that it is at all times safe, reliable, secure and sustainable. It covers low, medium and high voltage installations. Provide factory/site engineering with the required competence on Factory Automation System (FAS), Process Control System and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to effectively support manufacturing operational activities and continuously improve manufacturing performance. The role has a shared responsibility of tasks together with production, warehouse, QA and auxiliary services etc to ensure full requirement and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Management responsibilities:
Define, propose and monitor the plans and objectives of the electrical team in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles and the Electricity & Automation Manufacturing Execution System (E&AMES) Activity as outlined in the Nestl Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
Propose and implement work processes, procedures and technical resources relating to the electrical & automation team.
Lead and coordinate the electrical & automation team and maintain competencies, motivation and performance to achieve the teams mission and objectives.
Propose and control the electrical & automation component of the site M&I budget and any capital projects.
Propose and monitor electricity in accordance with the key performance indicators.
Demonstrate and promote the company's values within the electrical & automation team.
Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.

2. Functional responsibilities:
Ensuring line availability / healtiness of high-speed manufacturing lines and ensuring highest level of efficiency and performance from the lines. Ensure that all personnel performing electrical & automation related activities are legally trained and certified. Question the impact on product safety/quality, people safety and environmental during execution of any activity.
Ensure at all times the technical integrity/performance of the electrical energy supply and distribution.
Ensure at all times safe installations and operations through proper design, protection systems, procedures and training.
Liase with the site Safety Officer on electrical & automation matters relating to safety, electricity distribution, energy conservation, legal compliance, complaints etc.
Coordinate with Production, Quality Management and Engineering to resolve any electrical & automation issues.
Supervise and coordinate electrical & automation maintenance and project work by electricians, automation technicians and contractors.
Ensure proper management of electrical & automation documents (manuals, diagrams, instrument data sheet, software packages/licenses) through efficient filing and archiving procedures. Manage the capturing of electrical energy related information and the distribution of this information to the required stakeholder.

3. Maintenance and Improvement of electrical & automation assets.
Execute the maintenance of the electrical & automation equipment in accordance with the Nestl Maintenance Strategy using Consequence Driven Maintenance (CDM) as the multi-disciplined approach to proactively maintain/improve the fixed assets and Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM) as the process to manage the asset lifecycle. Adopt the Maintenance Excellence vision by striving for the M&I "Proactive Domain".Monitor plant and equipment to ensure optimal operation and reduction of planned and unplanned downtime. Develop and implement maintenance and inspection plans to ensure reliability, sustainability and security of electrical distribution infrastructure. Ensure technical integrity and performance of automation equipment.

4. Installation of new electrical & automation assets
Ensure that the justification, request for approval and reporting are in line with the Guidelines for Capital Investment. Ensure that new installations are designed with a high degree of flexibility to better enable the operations to adjust to a changing environment keeping in mind safety and the issues relating to the environment. Facilitate the introduction and implementation of new technologies in coordination with local, market, central technical and PTC engineering.

5. Continuous Improvement
Initiate and drive Continuous Improvement (CI) in electricity supply and distribution with the aim of achieving optimised plant performance. Ensure that all members of the team play an active role in assisting the client in improving the energy usage and reducing waste across the site through continual improvement initiatives.

Description:
Job description

About the Role

We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.

What Youll Do

Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What Were Looking For

0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?

Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.

If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.

Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.

Customer-first mindset with focus on scalability and automation

Description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a reliable, experienced and well-organised General Administration & Accounts Executive to join our team in Goa. The role involves managing day-to-day accounting, bookkeeping, banking and general business administration, while providing support in HR, office administration and operational management.

Candidates with prior accounting or finance experience in the hotel, restaurant, hospitality or food industry will be preferred. The ideal candidate should be detail-oriented, trustworthy, capable of working independently and interested in building a long-term career with the organisation.

On-site (Office-based) Margao, Goa, India

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounts & Bookkeeping

Maintain accurate day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping records.
Handle purchase and sales invoices, expenses, receipts and payments.
Perform bank, supplier and customer reconciliations.
Maintain cash, petty cash and expense records.
Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable.
Monitor outstanding payments and follow up with relevant parties.
Prepare financial information and reports for management, accountants and auditors.
Support budgeting, cost control and financial administration.
Maintain organised accounting records and supporting documentation.
Assist with accounting and cost management activities related to hotel, restaurant and food business operations.

2. Banking & Financial Administration

Assist with routine banking activities and payment processing.
Maintain payment records and supporting documents.
Coordinate with banks, accountants, suppliers and external service providers.
Ensure financial and administrative tasks are completed accurately and within deadlines.

3. HR & Office Administration

Maintain employee documentation, attendance, leave records and personnel files.
Assist with recruitment, onboarding and employee documentation.
Maintain employment contracts, company records and other confidential documents.
Coordinate office administration and routine operational requirements.
Support management with general HR and administrative activities.

4. General Business & Management Support

Provide administrative support across the company's food, hospitality and IT businesses.
Maintain organised records, schedules, reports and administrative systems.
Coordinate and follow up with employees, suppliers and external parties to ensure timely completion of tasks.
Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and work independently with minimal supervision.
Help develop and maintain efficient administrative processes and internal controls.
Handle confidential company, employee and financial information responsibly.
Take on additional responsibilities across administration, accounts and business operations as the role develops.

Candidate Requirements

Previous professional experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance administration or business administration is required.
Practical knowledge of accounting procedures, financial records and reconciliations.
Experience in hotel, restaurant, hospitality or food-sector accounting will be strongly preferred.
Relevant qualification in Accounting, Commerce, Finance or Business Administration is desirable.
Good working knowledge of accounting software, MS Excel, Google Sheets and standard office applications.
Excellent written and spoken English and Hindi.
Strong organisational, coordination and follow-up skills.
High attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when handling financial information.
Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
Trustworthy, disciplined, practical and resourceful, with a strong sense of responsibility.
Willingness to support multiple business functions and build a long-term career with the organisation.
Candidates residing in or around Margao, Goa, will be given preference.

What We Offer

Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
Stable, full-time, long-term employment.
Exposure to UK and Indian business operations.
Opportunity to work across food, hospitality and technology businesses.
Direct interaction with senior management.
Opportunities to take on greater responsibility and progress into senior accounts, administration or business management roles.

Joining: Immediate.

Description:
Entry level management position that is responsible for leading and assisting with the successful completion of daily shift requirements.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Strives to ensure guest and employee satisfaction and achieve the operating budget.
Assists in completing ficial and administrative responsibilities.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supports all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Coaches, counsels and encourages employees.
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Supports all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Front Desk Manager.
- Guides daily Front Desk shift operations.
- Communicates performance expectations to employees in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Monitoring and Supporting Progress Toward Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Participates in department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Trains staff on adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and property occupancy.
- Understands the impact of Front Desk operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implementing the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Ensures employees have the proper supplies and uniforms.
- Assists in the use of a guest information tracking system to ensure that a successful repeat guest recognition program is in use to recognize guest preferences and aid in problem resolution.
Supporting Handling of Human Resource Activities
- Identifying the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Providing guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Provides feedback to individuals based on observation of service behaviors.
- Participates in an ongoing employee recognition program.
- Conducts training when appropriate.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updating the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Understands the functions of the Bell Staff, Switchboard and Concierge/Guest Services operations.
- Complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.

Description:
The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Beyond acquisition, this role owns account health during the critical first two months post-onboarding, setting the foundation for long-term retention and growth.
1. Lead Funnel Management & New Client Acquisition
Identify, qualify, and pursue SME and B2B prospects.
Maintain a healthy lead pipeline across stages: Prospect Qualified Proposal Negotiation Closed
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospect shipping volumes, pain points, and service requirements
Present customized logistics proposals including pricing, SLAs, and VAS offerings
Coordinate with operations and pricing teams to ensure commercially viable deal structures
Achieve monthly targets for new client activations and revenue from new accounts
2. Client Onboarding
Lead end-to-end onboarding for newly signed clients including system setup, account configuration, and first-shipment coordination
Conduct a formal onboarding kick-off call within 48 hours of contract signing
Share onboarding documentation: SOPs, escalation matrices, rate cards, and tracking portals
Coordinate with operations, IT, and customer service teams to ensure smooth Day 1 experience
Monitor first 10 shipments closely flag TAT breaches, address NDR issues, and resolve any documentation gaps
Schedule a Week 2 and Week 4 check-in call to review initial performance data and client satisfaction
3. Account Stabilization & Growth
Conduct a formal Month 1 performance review with each new client covering delivery rates, TAT compliance, and delay metrics
Identify opportunities to improve shipment volumes and client engagement.
Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Ensure the account is stabilized and positioned for long-term growth and retention.
Hand over the account to the Account Management team with complete documentation and a smooth transition.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will be responsible for managing the daily operations of the front office, housekeeping, and guest services teams, and ensuring overall room division efficiency. As a Rooms Division Manager, you re not just overseeing day-to-day rooms division operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. As a Rooms Division Manager, you re not just overseeing day-to-day rooms division operations - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Proven experience in a senior hotel management role, ideally as a Room Division Manager or similar position.
Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire staff.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a guest-focused approach.
Strong knowledge of front office, housekeeping, and guest services operations.
Proficiency in hotel property management systems (PMS) and financial reporting.
Proficiency in English; additional languages are a plus.
Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Oversee front office operations: Manage front desk functions, including check-in/out, guest relations, and conflict resolution
Manage housekeeping operations: Oversee daily room assignments, monitor cleaning performance through inspections, and ensure readiness of guest rooms
Deliver guest service excellence: Ensure high-quality, consistent guest experiences by upholding brand standards and resolving issues with creativity, discretion, and sound judgment
Oversee service operations: Ensure Front Office and Housekeeping systems and procedures support exceptional service, smooth check-in/check-out, and room readiness
Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Description:
Responsible for the daily shift operations of Housekeeping, Recreation/Health Club and, if applicable, Laundry.
Directs and works with employees to ensure property guestrooms, public space and employee areas are clean and well maintained.
Completes inspections and holds people accountable for corrective action.
Position assists in ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the housekeeping or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Housekeeping Operations
- Ensures guest room status is communicated to the Front Desk in a timely and efficient manner.
- Works effectively with the Engineering department on guestroom maintece needs.
- Supervises the property general cleaning schedule.
- Obtains list of rooms to be cleaned immediately and list of prospective check-outs or discharges to prepare work assignments.
- Inventories stock to ensure adequate supplies.
- Supervises daily Housekeeping shift operations and ensures compliance with all housekeeping policies, standards and procedures.
- Assists in the ordering of guestroom supplies, cleaning supplies and uniforms.
- Supports and supervises an effective inspection program for all guestrooms and public space.
- Communicates areas that need attention to staff and follows up to ensure understanding.
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
Managing Departmental Costs
- Participates in the management of the department s controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Comprehends budgets, operating statements and payroll progress reports as needed to assist in the ficial management of department.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Participates as needed in the investigation of employee accidents.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs, and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Uses all available on the job training tools to train new room attendants and provide follow-up training as necessary.
- Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Accountable for overall success of the daily kitchen operations.
Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions.
Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maximizing the ficial performance in all areas of responsibility.
Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced.
Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports.
Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved.
Areas of responsibility comprise overseeing all food preparation areas (eg, banquets, room service, restaurants, bar/lounge and employee cafeteria) and all support areas (eg, dish room and purchasing).
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Leading Kitchen Operations for Property
- Leads kitchen management team.
- Provides direction for all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence or determine appropriate replacement to fill gaps.
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Demonstrate new cooking techniques and equipment to staff.
Setting and Maintaining Goals for Culinary Function and Activities
- Develops and implements guidelines and control procedures for purchasing and receiving areas.
- Establishes goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.
- Manages department controllable expenses including food cost, supplies, uniforms and equipment.
- Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
- Knows and implements the brands safety standards.
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Provides direction for menu development.
- Monitors the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation certifications.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
- Trains kitchen associates on the fundamentals of good cooking and excellent plate presentations.
- Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.
- Interacts with the Banquet Chef and Catering department on training regarding food knowledge and menu composition.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and or managers.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for areas of responsibility.
- Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to executive teams, managers and supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Your Role
As an Inside Sales professional, you'll own the end-to-end sales cyclefrom prospecting to closure. You'll engage with businesses across industries, understand their logistics challenges, and help them leverage Delhivery's solutions to drive growth. Every successful conversion contributes directly to expanding our customer base and strengthening India's logistics network.
Key Responsibilities
Engage with inbound and outbound prospects to identify business opportunities.
Conduct consultative sales conversations to understand customer requirements.
Deliver product and dashboard demonstrations tailored to client needs.
Manage the complete sales cycle, from first interaction to deal closure.
Consistently achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.
What We're Looking For
Required
6 months to 2 years of experience in Inside Sales or Business Development.
Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data for better sales outcomes.
Preferred
Experience in logistics, supply chain, or e-commerce.
Exposure to SMB or mid-market sales.
Based in Goa or willing to relocate.
Why Delhivery?
Accelerate your career with structured growth opportunities.
Competitive salary with attractive performance incentives.
Work from Goa while building a high-growth career.
Thrive in a culture that values ownership, accountability, and innovation.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

The Sales Manager - Logistics Services is responsible for driving new business acquisition through structured lead funnel management while ensuring a high-quality onboarding experience for new SME and B2B clients. Resolve operational issues by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
