Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International
Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You assist in planning, developing and execution of capital projects, technical development, feasibility perspectives of engineering-related activities in the supply chain and capital-expense project execution to support growth, world-class manufacturing and productivity with the highest level of quality, safety and environmental requirements. You help ensure sure that Mondel z business and innovation processes in project management and Mondel z standards in execution are followed.
How you will contribute
The role supports capital project execution, and you will be accountable for the quality of the results and execution of capital projects using Mondel z standards, and business and innovation processes in project management. You will help define and deliver the capital and technical agenda during the development phase of capital investments with stakeholders so that accurate budgets, plans and fit-for-purpose technical solutions are provided and develop the capital budget according to the contract and forecast cash flow. You will also help ensure that applicable engineering developments and standards are properly implemented, and support the development and implementation of state-of-the-art processes and equipment strategies to optimize resources, harmonize assets and rollout best practices.
What you will bring
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
Engineering or operations
Working effectively and under pressure to meet deadlines
Analysis
Project management
More about this role
Lead the electrical and automation engineering project a the site, ensuring reliable, safe, and efficient execution of all electrical systems and automation system for new capacity expansion.

What you need to know about this position:
Experience
5-6 years of progressive experience in electrical and automation engineering within a manufacturing environment (FMCG/food beverage preferred).
PLC / SCADA
Strong knowledge of PLC programming (Rockwell / Siemens), SCADA/HMI design, industrial networking (Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus TCPIP), and instrumentation. Shall have sound knowledge of batch processes and Pack-ML Standards.
Electrical
Solid understanding of power distribution, motor control, and electrical protection systems. MCC panels and Drives.
Instrumentation
Good knowledge of instruments, selection, and Calibration processes, including legal meteorology.
Digital and Cybersecurity
Digital mindset, familiar with Digital applications for factory operations.
OT infrastructure - Networks, Network management, Server, Virtual Environment, Cybersecurity tools and Secure Remote access tools.
Process and Equipment Safety.
Hands-on knowledge of Process Safety and Equipment Safety Standards (SIL and PL). To design and validate the safety of the equipment and processes.
Leadership
Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams in a fast-paced operational setting.
Project Mgmt
Experience managing capital projects (>$500K electrical/automation scope).
Communication
Ability to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders; strong written and verbal English.

Education / Certifications:
Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.

Job specific requirements:
Electrical Systems
Own the design, BOQ preparation, installation, commissioning, all electrical systems across for new capacity expansion Plant projects.
Ensure compliance with local electrical codes, MDLZ engineering standards, and relevant safety regulations (e.g., NFPA 70E, IEC, local statutory requirements).
Automation for plant projects
Design and implementation of automation and control systems, including PLCs (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, etc.), SCADA/HMI, VFDs, servo drives, instrumentation, and industrial networks for new capacity expansion.
Support in plant digital manufacturing roadmaps.
Project Delivery
Lead electrical and automation scope for capital projects - from concept and design through FAT/SAT, installation, commissioning, and handover.
Manage external contractors, system integrators, and OEMs to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to specification.
Prepare and manage project budgets, schedules, and risk registers for the EA scope.
People Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop a team of electrical and automation technicians/engineers.
Build technical capability through structured training, mentoring, and skills-gap assessments.
Foster a culture of safety, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
Coordinate with Site Automation team, SSAL and the Electrical Maintenance team for project shutdown and integration planning.
Safety Compliance
Champion electrical safety practices, including lockout/tagout (LOTO), arc-flash risk assessments, and safe work permits.
Ensure all electrical and automation work complies with MDLZ Global Engineering Standards, local regulations, and insurance requirements.
Maintain up-to-date electrical single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and automation documentation.

Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.

The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. Job Description
Head Maintenance & Utility - Baddi Plant

Internally, the role is designated as Site Maintenance and Utilities Lead responsible for driving plant maintenance excellence, equipment reliability, preventive and predictive maintenance, utilities management, and the Progressive Maintenance (PM) pillar under our IL6S framework.

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

ROLE PURPOSE
As a member of the Plant Leadership Team (PLT), the Progressive Maintenance & Utilities Lead will lead the Progressive Maintenance (PM) Pillar within the Integrated Lean Six Sigma (IL6S) framework and drive the plants journey towards a Zero Breakdown Culture.

This role is responsible for building maintenance capability, improving equipment reliability, strengthening utilities performance, driving energy efficiency, and embedding world-class maintenance practices across the plant .

The role is focused on coaching, capability building, and technical leadership rather than day-to-day maintenance execution.

Your goal will be to ensure that the site manufacturing & support activities, without interruption, without any facilities shortages and/or any issues thereof. You will achieve 100% compliance to Local legal regulations, Quality, Health Safety & Environment management systems and standards. You are responsible for the management and maintenance of site facilities, buildings and equipment(s) (hardware & software).

How you will contribute

You will:
Works cross functionally to develop and implement a strategic Facilities road-map and annual operating plan which is a competitive advantage to Mondel z. Partner with internal & external stakeholders and service providers to define and meet Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Sustainability, Engagement goals. Establish a strong governance to review & control Operational performance and continuous Improvement plan to deliver against best in class both internally and externally.
Lead and be accountable that Building Maintenance program, Facilities maintenance program capabilities, including maintenance repairs & overall operations are in place. Accountable to insure adherence to business continuity plan, manufacturing standards government regulations are understood by all employees/services providers at the site, regularly reviewed and monitored for effective implementation.
Provide leadership, coaching to Facilities team towards implementation of IL6S-Integrated Lean 6 sigma ways of working: delivering zero breakdowns via preventive/predictive maintenance strategies and technical mastery of maintenance and operation teams; PM (Progressive Maintenance) Pillar, and CBM (condition based monitoring), Visual controls & tools Mgmt., Lubrication mgmt. & Calibration of equipment(s) etc.
Role model Values and principles through effective coaching, mentoring and builds skills capability across the Plant technical/engineering team to engage with latest modern practices. Have a clear people succession and resource plan, for the asset & technology population , identifying and implementing critical levers to attract, retain and develop critical talent
Interface with key stakeholders internally and externally to develop and maintain effective relationships, align priorities in order to deliver the company objectives, and goals.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

Strong operational & manufacturing leadership experience in CPG industry with experience in TPM-Total productive maintenance, 5s, LEAN, 6 sigma tools and concepts, Safety & GMP standards
An Engineer with a strong financial & business acumen, project management skills and Knowledge of industrial maintenance and manufacturing equipment, PM (Progressive Maintenance) expertise, Spare parts management, SAP PM module end user knowledge, Technology & Engineering automation basics.
Excellent communication (verbal & written), coaching, and leadership skills in a team-based environment. Demonstrated abilities in Analytics, problem solving and team building


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Progressive Maintenance Leadership
Lead the Progressive Maintenance Pillar and drive equipment reliability across the plant.
Establish and sustain preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance practices.
Drive breakdown elimination and continuous improvement initiatives.

Capability Building
Develop maintenance capability across engineering and operations teams.
Coach technical leaders and strengthen organizational expertise in reliability and maintenance excellence.
Support capability transfer through Autonomous Maintenance initiatives.

Reliability & Operational Excellence
Improve equipment availability, maintenance effectiveness, and operational performance.
Lead root cause analysis and drive sustainable corrective actions.
Improve key reliability metrics including OEE, MTBF, and MTTR.

Plant Leadership
Own maintenance and infrastructure budgets.
Support capital projects, plant expansions, and equipment investments.
Provide technical expertise to improve future plant design and asset reliability

Technical & Utilities Governance
Provide leadership across maintenance, utilities, electrical, instrumentation, and automation functions.
Ensure reliable and efficient operation of critical plant infrastructure and utility systems.
Support modernization, automation, and reliability improvement initiatives.

Safety, Compliance & Sustainability
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and environmental requirements.
Drive energy optimization and sustainability initiatives across the site.
Champion safe maintenance practices and technical governance

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Reduced equipment breakdowns and downtime.
Improved reliability, maintenance effectiveness, and plant performance.
Strong PM Pillar maturity within the IL6S framework.
Improved utility reliability and energy efficiency.
Enhanced technical capability across the organization.
Best-in-class safety and compliance performance
IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE
Bachelors Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Electronics, or Industrial Engineering.
10+ years of experience in Maintenance, Reliability, Engineering, or Plant Technical Operations.
Strong hands-on maintenance foundation with progression into maintenance leadership roles.
Experience working within Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Integrated Lean Six Sigma (IL6S), or similar operational excellence frameworks.
Proven track record of driving reliability improvements, capability building, and maintenance excellence in highly automated manufacturing environments. Strong leadership, coaching, stakeholder management, and systems-thinking capabilities.

WHY JOIN
This is a high-impact Plant Leadership Team role offering the opportunity to shape maintenance strategy , influence plant-wide performance, build technical capability , and drive world-class reliability and operational excellence

Job Description Senior Manager (Civil)

Business Unit: Auro Textiles Fabric Division
Grade: Senior Manager, M3
Reporting To: Unit Head
Place of Posting: Baddi, Himachal Pradesh

1. Primary Role

To oversee civil maintenance and infrastructure management across all Fabric Division units, including factory buildings, residential colonies, utilities, and other civil structures. The role also involves planning and execution of Greenfield and Brownfield projects, ensuring timely completion, cost control, quality standards, structural integrity, and compliance with safety procedures.

2. Roles and Responsibilities

1. Oversee repair and maintenance of factory buildings, residential facilities, roads, drainage systems, water supply lines, sewerage systems, and other civil infrastructure.
2. Conduct periodic inspections of civil structures, roofs, flooring, plaster, ceilings, and other building components to ensure structural stability and timely maintenance.
3. Assess the feasibility of new buildings, machine foundations, and modifications to existing structures, including preparation of drawings, proposals, cost estimates, and BOQs.
4. Prepare annual revenue and capital budgets, monitor expenditure, control costs, and ensure effective utilisation of resources.
5. Review material requirements, verify quantities, and approve purchase indents as per organisational procedures.
6. Monitor construction projects for progress, budget, quality, and adherence to approved specifications and timelines.
7. Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, contractors, and internal departments to resolve technical and site-related issues.
8. Verify job approvals, contractor bills, work measurements, and supporting documents in accordance with organisational SOPs.
9. Ensure compliance with safety standards and prescribed procedures during civil maintenance and construction activities.
10. Maintain records of drawings, estimates, BOQs, approvals, completed jobs, and associated costs.
11. Lead and guide civil officers, supervisors, and supporting staff, while addressing team grievances and ensuring effective service delivery.
12. Provide land, building, and infrastructure-related information to internal departments, CPPD, and the Estate Office as required.

3. Essential Qualifications and Experience

- Relevant qualification in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
- Proven experience in industrial infrastructure, including Greenfield and Brownfield projects and civil maintenance.
- Hands-on experience in project execution, budgeting, BOQ preparation, cost estimation, and contractor management.
- Knowledge of construction quality standards, safety practices, and infrastructure maintenance.

Description:
Purchase Executive/Sr. Executive - Manufacturing Industry

Supply Chain Management

Procurement to pay activities which includes identification & selection of vendor, sourcing of raw materials, indenting & order generation, order tracking, and payment to the supplier.
Managing supply and demand, by using techniques like Forecasting & other inventory models.
Competitive Advantage, thereby enabling overall Cost reduction & value addition.
Customer (Internal & External) relationship & service management.
Co-ordinating and updating different functional teams for value addition in the services.

Vendor Management

Execution of vendors' selection process.
Establishing proper communication channels and information flow between Internal and External customers.
Maintaining long term relationship with existing & potential vendors.
Performing vendors stratification-classification & consolidation.
Renegotiating existing price contracts, Selection through Comparative statements.
Performing cost & performance benchmarking.

Logistics Management

Cost reduction & service improvement.
Inventory strategy, Location Strategy, Transport Strategy, and Vehicle routing.
Inbound logistics.
Transportation allocation of vehicles for Lifting & Inbound movement of Raw Material.
Procurement logistics, Distribution logistics, Disposal logistics, and Reverse logistics.


Position: Junior Engineer Dispatch
Experience: Minimum 3 Years
Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred

Candidate Profile
Minimum 3 years of experience in Dispatch / Logistics / Stores Operations
Good knowledge of invoicing, stock taking and dispatch documentation
Experience in vehicle coordination and transporter follow-up
Good understanding of inventory and stock management
Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel and ERP systems
Good communication and coordination skills
Ability to work independently and manage daily dispatch activities
Knowledge of Hindi is an added benefit
Immediate joiners preferred
We are looking for a responsible and organized Dispatch professional with good knowledge of dispatch operations, invoicing, stock management and vehicle coordination.

Description:
Job Summary
Ortho Max Mfg Co. Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Manager Domestic to drive sales growth across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in the medical devices or orthopaedic implant industry and will be responsible for developing business opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, and achieving regional sales targets across the assigned territories.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve or exceed regional sales targets.
Identify new business opportunities and expand existing customer relationships across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh.
Conduct market research to stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements.
Build strong relationships with key decision-makers in hospitals, clinics, trauma centres, and healthcare institutions.
Schedule product demonstrations, surgeon meetings, training sessions, and provide technical support as required.
Address customer complaints or issues promptly and professionally to ensure customer satisfaction.
Analyse market dynamics to identify potential growth opportunities within the assigned territories.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Product Development, and Operations, to align sales strategies with company objectives.
Consistently achieve and exceed assigned sales targets.
Track sales performance, prepare periodic reports, and identify areas for improvement.
Develop and implement strategies to increase market share throughout the assigned region.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory and company requirements related to sales activities.
Drive customer satisfaction and build long-term business relationships.
Manage distributor and dealer networks within the assigned territories, where applicable.
Experience & Qualifications
Bachelor s Degree in Engineering, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related field.
3 4 years of proven sales experience in the Medical Devices or Orthopaedic Implant industry (preferred).
Strong understanding of the healthcare industry, particularly Orthopaedics and Trauma Care.
Demonstrated track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
Proficiency in Hindi is essential. Knowledge of Punjabi is preferred. Familiarity with regional languages is an added advantage.
Willingness to travel extensively across Punjab, Rajasthan, and Himachal Pradesh.
Strong leadership, planning, and territory management capabilities.

Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You will be responsible for coordinating and enabling the Site Asset & Technology Leader in driving asset reliability, maintenance, infrastructure and facilities performance to support the delivery of site SQCDSM targets.

The role will focus on ensuring reliable plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure and facilities, while driving effective MRO management, maintenance planning, budget utilization, inventory management and productivity initiatives. You will also ensure uninterrupted site operations through compliance with local legal regulations, Quality, Health, Safety & Environment standards and Mondel z manufacturing requirements.

How You Will Contribute
You will:
Asset, Maintenance & Infrastructure Management
Coordinate the execution of preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance activities for plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure, buildings and facilities.
Drive maintenance of site infrastructure and facilities, ensuring timely execution of preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective actions.
Support asset reliability and loss prevention initiatives to minimize breakdowns, downtime and equipment-related losses.
Implement and sustain IL6S/TPM ways of working, including Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, Condition-Based Monitoring (CBM), lubrication management, calibration, visual controls and loss elimination.
Partner with the PM and operations teams to identify maintenance requirements, validate priorities and ensure timely closure of actions.
MRO & Inventory Management
Manage and track MRO requirements, consumption, availability and inventory, ensuring the right materials are available to support maintenance activities.
Review and validate MRO requirements raised by maintenance/PM teams based on business need, equipment criticality and inventory availability.
Participate in DMS (Daily Management System) routines and translate identified maintenance requirements into appropriate procurement actions.
Coordinate the PR/PO process for MRO requirements, including requirement validation, purchase order creation and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
Monitor MRO spend, consumption and inventory levels to improve cost effectiveness and avoid excess/obsolete inventory.
Coordinate with suppliers/OEMs and service providers to ensure timely delivery of materials and services in line with agreed SLAs.
Budget & Cost Management
Support annual maintenance, MRO, infrastructure and facilities budget planning, including allocation and tracking of spend across various requirements.
Monitor OPEX/M&R and maintenance-related expenditure against budget and identify potential deviations and corrective actions.
Support prioritization of maintenance and infrastructure requirements based on business impact, asset criticality and available budget.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and productivity improvement through effective MRO management, maintenance practices and supplier management.
Productivity & Continuous Improvement
Drive and support MRO productivity projects and cost-saving initiatives focused on reducing maintenance losses, improving asset reliability and optimizing MRO spend.
Identify opportunities for loss elimination and improve maintenance effectiveness through data-driven analysis and structured problem solving.
Apply PDCA, TPM/IL6S and other continuous improvement methodologies to address recurring equipment and maintenance issues.
Capability Building & Stakeholder Management
Coach and support operating and maintenance teams on routine maintenance, equipment care, breakdown prevention and CIL (Cleaning, Inspection & Lubrication) practices.
Support development of technical capability within operating teams and work process owners.
Interface with internal stakeholders including Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, Quality, HSE and Supply Chain, as well as external service providers and OEMs.
Ensure adherence to manufacturing standards, governance, compliance requirements and applicable legal regulations.
What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career, along with the following experience and knowledge:
Experience in plant maintenance, asset management, engineering, facilities, infrastructure or MRO management, preferably within a manufacturing/FMCG environment.
Good understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, asset reliability and maintenance planning.
Knowledge of MRO management, inventory management, procurement processes and supplier/OEM coordination.
Experience in budget planning, cost tracking and OPEX/M&R management.
Understanding of TPM/IL6S, Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, CBM, loss elimination and PDCA-based problem solving.
Ability to evaluate and validate maintenance/MRO requirements and coordinate the DMS requirement validation PR/PO execution cycle.
Experience in driving or supporting productivity, cost-saving or continuous improvement projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and track performance.
Computer proficiency, including MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with experience in ERP systems such as SAP or similar platforms.
Strong communication, collaboration, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Ability to coordinate multiple priorities across maintenance, MRO, infrastructure, facilities, inventory and budget management.
Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research & Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.
Mondel z International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Coordinate and organize day to day operations of the department including planning and controlling
Manage the development and implementation of departmental standards
Ensure all patrolling, inspections and escort duties are performed with a high standard

Description:
1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.
India Nippon Electricals is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the design, development, and implementation of innovative electrical solutions for automotive applications. The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading projects from concept through to completion, ensuring that all engineering deliverables meet quality, reliability, and performance standards.

The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills

Location: Chennai, Pondicherry, Erode
Role Purpose
The Customer Service Officer (Internship Trainee) will be responsible for managing customer service operations for unsecured lending products while undergoing structured rotational training across service desk, complaint management, regulatory grievance handling, and quality functions.
The role is designed to build a strong compliance-oriented, customer-centric operations leader for future managerial responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities
1. Service Desk Operations
Handle inbound customer interactions related to loan applications, disbursement, EMI servicing, foreclosure, and account queries
Ensure high First Call Resolution (FCR) and adherence to defined Turnaround Time (TAT)
Maintain accurate call documentation in CRM/system
Deliver consistent customer experience aligned with company standards
Register and track customer complaints in the system
Maintain proper documentation for audit and inspection purposes
2. Regulatory & Compliance Adherence
Strict adherence to RBI guidelines and internal policies
Ensure zero tolerance toward mis-leading information or incorrect commitments
Maintain audit-ready documentation of customer communication
Escalate sensitive cases to Nodal / Grievance Officer as per defined escalation matrix
3. Customer Experience & Process Improvement
Identify recurring service gaps and suggest corrective actions
Support implementation of process improvement initiatives
Contribute to service quality enhancement programs

Training & Rotational Exposure (1218 Months)
The InternshipTrainee will undergo structured exposure to:
Service Desk Operations
Welcome Calling
Complaint Desk & Escalation Handling
Regulatory Grievance Management
Quality & Training Function
MIS & Process Governance
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
First Call Resolution (FCR)
Average Handling Time (AHT)
Complaint TAT Compliance
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Audit & Compliance Score
Zero Regulatory Deviations
Qualification
Graduate (MBA in Finance / Operations / Marketing preferred)
02 years of relevant experience (Fresh MBA candidates may apply)
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Analytical and problem-solving ability
Customer-centric approach
Compliance-driven mindset
Ability to handle pressure and escalations professionally
Working knowledge of CRM systems

Description:
What you ll do:
Lead and manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of both MV Switchgear portfolios.
"- - Define and execute R&D strategies for component development across MV Switchgear aligned with business objectives and product technology roadmaps.

- Supervise VCB design activities for MV Switchgear, including interrupters, linkages, and insulation systems for AIS and GIS environments.

- Utilize DFMEA and reliability engineering methods to strengthen robustness and long-term quality of Switchgear components.
- Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
- Collaborate with suppliers and R&D institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
- Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team, fostering expertise in both MV Switchgear component engineering and building succession pipelines.
- Ability to recruit, recognize and cultivate high performers and expose them in order to create a robust second line of management.
- Assessment criteria of subordinates is performance that leads to planned results.
- Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
- Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
- Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
- Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations.
- Responsible for monitoring and controlling budgets and expenses to achieve the optimum cost efficiency.
- Develop, coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible."

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

To know and develop proficiency in handling internal company software platforms, ie. iCABS, SCP and any other systems that may be introduced.
Must have a good knowledge of the branch territory.
To ensure that the Service Companion usage is maximised for all the service deliveries & should be always above 95%
Organisation of schedule and planning of all service (including contracts, jobbing, call outs, etc.) requirements on a daily, weekly and monthly basis for all technicians within the branch
To ensure that all the service companion devices are active and in use. All the devices should be active 100% at any given point of time
Priority-wise planning of all due for Renewals visits, enquiries, call outs and complaints. Pending visits should be negligible (Service backlogs). Emphasis on "On Time planning
Liaise with the Sales and Service team to best accommodate urgent service visit appointments and communicate changes to affected customers timely.

Manage service documentation and ensure all customer/technician s feedback are followed up with actions
Enter correct (error free) consumption data and TOS in the SCP to ensure command centre account profitability reflects correct data customer wise.
Ensure all service data from dockets, log cards, service orders and other sources is updated accurately into business systems in timely manner
Coordinate with the IT team for new users, device issues etc.
Supports business transition from paper-based to system and digital-based planning, visit documents, whilst upholding documentation integrity. Follow callout process so as to ensure that the complaints are delivered only after raising the ticket
Review service reports with OM, OE and BM and highlight areas of concern critical backlog and weekly trend to manager.
Reviews and provides service compliance updates daily.
Assist & help AOM / OM / Assistant Branch Manager / Branch Manager in monitoring Technician service productivity and efficiency related KPIs
Maintain positive working relationship and effective communication with Sales & Service Colleagues, Supervisor, Technician, Operations staff for any service related issues. Coordinate with Sales for any available slots, time adjustment for new sales scheduling
Work with branch management to correct service areas distributed across the business based on annual revenue from areas, time on site, travel time & routine requirements
Utilise the Route technicians for jobbing only after the route technicians routine services are delivered
Expected to be knowledgeable about company safety policies and safety (SRA) requirements on the job, be able to read and understand company policies
Any unresolved issues should be quickly elevated to the next level of management for prompt resolution
Any other similar duties as and when specified by the manager
  REPORTING
Daily, weekly & monthly (SOS) State of Service for Branch. Residential GSS SOS should also be the priority
Weekly reporting of pending jobs, ageing profiles to ABM/BM
Monthly reporting of technician wise trends.
Maintain State of Service and productivity data per technician
Maintain visibility on complaints received and report on all call outs / critical incidents received from branch.
Annual Leave planning of technicians
Ensure that each technician service productivity is achieved as per set targets
Key Result Areas:
On time service planning with ZERO pending services every month
Monitoring SCP active devices & Usage on weekly basis
Minimum expectancy on SCP active device(100%) & usage >95%
Achieving progressive improvement in State of Service (SOS) and meet SOS targets assigned by the branch
Minimizing service backlog (meet our contractual obligations)
  Competencies (Skills essential to the role):
Be decisive
Attention to details and accuracy
Planning & organizing
Analytical skills
Customer oriented
Negotiation skills
Ability to work patiently in a dynamic service environment
  Educational Qualification / Other Requirement:
Minimum graduation with 1 to 3 years of relevant experience of managing team
Basic computer skills - for reporting/work management (Advanced computer skills would be an added advantage)
Communication - speaking on phone to external customers & internally with technicians, other Operations colleagues.
Knowledge of territory which is handled for planning
Occasional Travel required within the Division
Liaise with the Operations Manager, Operations Executive, Service Supervisors to establish service requirements and provide information, assurance and advice as required
Communicate all service issues in a timely manner to the ABM/BM, Operations Manager

Big7 Solutions is a digital solutions and marketing company that helps businesses grow through creative, technology-driven, and data-focused strategies. We believe in creativity, innovation, and delivering impactful digital experiences that help brands build a strong online presence.

About the Role
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Creative Video Editor with 1-2 years of experience in video editing, motion graphics, and visual storytelling. The ideal candidate should have a strong sense of creativity, understand social media trends, and be able to transform ideas and raw footage into engaging video content.
The candidate should also have basic graphic design skills to support the creation of social media creatives, promotional videos, advertisements, and other digital marketing content.

Key Responsibilities
Edit engaging videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other social media platforms.
Create promotional videos, brand videos, advertisements, and marketing content.
Add transitions, animations, motion graphics, sound effects, and background music to enhance video quality.
Develop creative concepts and visual storytelling approaches for video content.
Create AI-assisted video content using relevant AI tools when required.
Design basic graphics, thumbnails, titles, and other visual assets for digital platforms.
Ensure consistent branding, visual quality, and storytelling across all video content.
Optimise videos for different social media platforms, formats, and aspect ratios.
Collaborate with the design, content, and digital marketing teams to understand project requirements.
Stay updated with video editing techniques, social media trends, and emerging creative tools.
Manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality standards.

Required Skills and Qualifications
12 years of professional experience in video editing and content creation.
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Filmora, CapCut, or similar editing software.
Basic knowledge of graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva.
Understanding of motion graphics, transitions, colour correction, audio synchronisation, and pacing.
Ability to create engaging short-form videos and promotional content.
Familiarity with social media formats, trends, and platform-specific content requirements.
Knowledge of AI video generation and editing tools is an added advantage.
Strong creative thinking, visual storytelling, and attention to detail.
Good time management skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team.
A portfolio showcasing previous video editing and creative projects is preferred.

What We’re Looking For
A creative thinker who can turn ideas into engaging visual content.
Someone who takes initiative and brings fresh ideas to projects.
A candidate who balances creativity with brand consistency and project requirements.
Someone who is eager to learn new tools, techniques, and AI-powered creative workflows.

Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled T24 Developer with 3 to 5 years of experience in Temenos T24/Transact local development, customisation, and integration framework. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in developing and customising T24 applications, implementing business requirements, and integrating T24 with internal and external systems.
The candidate will work closely with functional consultants, business analysts, and technical teams to deliver high-quality banking solutions.

Role & responsibilities
Develop, customise, and maintain Temenos T24/Transact applications based on business requirements.
Work on T24 local development, including routines, versions, enquiries, and application customisations.
Develop and maintain integrations using the T24 Integration Framework and related integration technologies.
Support system integration between T24 and third-party applications, APIs, and other banking systems.
Analyse technical requirements and translate them into effective development solutions.
Perform unit testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and defect resolution.
Support SIT, UAT, deployment, and post-production activities.
Prepare technical documentation and ensure adherence to development standards.
Collaborate with functional, testing, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure timely delivery.
Provide technical support for existing T24 applications and integration interfaces.

Required Skills & Qualifications
3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Temenos T24/Transact development.
Strong experience in T24 local development and customisation.
Practical experience with the T24 Integration Framework and system integration.
Knowledge of T24 development components such as routines, versions, enquiries, and application programming.
Experience with jBASE/jBC and related T24 development tools.
Understanding of integration concepts, APIs, web services, and interface development.
Good knowledge of banking processes and the Temenos T24 application architecture.
Experience in debugging, testing, and resolving technical issues.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred candidate profile
Experience working on T24 implementation, enhancement, or support projects.
Exposure to OFS, SOAP/REST APIs, middleware, and interface monitoring.
Familiarity with source control, release management, and development lifecycle practices.
What We Offer
Competitive salary as per market standards.
Opportunity to work on banking technology and integration projects.
A collaborative and professional work environment.
Opportunities for technical learning and career growth.

Description:
Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced Warehouse Manager who can take full ownership of the warehouse: racking and storage, stock accuracy, dispatch, and the supervisors and workforce. The person who joins must be able to run the operation independently and report to the owner with clear, accurate information.

Key Responsibilities

Racking & Storage
Manage a G+5 pallet racking system with defined bin locations (row, column, level)
Ensure every pallet is put away in the correct bin and the location is recorded accurately
Plan space usage, put-away, and picking to keep the warehouse organized and avoid congestion
Enforce FIFO by batch, production date, and MRP
Ensure safe forklift / reach truck movement and racking load safety

Inventory & Stock Control
Maintain 100% stock accuracy between physical stock and records
Conduct regular cycle counts and month-end physical stock audits
Track good vs. damaged stock and handle damage segregation and reporting
Reconcile stock with client records and resolve differences quickly

Inward & Dispatch
Plan and supervise daily receipts from the factory and dispatches to depots
Coordinate vehicle placement, loading, and documentation without delays
Ensure dispatch accuracy (right SKU, batch, quantity)

People Management
Lead supervisors, forklift operators, and loading/unloading labour
Allocate shifts and daily work, and hold supervisors accountable for targets
Maintain discipline, attendance, and productivity on the floor
Resolve worker issues firmly and fairly, without escalating everything to the owner
Train new staff on racking, stock procedures, and safety

Compliance, Safety & Reporting
Prepare daily/weekly MIS on stock, inward, dispatch, damages, and manpower
Ensure housekeeping, fire safety, and PPE compliance
Be ready for client audits and inspections at any time

Requirements
5+ years of warehouse experience, with at least 2 years as Warehouse Manager / In-charge
Mandatory: hands-on experience managing a pallet racking warehouse with bin locations
Experience in FMCG, 3PL, or manufacturing warehouses preferred
Proven experience leading a team of 20+ workers and supervisors
Strong knowledge of FIFO, batch tracking, stock audits, and damage handling
Working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets (WMS or SAP exposure is a plus)
Good communication in Tamil; English and Hindi preferred
Graduate in any discipline; diploma/degree in logistics or supply chain is a plus

Description:
Role and Responsibilities:
1. Supplier Quality Management
Evaluate and approve new suppliers. Conduct supplier audits and assessments. Monitor supplier performance using quality metrics (PPM, defect rates, delivery quality, etc.). Develop supplier improvement plans when quality issues arise.
2. Incoming Material Quality Assurance
Verify that incoming parts and materials meet specifications. Review inspection reports and quality documentation.
Coordinate with incoming quality inspection teams. Manage containment actions for non-conforming materials.
3. APQP and PPAP Activities
Participate in Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities. Review and approve Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submissions from suppliers. Ensure suppliers comply with customer-specific requirements during product development.
4. Problem Solving and Corrective Actions
Lead investigations of supplier-related defects. Use quality tools such as:
8D Methodology, 5 Why Analysis, Fishbone (Ishikawa) Diagram, Pareto Analysis, FMEA
Verify implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions.
5. Process Audits
Conduct supplier process audits. Verify compliance with: IATF 16949 requirements ISO 9001 standards, Customer-specific requirements, Assess manufacturing controls, traceability, and process capability.
6. Quality Data Analysis
Analyze warranty, field failure, and production defect data.
Track KPIs such as: PPM (Parts Per Million defects). Supplier Scorecard Ratings, Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ)
Audit Findings, Generate quality reports and improvement recommendations.
7. Change Management
Review supplier process changes.
Approve changes in: Manufacturing processes, Raw materials, Tooling, Production locations and Ensure proper validation before implementation.
8. Customer Complaint Support
Support investigations related to supplier-caused customer complaints. Coordinate with suppliers for root cause analysis and corrective actions. Provide quality documentation to customers when required.
9. Cross-Functional Coordination
Work closely with: , Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Purchasing/Sourcing, Production, Logistics, Suppliers
Customer Quality Teams, Skills Required
The SQA Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the quality of software products through comprehensive testing and validation processes. The role involves developing and executing test plans, identifying defects, and collaborating with the development team to enhance product quality. The SQA Engineer will participate in the entire software development lifecycle, providing insights and recommendations to improve testing methodologies and processes.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Company Profile
Gold Plus Group is the second-largest glass manufacturing company in India, with its Head
Office located at Kings Mall, Rohini, Delhi. The Group operates two Float Glass and Solar Glass
manufacturing plants at Roorkee (Uttarakhand) and Kanagala, Belagavi (Karnataka), along with
a processing plant at Kala Amb (Himachal Pradesh), and has a strong sales presence across all
regions, with a group turnover of INR 3,500 crore and a workforce of approximately 4000+
employees.
Company Website: https://goldplusgroup.com/
Designation: Area Sales Manager
Department: Sales and Marketing
Qualification: MBA
Roles and Responsibilities-
•
•
•
Manage and strengthen relationships with existing business associates linked to the
organization.
Identify, onboard, and develop new business associates within the assigned region to drive
market expansion.
Achieve sales targets in terms of tonnage as assigned periodically by the organization
through the Regional Manager (RM).
•
•
Ensure timely collection of receivables and maintain healthy outstanding levels.
Oversee account reconciliation and coordinate with the accounts team to resolve
discrepancies.
•
•
•
Build long-term customer relationships and enhance brand presence in the region.
Address and resolve customer queries, complaints, and service-related issues promptly.
Assign tasks to Marketing Executives (ME) reporting to them and monitor their
performance.
•
Perform additional duties as assigned by the RM / General Manager (GM) from time to time
Skills-
•
•
Presentable
Good Communication skills
AboutCompany: Gold Plus Group, is the leading glass manufacturing processing group in India and manufactures Float Glass and complete range of high quality processed glasses at its state - of the art manufacturing facility in Karnataka, Roorkee, Uttrakhand, Sonepat, Haryana and Kala Amb , Himanchal. Gold Plus started its operation in 1985 with trading in various glasses has now earned the distinction of manufacturing all types of processed glasses under one roof.

Description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Overview
Service Managers (SM) or Territory Managers (TM) are the frontline owner of fleet quality, safety compliance and ground-level service execution resulting in top-notch customer experience.
Core Responsibilities
Service Quality –
1. Completing daily in-bus inspections and fill the audit form to improve service delivery
2. Own audit score and bus-quality-complaints-per-trip metric, and zero compromise on safety violations
3. Ensure cleanliness, comfort and onboard amenities meet brand standard on every trip
4. Daily coordination with operator staff to get the work done and highlighting improvement areas
5. Calling unhappy customers daily and gather captain & crew feedback to close the loop; resolve issues at the right quality, not just speed
6. Working on reducing customer complaints related to bus condition, cleanliness and safety concerns
 Team Leadership & Accountability -
1. Recruit, train and manage the team of bus captains ensuring grooming standards and timely reporting
2. Own roster planning, week-offs, attendance and attrition control
3. Drive accountability through audits and performance evaluation; log corrective actions against the SOP checklist; keep behavioral complaints under check
4. Deliver on customer engagement targets of customer ratings and in-bus bookings
 Reporting & Continuous Improvement -
1. Own the reports assigned to this role, flag trends and make corrections
2. Monitor service and captain level performance through performance dashboards
3. Bus punctuality reports to be seen daily and making timely schedule/route corrections
4. Log daily checklist of SOPs and ensure team down the line improve on deliverables
 Required Skills & Availability
 Working knowledge of bus systems, fleet maintenance basics and safety regulations
 Proven people-management and training ability for a frontline team
 Composure and firmness enforcing standards under operational pressure, including the authority to hold a bus back from dispatch
 Strong coordination and stakeholder communication — captains, crew, customers and the operator
 Comfortable working late nights and staying reachable off-hours while services are running

Description:
To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency
to achieve sales & productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners.Recruit ,Coach,Mentor,Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity & Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to on boarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals & performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re- activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English & regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills -
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Description:
Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh (HIAL) is an upcoming Alternative Institute for Mountain Development which follows Contextual Learning and Experiential Pedagogy where students learn by doing and earn while they learn. It aims to develop Ladakh into a benchmark of sustainable living for the mountain world, where all children receive a meaningful education that prepares them for a life of dignity in harmony with nature. It believes in collaborative exercise between learners and facilitators. Instead of solving problems with the conventional 3Rs (Reading, writing, and arithmetic), the learners are encouraged to solve problems using the 3Hs: Bright Head, Kind Heart, and Skilled Hands. The institute is promoted by the renowned leaders in entrepreneurial education in India and attracts talent and grants from leading corporates and Government bodies in India.

Job Description:
We are seeking a talented and creative Media Executive to join our team . The ideal candidate will have proven photography and videography skills, with a keen eye for capturing compelling visuals that tell a story. Strong attention to detail and ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Willingness to travel and work in challenging environments, including remote Himalayan regions, and be flexible with assignments and schedules.
Benefits:
Opportunity to work with a dynamic team dedicated to making a positive impact in the Himalayan region.
Experience the rich cultural heritage and breathtaking landscapes of Ladakh.
Professional development opportunities and training in media production and storytelling techniques.
If you are passionate about using your media skills to make a difference and are excited about the opportunity to work in the beautiful Himalayan region of Ladakh, we encourage you to apply for the Media Executive position at HIAL. Join us in our mission to create a more sustainable and resilient future for Himalayan communities.

Job Summary

The Sous Chef - Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting the Executive Chef in managing the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires strong knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, menu execution, and kitchen procedures, along with proven leadership skills and the ability to manage a team effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the Executive Chef in managing the day-to-day operations of the Indian kitchen.
Supervise and coordinate the work of Chefs de Partie, Commis Chefs, and other kitchen team members.
Prepare and oversee the preparation and cooking of Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, portion control, and overall food quality.
Conduct regular quality checks and ensure all dishes meet the required standards before service.
Plan and supervise mise en place and ensure adequate preparation for daily operations and service.
Assist in menu planning, development of new dishes, and implementation of seasonal and special menus.
Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling, and rotation of food items in accordance with FIFO practices.
Monitor ingredient quality, freshness, and availability and coordinate with the relevant departments for timely replenishment.
Control food wastage and assist in maintaining food-cost targets through effective production and portion control.
Ensure strict compliance with food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.
Maintain cleanliness, organization, and discipline across the Indian kitchen and assigned work areas.
Assist in managing buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, special events, and other culinary requirements.
Train, guide, and develop junior kitchen team members in Indian cooking techniques, hygiene, and standard operating procedures.
Allocate daily duties and ensure efficient deployment of kitchen personnel during service.
Monitor kitchen equipment and report maintenance requirements, malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to the Executive Chef.
Take responsibility for the Indian kitchen in the absence of the Executive Chef, ensuring uninterrupted and efficient operations.
Work closely with other kitchen sections and service teams to ensure smooth coordination and timely food delivery.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 7-8 years of experience in a professional Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.

Strong knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines.
Proven experience in supervising and leading a kitchen team.
Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and HACCP standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, ingredients, and regional cuisines.
Strong leadership and team-management skills.
Ability to maintain consistency and quality during high-volume service.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet service timelines.
Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good understanding of food cost, portion control, and wastage management.
Ability to train, motivate, and develop junior kitchen team members.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Ability to maintain a clean, disciplined, and professional kitchen environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Description:
Job Description:
The Purchase Manager will be responsible for end-to-end management of the Sheshyon shop. This includes establishing and maintaining supplier relationships, negotiating favorable deals, overseeing inventory, ensuring timely purchases and sales, handling invoices, tracking budgets, and managing records. The role requires an individual who is highly organized, skilled in negotiation, and capable of fostering efficient and cost-effective operations.

Key Responsibilities:

1.Supply Chain Management:
Establish and maintain relationships with suppliers to ensure a reliable flow of quality goods.
Identify new suppliers and vendors when necessary, expanding options to meet the shop's diverse needs.
2.Negotiations and Vendor Relations:
Negotiate terms, pricing, and conditions with suppliers to achieve cost-effective procurement.
Report on supplier performance to ensure adherence to quality and service standards.
3.Procurement and Inventory Control:
Make timely purchases based on the needs of HIAL, public customers, and budget guidelines.
Manage stock levels, reorder points, and work with suppliers to prevent stockouts.
4.Billing, Budgeting, and Accounting:
Prepare and manage invoices, maintain bill records, and ensure accurate accounting for all purchases and sales.
Track and report on budget allocations, and provide regular updates to management.
5.Customer Service and Sales:
Serve as the main point of contact for both internal HIAL departments and external customers. Ensure a high standard of customer satisfaction and timely responses to inquiries.
6.Returns, Charges, and Price Adjustments:
Assist in the return of goods to suppliers when necessary and handle related documentation. Review carriage charges, price increases, and communicate changes to relevant departments.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's/ Master's or MBA in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field.
Proven experience in purchasing, vendor management, and inventory control.
Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in accounting and budgeting.
Ability to multitask and work in a dynamic environment.

This is a full-time on-site Executive Chef role at Lchang Nang Retreat located in Nubra. The Executive Chef will oversee the culinary operations and manage a team of chefs. Proven ability to effectively manage a team of chefs, and to train and mentor colleagues
Experience in menu planning, recipe development, and inventory management
A thorough understanding of food safety and sanitation practices, and the ability to ensure compliance
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work well under pressure
A passion for food, and a creative approach to menu development
Experience with catering and events, and the ability to adapt to different settings and cooking environments

The role will encompass a range of marketing activities, including digital marketing, content creation, event promotion, and brand management.

Key Responsibilities:

Promote Responsible Tourism Events:
Develop and implement marketing plans to promote responsible tourism-related events and activities curated by HIAL.
Collaborate with local and international partners to create awareness and attract participants.
Utilize digital marketing channels, social media, and content marketing to reach the target audience.
Promote Institute Courses:
Create marketing campaigns to promote the various courses offered by the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh.
Develop course-specific marketing materials, including brochures, flyers, and digital content.
Implement strategies to increase course enrollment and participation.
Promote Conferences and Workshops:
Plan and execute marketing initiatives to promote conferences, workshops, and seminars held at the institute.
Coordinate with speakers, sponsors, and participants to ensure successful event promotion.
Manage event registration and attendee communication.
Digital Marketing:
Implement digital marketing strategies, including SEO, SEM, email marketing, and social media campaigns.
Create and curate content that highlights the institute's mission and values.
Monitor website traffic, engagement, and conversion rates to optimize digital marketing efforts.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Content Creation:
Develop compelling and informative content, including blog posts, videos, and infographics, to engage the target audience.
Ensure that content aligns with the institute's values and promotes sustainable practices.
Collaboration:
Collaborate with the institute's teams, including academic, administrative, and event planning, to align marketing efforts with organizational goals.

Budget Management:
Create and manage marketing budgets, optimizing resource allocation for maximum impact.
Monitor spending and provide regular reports

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
Proven experience in marketing, preferably in the field of education, sustainable tourism, or related areas.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing techniques and tools.
Excellent communication and content creation skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a diverse team.
Passion for sustainable and responsible tourism practices.
Familiarity with Ladakh and the local community is a plus.
This Marketing Manager will play a crucial role in promoting the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh's mission to promote responsible tourism and education in the region, while also fostering awareness and participation in its various courses, conferences, and workshops.

Description:
The Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Finance Head to lead our finance department. As the Finance Head, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the financial stability and success of our organization. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining financial forecasting models, supervising a team of accountants, and identifying cost-saving solutions. Additionally, you will collaborate with senior management to explore alternative funding options, manage resource allocation, and ensure compliance through audits.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Forecasting:
Develop and maintain forecasting models for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results to provide accurate and timely financial insights to the organization.
Team Leadership:
Provide strong leadership and supervision to a team of accountants, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in all financial transactions. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development within the team.
Cost Optimization:
Identify opportunities for cost-saving solutions to optimize financial performance, enhancing the financial sustainability of the organization.
Funding Exploration:
Collaborate with senior management to explore alternate funding options for projects and initiatives, including grants, partnerships, and investment opportunities.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Budget Approval:
Review and approve budgets, ensuring they align with the organizational goals and financial constraints. Monitor budget performance and recommend adjustments when necessary.
Vendor Payments and Payroll:
Ensure timely payments to vendors and the punctual release of employee salaries, maintaining strong vendor and employee relationships.
Financial Integrity and Compliance:
Conduct regular audits to maintain financial integrity and compliance with relevant laws and regulations. Develop and implement corrective measures as needed.

Qualifications:
Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. MBA or a relevant advanced degree is preferred.
Proven experience in financial management, including forecasting, budgeting, and cost analysis.
Strong leadership and team management skills with a minimum of 5 years of supervisory experience.
Proficiency in financial modeling, accounting software, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of funding opportunities in the nonprofit sector is a plus.

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
