Job Title - GCC Technology Advisory Manager
Management Level: 07 - Manager
Location: Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata
Must have skills: GCC (Global Capability Centers) Strategy, Digital & Technology Strategy, Technology Operating Model Design, Sourcing Strategy, Business Case Formulation, IT Processes & Governance
Good to have skills: Tech M&A Advisory, IT Shared Services, Agile Operating Model, Workforce Transformation, AI in SDLC, Data Visualization Tools, Enterprise Architecture

Job Summary:
Manage defined workstreams within GCC strategy and digital transformation engagements, taking responsibility for structuring the approach, shaping the analysis, and delivering high-quality outputs within agreed timelines along with budgeting and forecasting activities
Own and lead projects - guiding team, reviewing outputs, and ensuring coherence across deliverables at the workstream level
Prepare client presentations, workshop materials, and proposal sections independently, contributing actively to client discussions and working sessions
Develop business cases, cost analyses, value realization frameworks, and support models for GCC setup and digital strategy assignments
Apply a technology and business perspective across GCC processes, IT governance design, KPI and maturity frameworks, and emerging areas such as AI-enabled transformation
Contribute to business development efforts through research, pitch preparation, and proposal development and managing BD cycles
Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends.
Roles & Responsibilities:
GCC Strategy and Setup: lead analysis of BOT/ABO setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GCC tooling landscape assessment, capability maturity evaluation, and process taxonomy design for new GCC entities
Cost Analysis and Value Realization: develop detailed cost models covering setup costs, run-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GCC and technology transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers
KPI Design and Performance Frameworks: design KPI frameworks for GCC performance management, covering operational, delivery, financial, and strategic metrics; develop KPI dashboards and reporting cadences aligned to governance structures
Capability Maturity Assessment: conduct structured maturity assessments across GCC functions, IT processes, and technology capabilities; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
GCC Processes and Tooling: Design GCC-specific operating processes including demand management, project intake, service catalogues, and performance reporting; assess and recommend tooling platforms (ITSM, PPM, reporting) suited to GCC operating contexts
IT Governance Design: Design IT governance frameworks for GCC and enterprise technology contexts, including governance councils, decision rights, escalation structures, and policy frameworks aligned to organizational objectives
RACI and Interaction Model Design: Develop RACI matrices and IT interaction models defining roles, responsibilities, and collaboration patterns between the GCC, parent organization, business units, and third-party vendors
Operating Model Design: Design integrated IT operating models for GCC setups including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition planning considerations
AI in SDLC: Contribute to assessments and recommendations on AI integration into software development lifecycles within GCC contexts - covering AI-assisted coding, automated testing, and intelligent release management
Professional & Technical Skills:
7-10 years of total experience in strategy consulting, technology advisory, or in-house corporate strategy; experience at a top-tier or Big 4 firm preferred
Experience leading workstreams in GCC strategy, digital transformation, or technology operating model engagements
Working knowledge of at least 2-3 of the following: GCC/Captive Center setup, Digital & Technology Strategy, IT Governance, Operating Model Design, IT Shared Services, Sourcing Strategy, Agile Transformation
Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks for technology and GCC transformation contexts
Experience designing KPI frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches - capability, process, or technology maturity - and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
Familiarity with IT governance frameworks (e.g. COBIT, ITIL) and ability to design practical governance structures including RACI models and interaction frameworks
Understanding of GCC tooling ecosystems - ITSM platforms, project portfolio management tools, reporting and analytics platforms
Awareness of AI adoption in software delivery including AI-assisted development tools and their implications for GCC workforce and process design
Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills
What's in it for you?
Opportunity to work on GCC and digital strategy programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries
Exposure to senior stakeholder engagements and client-facing responsibilities as part of high-performing delivery teams
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Educational Qualification: MBA from Tier-1 Institute

Role: Workday Accounting Prism
Experience: 4 to 10 years
Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certification: Workday certification (Mandatory)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Financials certification.
At least 1 year or full implementation of Workday Financials along with end to end support on Accounting Center/Prism.
At least 3 years of relevant Workday experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Subject Matter Expertise on Accounting Center Processes and reports while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Functional experience in several Workday Finance modules like Financial Accounting, Common Financial Management, Customers, Customer Accounts, Banking and Settlement, Business Assets, Projects.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various Finance modules and hands on experience configuring FDM structure and business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Preferred Skills:
Good to have Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Reporting, FDM and other certifications related to Workday Finance functional areas.
Knowledge on using Customer Central for configuration and migration.
Demonstrates thorough abilities and/or a proven record of success working in a collaborative environment to collect and refine business requirements along with the associated development activities to deliver the appropriate reporting solutions within Workday Accounting Center;
Demonstrates competencies in verbal and written communication skills via experience in leading business requirements gathering and design sessions;
Demonstrates thorough abilities in data profiling and governance principles to ensure data integrity and quality throughout the development life cycle, and utilizes data modeling, design, and visualization tools and principles;
Demonstrates thorough knowledge of SQL, including database queries;
Serves as a subject matter expert regarding Workday Accounting Center; and
Demonstrates critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Description:
Electrical Supervisor

Job Overview

We are seeking a results-driven Electrical Supervisor to join our Engineering & Projects Department at Phoenix Electricals. In this role, you will lead and manage on-site electrical infrastructure operations, ensuring high-quality field execution, technical compliance, and strict
adherence to safety standards across assigned project locations.
This position reports directly to the Project Head and plays a vital role in delivering our infrastructure projects on time and within specification across our Pan-India operational footprint.
Key Responsibilities
1. On-Site Field Execution & Operations

Direct and supervise daily on-site electrical works, including overhead transmission line installation, underground cabling, substation equipment setup, and distribution infrastructure.
Coordinate field labor, riggers, fitters, and specialized sub-contractors to maintain daily execution targets.
Ensure proper utilization, maintenance, and tracking of project materials, heavy machinery, and specialized field equipment on site.
2. Quality Assurance & Technical Compliance
Verify that all field installation work complies with approved single line diagrams (SLDs), route layouts, engineering drawings, and quality assurance plans.
Conduct stage-wise inspections, cable insulation testing (Megger), earth resistance testing, and pre-commissioning checks.
Maintain site quality records, track punch lists, and manage request-for-inspection (RFI) procedures with client or utility representatives.

3. Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) Compliance
Enforce strict compliance with site safety regulations, permit-to-work (PTW) protocols, and risk assessment procedures.
Conduct regular morning toolbox talks (TBT) covering site-specific hazards, high-voltage risks, and working-at-height safety.
Ensure 100% compliance with mandatory personal protective equipment (PPE) across all field personnel.

4. Progress Tracking & Site Coordination
Prepare and submit daily progress reports (DPR), material consumption logs, and site activity records to project management.
Assist in local site management, including Right-of-Way (RoW) clearances, utility coordination, and landowner interactions along project corridors.
Support senior engineers in measuring executed quantities for billing and subcontractor reconciliation.

Required Qualifications & Credentials
Education: ITI Or Diploma
Experience: Proven field execution experience in electrical infrastructure projects, transmission lines, cabling, or substations.

Licenses/Certifications: Valid Electrical Supervisor Competency Certificate / License issued by a State Electrical Licensing Board preferred.
Core Skills:
Strong technical understanding of high-voltage systems, earthing, stringing, and cable jointing procedures.
Ability to read and interpret complex electrical engineering drawings and site schematics.

Strong team leadership, local workforce management, and field problem-solving skills.
Physical fitness to manage active field operations under remote or outdoor site conditions.
AboutCompany: Phoenix Electricals is a turnkey Electrical Solutions company working in the Electrical distribution sector and having experience in Government and Private sectors with varied experience in Liasoning, Design, Procurement, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of Substations, Distribution Transformer Centers, Overhead lines, Underground cables and RMU installation works.

Description:
Role Purpose
Own and drive the complete Water Purifier Service across the product lifecycle, ensuring superior customer experience, service excellence, operational efficiency, revenue growth, and profitability. The role will work closely with Product Management, R&D, Quality, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Service teams from product conception to end-of-life support.

Key Responsibilities

Service Operations Excellence
Ensure achievement of category service SLAs, TAT, FFR, productivity, and customer satisfaction targets.
Drive operational excellence through Daily Work Management (DWM), Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Monitor installation, complaints, warranty, and preventive maintenance performance across Direct Service Centers (DSC) and ASP networks.
Ensure effective CRM utilization, customer registration compliance, and consumer database management.

Category Ownership & Business Responsibility
Own the overall Water Purifier Service Category performance, including customer satisfaction, operational KPIs, revenue, cost management, and profitability.
Manage end-to-end service P&L, including warranty cost, spare parts profitability, AMC business, accessories sales, installation revenue, and finished goods referrals.
Develop and execute category service strategy aligned with business growth objectives.

Product Development & NPD Support
Represent Service as a key stakeholder in New Product Development (NPD) and stage-gate reviews.
Provide field insights, voice of customer, serviceability inputs, reliability requirements, and cost optimization recommendations during product design.
Drive service readiness activities before product launch, including service manuals, spare parts planning, troubleshooting tools, training modules, and SOPs.
Monitor post-launch performance and drive corrective actions through RCA and CAPA initiatives.

Product Quality & Process Improvement
Analyze field failures, recurring complaints, and service trends to identify improvement opportunities.
Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and collaborate with Quality, R&D, and Supplier Development teams for corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor product reliability, warranty performance, spare consumption trends, and service cost optimization.

Training & Capability Development
Develop and implement comprehensive training programs for Direct service technicians, Service managers, call center teams, and ASP partners.
Create technical training modules, e-learning content, SOPs, installation guides, service advisories, videos, and knowledge repositories.
Drive capability enhancement through field coaching, skill assessments, certification programs, and performance monitoring.

Service Content & Knowledge Management
Develop and maintain service documentation, troubleshooting guides, installation procedures, technical bulletins, warranty policies, and service advisories.
Ensure timely communication of product updates and service process changes to all stakeholders.

Spare Parts & Supply Chain Management
Own spare parts strategy, forecasting, inventory planning, availability, and lifecycle management.
Optimize spare parts cost, fill rate, inventory health, and service readiness across the network.
Drive standardization and cost-effective sourcing initiatives.

Customer Experience & Digital Service
Drive NPS, CSAT, customer retention, and service experience enhancement programs.
Monitor customer feedback from CRM, contact center, MTRSS customer and marketplaces.
Lead digital initiatives related to service automation, field mobility, self-service tools, customer communication, and analytics.

Revenue & Business Growth
Drive AMC, accessories, consumables, spare parts, upgrades, and installation revenue growth.
Develop service-led business opportunities and customer lifecycle monetization programs.
Enable referral generation and conversion for Water Purifier finished goods sales.
Monitor revenue realization, margins, and profitability across all service revenue streams.

Partner & Stakeholder Management
Manage relationships with DSC team, Branch CS team, ASP partners, Category Business lead, Digital marketing team, Ecom partners, and KAMs.
Ensure alignment between service operations and business objectives through regular reviews and governance mechanisms.
Drive marketplace ratings, reviews, and service performance metrics.

Performance Management & Reporting
Establish and monitor category KPIs, dashboards, and governance mechanisms.
Review business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions.
Prepare periodic MIS, management reviews, business forecasts, and performance reports for leadership.

Key KPIs
NPS / CSAT
Service SLA & TAT Achievement
First-Time Fix (FTFR)
Installation Success Rate
Warranty Cost % to Sales
Spare Parts Availability & Fill Rate
AMC Revenue Growth
Accessories & Consumables Sales
Service Revenue & Profitability
Field Productivity
Field Failure Rate (FFR)
Marketplace Ratings & Reviews
Product Reliability & Quality Metrics
Overall Category P&L Performance

Preferred Experience

10+ years of experience in Service Operations, Product Support, Consumer Durables, Water Purifiers, Appliances, or Similar Categories.
Strong exposure to Product Development, Service Operations, Quality, Spare Parts Management, Revenue Generation, and Business Management.
Proven experience in leading large field service networks and driving customer experience transformation.
Strong analytical, commercial, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities.

Education Qualification:
Bachelors degree, MBA with any specialization

Key Skills/Competencies:
Global mindset - Ability to understand different markets, competitor overview and set the differentiated trend for Vguard
Excellent domain knowledge
Problem Solving & Decision making
Influencing
Business Acumen
Strategic Thinking
Interpersonal Relationships
Effective Decision Making
Enabling Change Management and Developing People
Familiarity with MS office, CRM systems and other CRM related practices
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively

Description:
Picture yourself brightening someones day. When you join our Hotels team, thats exactly what youll do every time you come to work. As a Food Beverage Attendant, youll play an essential role in delivering friendly, attentive, and efficient service across our dining outlets.
Whether welcoming guests, taking orders, serving food and beverages, or ensuring the outlet is ready for service, youll help create experiences that make every stay special.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in food and beverage, hospitality, or customer service is preferred.
A passion for delivering friendly and attentive guest service.
Basic knowledge of food and beverage service procedures.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Positive, team-oriented, and adaptable approach.
Well-presented, reliable, and committed to maintaining high service standards.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays when required.
Ability to stand for extended periods and perform the physical requirements of the role.
Heres what youll do during a typical day:
Deliver warm and attentive service: Welcome guests, take orders accurately, serve food and beverages, and respond promptly to guest requests.
Create memorable guest experiences: Build positive relationships with guests, anticipate their needs, and handle feedback professionally.
Maintain service excellence: Follow Hiltons service standards and ensure food and beverages are presented and delivered to the highest quality.
Support smooth outlet operations: Assist with table setup, clearing, resetting, cleaning, and preparing the outlet before, during, and after service.
Work effectively as a team: Coordinate closely with colleagues, supervisors, kitchen teams, and other departments to ensure seamless service.
Support revenue and efficiency: Promote menu items and special offers where appropriate, process orders accurately, and minimize wastage.
Uphold health and safety standards: Follow food safety, hygiene, sanitation, alcohol awareness, and workplace safety procedures at all times.
Develop your skills: Participate in training and continuously build your knowledge of menus, service techniques, and hospitality standards.

Respond and attend to guest repair requests.
Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintece issues.
Perform preventive maintece on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication.
Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines.
Carry equipment (eg, tools, radio).
Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings.
Maintain maintece inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed.
Communicate each day s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards.
Display basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building.
Perform all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough cleanup of the painting or repair area.
Test, troubleshoot and perform basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (eg, plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guestroom items.
Program TVs and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related inventory duties.
Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintece work.
Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers.
Display basic computer skills including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintece problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials.
Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets.
Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation.
Adhere to quality expectations and standards.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees.
Speak with others using clear and professional language.
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance.
Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Enter and locate work-related information using computers.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

License or Certification: Driver s License

Job Summary
Results-driven CPQ Pricing Analyst with 2-3 years of hands-on experience implementing and optimizing CPQ solutions across mid-size to enterprise organizations. Roles & Responsibilities:
Provide functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools solutions like PriceFx, CONGA, PROS , SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus

Work on B2B Pricing Analytics (Exploratory Analysis & Reporting), target state analytics recommendation
Work on recommending and deploying process improvements and enablers with best-in-class KPIs
Work as an integral part of the client-s sales organization, towards driving efficient and effective structure pricing and discounting approach.
You will work closely with our clients as Consulting Professionals who design, build, and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance within the Pricing & CPQ area.
The candidate will be responsible for providing functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools

Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills:
2-3 years of progressive industry and/or consulting experience in the Products/ Communications & High Tech/ Financial Services industry/ Resources
Experience working with PROS Smart Price Optimization & Management (POM) & Smart Configure Price Quote (CPQ). Certification in these areas is an advantage.
Functional experience in Pricing of Services, products, parts, and post sales services
Proficiency in MS Excel, Macro, and PowerPoint and exposure to Visualization Tools such as Power BI and Tableau
Knowledge of other Pricing & CPQ tools like PriceFx, CONGA, SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, PROS, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus are a plus

Additional Information

PROS Smart Price Optimization and Management
PROS Smart Configure Price Quote

Learning Deployment Specialist Senior Associate
The opportunity
As a Learning Deployment Specialist within the GDS Talent Services - L&D Hub, you will coordinate the end-to-end deployment of learning programmes and projects for EY teams across regions and time zones. You will manage schedules, learning-system setup, logistics, budgets, compliance and stakeholder engagement, while producing virtual sessions as needed and delivering a consistent, high-quality learner experience in line with agreed service levels.
Your key responsibilities
Learning and project deployment
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to schedule offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the end-to-end execution of Learning course deployment plans and budgets, including conference and event management including:
Arranging training material
Monitoring of participant nominations working alongside Deployment Administration Team
Management of learner cancellations, no shows and missed sessions, including coordinating training dates and nominations from different areas of the business
First point of contact for queries from the practice in relation to the courses assigned, in addition to ongoing management of learning mailboxes and referrals from Deployment Administration Team
Prepare facilitators for delivery of Learning courses (logistics) and support in the management of facilitators
Provide oversight of Learning Deployment administration activities, taking responsibility for the detailed review of work performed by the Deployment Administration Team assigned.
Manage and maintain SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Support the hosting and production of online modules, webcasts and virtual learning projects. Advise on best practice, for example interactivity during virtual classroom sessions
Virtual Producer role where Virtual Producer team can't support
Realise operational excellence through maintaining thorough understanding of, and adherence to, the Learning Deployment Operating Model
Ideas generation and rollout of networking elements within virtual learning programmes
Venue booking, accommodation booking for residential courses and ongoing management
Ensure CE credits awarded to Learning participants and instructors where applicable
Supporting on projects across the Learning and/or Leadership Development TD team(s) as required
Financial Management
Support the budget, accruals, forecasts, and actual costs of courses/projects you are responsible for.
Support all Finance related activities as per the Deployment model.
Support with monthly/annual finance activities/requests from Enablement/Operations team.
Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain close working relationships with onshore and offshore colleagues.
Build and maintain close working relationships with Deployment Administration team (where relevant).
Coach and support the Deployment Administration team to increase their knowledge, skills and competence within their role along with their understanding of the region, by providing transparent and supportive feedback.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders relevant for courses and client groups to enable the successful deployment. Stakeholders may include Deployment Administration Team, Portfolio Managers, Senior Learning Associates, Learning Associates, Enablement team, Service Line Talent Development Teams, Global Deployment Team, Facilitators, external suppliers.
Measure Learning
Access reports on Learning course L1–L3 evaluation feedback and analyse feedback from course participants to continually improve course offerings.
Accurate reporting and tracking of course consumption and satisfaction reporting.
Continuous Improvement
Document lessons learned and refine deployment processes.
Stay updated on SuccessFactors features and best practices in learning deployment.
Generate new ideas/suggest improvements/possible solutions.
Team
Contribute to other activities or projects across wider Talent Development functions.
Support the induction of new team members.
Skills and Attributes for Success
To qualify for the role you must have:
Strong project management skills to deliver and ensure seamless execution of portfolio tasks.
Proactive problem solver with a solutions mindset, willing to adjust work schedules as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Strong IT skills, particularly in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint. There will be a test to determine your knowledge.
Experience in using Power BI, PowerApps, and an openness to learn and use AI will be preferred.
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
Strong team worker, with enthusiastic, can-do approach, with ability to coordinate and work as “one team”.
Commercial acumen and business awareness.
Commitment to driving and delivering quality services and products to Talent, ensuring high standards are met.
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly, adapting to changing environments and priorities.
Ability to engage and influence others, demonstrating good change management skills and a desire to drive process improvements.
Experience in curating and maintaining knowledge resources, including documentation and SharePoint sites, to enhance accessibility and usability for participants.
Experience in establishing and managing key stakeholder relationships, including external vendors and key internal stakeholders.
Strong team worker with an enthusiastic, can-do approach, capable of coordinating and working as “one team”.
AI Skills
Working knowledge of Generative AI tools and effective prompting.
Ability to leverage AI to improve efficiency, automation, reporting, and learner experience.
Experience
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline; a Human Resources diploma is an advantage.
Experience in learning deployment or programme coordination, or a strong interest in developing a career in learning.
Experience in a professional services or corporate environment and working across international and diverse teams.
Experience
Bachelor's degree in business administration, Human Resources or a related discipline; a Human Resources diploma is an advantage.
Experience in learning deployment or programme coordination, or a strong interest in developing a career in learning.
Experience in a professional services or corporate environment and working across international and diverse teams.
Additional Requirements
Training or certification in producing Microsoft Teams, Zoom or Webex sessions is highly desirable/essential.
Flexibility to work European Time Zone business hours; adjust schedules for peak demand and virtual learning support when required.
What we offer
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development and you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Job Title: Learning Deployment Specialist
Job Summary:
Talent Services is a core service function within the Global Delivery Services organization, providing multiple HR and learning related support services including Recruitment support, Onboarding support, People Data Administration, Learning Administration, Cross Border Travel, Global Mobility and Performance Management support to EY member firms.
Talent Services supports Europe West (EW) as part of the extended Region Learning team. It is fully integrated with onshore colleagues in Europe West and participates in meetings, projects and planning activities as part of one team. It is aligned with the Learning Global Process Model and initiates learning processes through the existing workflow for execution by the CAT and DAT teams.
The person selected for this role will be at the rank of Senior Associate and will be responsible for the deployment of multiple courses within one or more curricula for Europe West, working alongside the Senior Deployment Specialist and/or Learning Program Manager. The Senior Associate will oversee learning administration activities and report on course feedback. (50%)
The Senior Associate will support the end-to-end program lifecycle, including program planning, stakeholder coordination, participant and facilitator management, communications, learning logistics, program documentation, delivery readiness, evaluation, and continuous improvement. (50%)
Applications Used: SuccessFactors (Learning Management System), ServiceNow
Essential Functions of the Job (Responsibilities)
Deployment (0.5 FTE)
Ensure end-to-end coordination of learning deployment activities, including validating training request forms, submitting item and class requests, and ensuring that CE credits are awarded.
Submit requests for online, virtual, and physical classroom sessions, as well as program requests in SuccessFactors for learner consumption.
Address learner queries related to credits, class requests, and compliance.
Monitor participant nominations and manage cancellations, no-shows and missed sessions.
Monitor and analyse reports, including credit reports, NASBA reports and evaluation feedback.
Ensure CE credits are awarded to learning participants and instructors, where applicable.
Build and maintain close working relationships with the EW Learning team.
Program Management (0.5 FTE)
Support EW Tax Learning Leads in executing regional learning priorities and learning initiatives.
Coordinate the planning and delivery of Europe West Tax learning programs, including timelines, action trackers, governance activities and key deliverables.
Manage participant, facilitator and stakeholder engagement activities, including nominations, communications, briefing activities and delivery readiness.
Support stakeholder meetings and governance forums, including agenda preparation, documentation, action tracking and follow-up.
Maintain program documentation, status reports, trackers and learning resources.
Support virtual and face-to-face learning events, including learner experience, logistics coordination and delivery support.
Monitor risks, dependencies and program actions, escalating issues where appropriate.
Analyse participant and stakeholder feedback, evaluate program outcomes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with business stakeholders, facilitators and learning teams across Europe West.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements:
Deployment
Understanding of EY and EY Talent.
Stakeholder management.
Strong IT skills in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook and SharePoint.
Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
Strong team player with an enthusiastic, can-do approach and the ability to coordinate and work as one team’.
Drive the delivery of quality services and products to Talent.
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly.
Proactive problem solver with a solution-oriented mindset.
Flexible and dependable; willing to adjust the work schedule as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.
Program Management:
Strong program coordination and organizational skills.
Strong program coordination, organizational and prioritization skills.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior business stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and competing demands simultaneously.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.
Ability to interpret learning metrics, feedback and program data to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
Ability to think creatively and identify opportunities to enhance the learner experience.
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, SharePoint, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook; advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills are desirable.
Ability to work effectively across countries, cultures and time zones.
Learner and client-service focused, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
Job Requirements:
Education:
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Business or a related discipline.
Experience:
Deployment
5 to 8 years of relevant experience.
Significant experience working in HR within a professional services or corporate environment.
Experience working in Learning and Development is desirable.
Experience working in international and diverse environments.
Program Management
5-8 years of experience in Learning & Development, Talent, Program Management, People Development, or a related field.
Experience supporting the planning and delivery of learning programs, talent initiatives, or business projects.
Experience supporting regional or global initiatives within a matrix and stakeholder-driven environment.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
Experience coordinating virtual and/or classroom learning events, workshops, or development programs.
Experience collaborating with geographically dispersed and cross-functional teams.
Experience in professional services and/or international environments is desirable.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Description:
Job Summary
As a Senior within HR Managed Services, you will help organizations transform and optimize HR service delivery through process redesign, HR Shared Services, HR Service Centre set-up and operating model design.


The Opportunity
You will work closely with HR and business stakeholders to assess current-state operations, design future-state service delivery models, and implement practical solutions that improve efficiency, governance, employee experience and service quality.
In addition to client delivery, you will play an active role in practice development and business growth by supporting solution development, proposals, market initiatives and reusable assets.


Your Key Responsibilities

Advisory HR Transformation
Assess current-state HR processes, service delivery structures, organization capabilities and pain points.
Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops and requirements-gathering sessions.
Design future-state HR processes, service delivery models, organization structures and governance frameworks.
Develop pragmatic recommendations and implementation roadmaps aligned to client priorities.


HR Shared Services Service Centre Set-up
Support end-to-end design and set-up of HR Shared Services or HR Service Centres, including scope, location considerations, service catalogue, roles, spans and layers, governance and interaction models.
Develop process maps, SOPs, playbooks, work instructions, service level definitions and RACI frameworks.
Support transition, knowledge transfer, training, testing, operational readiness and stabilization activities.
Define KPIs, reporting requirements and continuous improvement mechanisms for service operations.


Client Delivery Team Leadership
Own defined workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed scope, timeline and quality standards.
Build effective working relationships with client stakeholders, EY member firms and cross-functional teams.
Guide junior team members, review deliverables and support their day-to-day development.
Identify risks, dependencies and improvement opportunities, and communicate them proactively.


Practice Development Business Growth
Contribute to proposals, RFP/RFI responses, solution design, effort estimates and client presentations.
Develop thought leadership, methodologies, accelerators, case studies and reusable assets.
Support market research, account initiatives and internal knowledge-sharing activities.


Skills and attributes for success
Strong understanding of end-to-end HR processes, HR service delivery and HR operating models.
Experience in HR transformation, process redesign, HR Shared Services or HR Service Centre set-up.
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, facilitation and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate business challenges into practical process, organization and governance solutions.
Excellent communication, presentation and client-ready documentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across global and cross-cultural teams.
Open to travel nationally and internationally for approved client projects in line with EY and country-specific travel advisory guidelines.


Ideally, You'll Also Have
6-9 years of experience in HR Transformation, HR operations, HR Shared Services or consulting.
Master's degree in HR or a similar full-time MBA/EMBA.
Hands-on experience in HR operating model design, process mapping, service catalogue design, RACI development and SOP creation.
Experience supporting Shared Services transitions, knowledge transfer, training, operational readiness or stabilization.
Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma or structured continuous improvement methodologies.
Experience supporting proposals, business pursuits and practice development initiatives.

Description:
AI Developer (Python) Experience 4-8 years’ experience
Skills and attributes for success
Candidate must possess proficiency in the following technologies:
Core AI Engineering & LLM Frameworks:
Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Auto Gen, Google Agent SDK, Model Context Protocol, Skills-based agent frameworks.
GenAI / Agentic AI Systems:
LLM application development, agentic AI architectures, multi-agent workflows, prompt engineering, AI system design, tool/function calling, enterprise AI integration.
RAG, Embeddings & Vector Search:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines, embeddings, semantic search, context retrieval strategies, Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS, Redis Vector, pgvector.
Backend & API Engineering:
Python, Fast API, REST API design, scalable API platforms, event-driven systems, microservices architecture, third-party system integration.
Cloud, Infrastructure & Containers:
Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, cloud-native application development, containerized deployments.
Databases & Data Platforms:
SQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, Redis, ClickHouse, database design, performance optimization, data accuracy and integrity.
AI Model Engineering:
Model fine-tuning, LoRA, BERT, LLM architecture understanding, evaluation techniques, AI performance monitoring.
AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI:
PII protection, data privacy, AI security, compliance, responsible AI practices, governance controls, monitoring and observability frameworks.
DevOps & Engineering Practices:
GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing, production deployment practices, observability and monitoring.
Preferred Technologies:
Rust, Go, Kubernetes, OpenShift, advanced vector database platforms, enterprise-scale LLM deployment patterns.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Minimum of 4+ years of professional engineering experience, with hands-on experience in backend/platform engineering and GenAI/LLM systems.
Bachelor’s degree B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT, or related engineering discipline.
Strong hands-on proficiency in Python for AI application development, backend services, and platform engineering.
Demonstrable experience building LLM-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, and enterprise AI integrations.
Hands-on expertise with LangChain and LangGraph, with exposure to frameworks such as AutoGen, Google Agent SDK, Model Context Protocol, or Skills-based agent frameworks.
Experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines using vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS, Redis Vector, or pgvector.
Strong understanding of embeddings, semantic search, context retrieval strategies, chunking approaches, ranking, and retrieval optimization.
Proficiency in building scalable backend services using Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven architecture.
Experience working with Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Services for enterprise-grade AI solution development.
Strong understanding of Docker and containerized deployments, with exposure to Kubernetes or OpenShift preferred.
Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar DevOps tooling.
Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL database design, query optimization, and scalable data interaction patterns.
Familiarity with AI evaluation, observability, monitoring, and production support for LLM-based systems.
Strong understanding of PII protection, data privacy, AI security, compliance, and responsible AI practices.
Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including AI engineers, data engineers, cloud/platform teams, security teams, product owners, and business stakeholders.
Experience in banking or financial services domain is preferred, especially exposure to regulatory, security, and compliance requirements.
Ability to troubleshoot and debug issues across AI pipelines, backend services, APIs, vector stores, cloud services, and production environments.
Commitment to engineering quality, including maintainable code, automated testing, reusable components, documentation, and scalable design practices.
What we looking  for
Provides intermediate to senior-level system analysis, architecture design, development, and implementation of AI platforms, backend services, APIs, and enterprise AI systems.
Designs and develops scalable GenAI applications using LLM frameworks, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and cloud-native backend services.
Translates business and technical requirements into robust AI engineering solutions, including APIs, agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines, integrations, and data processing components.
Builds, tests, and deploys AI-powered backend services using Python, FastAPI, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, vector databases, and modern DevOps practices.
Develops and maintains RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings generation, vector indexing, retrieval optimization, and response grounding.
Implements agentic AI architectures using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Google Agent SDK, or Model Context Protocol-based integration patterns.
Integrates AI solutions with enterprise systems, third-party applications, APIs, data platforms, and workflow tools.
Elevates code into development, test, staging, and production environments following established CI/CD, change control, and release management processes.
Provides production support for AI applications, including monitoring, troubleshooting, performance tuning, issue resolution, and root cause analysis.
Participates in design reviews, code reviews, testing reviews, and architecture discussions to ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable AI systems.
Applies software development methodology and follows architecture, information security, and responsible AI standards.
Contributes to AI observability and evaluation practices by monitoring model behavior, retrieval quality, latency, accuracy, hallucination risks, and system performance.
Supports implementation of AI governance controls including PII protection, data privacy, access control, compliance, responsible AI guardrails, and auditability.
Understands client business functions, technology needs, and enterprise constraints, especially in regulated banking and financial services environments.
Contributes to optimizing system performance through efficient API design, database optimization, vector search tuning, caching strategies, and scalable infrastructure patterns.
Supports the integration and maintenance of data pipelines between enterprise systems, vector databases, APIs, and backend AI services, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
Maintains and updates technical documentation for AI platforms, backend components, architecture, deployment flows, data pipelines, and operational procedures.
Applies intermediate to strong knowledge of backend security, AI security, data protection, and cloud-native engineering best practices during solution development.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

As part of our Risk Consulting Service Line, you will be part of the team performing reviews and assessment of SAP Application Controls testing for SAP ERP solutions for various clients across the MENA region. Perform technical review in the SAP security design, implementation of SAP ERP and SAP Cloud solutions.

Should have hands on experience and strong knowledge on technical activities performed in S4 Hana and Success factors covering all key modules of Finance, HR and Payroll

SAP certified professional

EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and onbrand creative solutions. A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and on-brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human - across multiple media platforms.
As an Associate - Graphic Design, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. You liaise with workflow coordinators, art director, and content teams to render creative concepts strategically and tactically into effective collaterals (MS-based applications, print and interactive collaterals). Your primary work involves creating design solutions for impactful proposals, illustrations, layouts and enhanced user experiences, across multiple streams. You have an astute understanding of design principles and highly refined sense of aesthetics. So, you comfortably work within the brand specifications, yet push the boundaries to deliver compelling and inspiring creative solutions to customers.
Your key responsibilities
Design branding materials, such as brochures, placemats, illustrations, layouts, infographics, on-screen presentations, proposals and social media collaterals
Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time and efficiency
Stay up to date with latest design trends, socialize the same to peers
Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
Communicate effectively with customers while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
Be responsive to customers on calls and emails
Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives
Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach
Flawless typography skills and keen sense of balance and intuition when it comes to layout
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to interact effectively and positively in a fast-paced environment
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline)
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
Strong visual design capability
1-4 years of relevant experience
Ideally, you ll also have
Preferable knowledge of Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics skills
Technologies and Tools
Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
What we look for
Passion to tell stories through the power of visuals
Creative problem-solving mindset with a flexible can-do attitude
Self-starter with the ability to understand and translate verbal ideas into impactful, cohesive outputs
Hands-on experience in developing brochures, newsletters, flyers, banners, business presentations, animated presentations, and various types of marketing collaterals
Experience working with global clients
Confidence, maturity, and ability to build strong client relationships
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others
What we offer
EY GDS is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to creative consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Job Title: Learning Deployment Specialist
Job Summary :
Talent Services is a core service line within the Global Delivery Services organization, providing multiple HR and learning related support services including Recruitment support, Onboarding support, People Data Administration, Learning Administration, Cross Border Travel, Global Mobility and Performance Management support to EY member firms.
Talent Services supports Europe West (EW) and acts as part of the extended Region Learning team. It is fully integrated with onshore colleagues, participating in meetings, projects and planning activities as part of one team and is aligned with the Learning Global Process Model and initiates learning processes via existing workflow (SNOW intake forms) for execution by CAT and DAT teams.
This role is responsible for the deployment of multiple courses and learning events within one or more curriculum for EY Germany working alongside the Senior Deployment specialist and/or Learning Program Manager. Supports learning administration activities and monitors course feedback and evaluation results.
Applications Used: SuccessFactors (Learning Management System), Service-Now
Essential Functions of the Job :
Responsibilities:
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to Schedule Offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the operational execution of learning deployment plans, including budget tracking, cost administration and coordination of event-related activities.
Monitor participant nominations in collaboration with DAT teams.
Manage learner cancellations, no-shows and missed sessions, including the coordination of alternative training dates and nominations.
Prepare facilitators for delivery of learning courses (logistics) and coordinate facilitator logistics and communications
Support event administration within learning systems by creating event codes, uploading participant data, agendas, and cost documentation, monitoring administrative completion, and facilitating event closure activities.
Coordinate operational event requirements, including badge production, print requests, participant materials, and other logistical activities required for successful event delivery, where responsibility has been assigned to the Deployment team
Manage and maintain learning-related SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Build and maintain close working relationships with EY Germany learning team
Contribute to other activities or projects across the wider Talent Development function
Ensure appropriate CE credits are awarded to learning participants and instructors, where applicable.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements :
Understanding of EY and EY Talent
Experience with learning management systems (preferably SuccessFactors Learning).
Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented working style and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
Strong team player with an enthusiastic, can-do approach and the ability to collaborate effectively as part of one team.
Ability to build effective working relationships across global and regional teams.
Drive and deliver quality services and products to Talent
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly
Knowledge of existing AI tools and capabilities, with the ability to identify, evaluate, and leverage AI-driven solutions to improve processes, efficiency, and user experience
Strong IT skills - Microsoft Office 365 suite - Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, etc
Proactive problem solver with solutions mindset
Service-oriented mindset with a strong commitment to delivering an excellent learner and stakeholder experience.
Flexibility to support business-critical activities during peak periods in alignment with local labor regulations and business needs.
Professional working proficiency in English; German language skills are advantageous.
Job Requirements :
Education :
Bachelors degree in Business, Human Resources or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Experience or specialization in Human Resources is considered an advantage.
Experience :
3+ years of relevant experience in Learning Operations
Significant experience of working in HR in professional services or corporate environment
Working in international and diverse environments
Experience with SuccessFactors Learning is considered an asset. A strong willingness to learn and build expertise in learning administration systems and processes is essential.

EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and onbrand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human — across multiple media platforms.
As a Senior Associate — Senior Document Specialist, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. You liaise with workflow coordinators, art director, and content teams to render creative concepts strategically and tactically into effective collaterals (MS-based applications). You have an astute understanding of design principles and highly refined sense of aesthetics. So, you comfortably work within the brand specifications, yet push the boundaries to deliver compelling and inspiring creative solutions to customers.
Your key responsibilities
Conceptualize and produce collaterals such as placemats, infographics, presentations, proposals, newsletters, posters, banners, and other marketing collaterals using MS-based applications
Communicate effectively with customers while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Provide unique, innovative, and effective solutions/design concepts to customers
Meet and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time and efficiency
Adhere to EY brand standards and remain cognizant of visual as well as verbal guidelines
Mentor junior team members on best practices around applying creativity in production environment
Stay up-to-date with latest design trends, socialize, and advocate the same to teams/customers
Seamlessly manage multiple creative projects simultaneously
Work with minimal supervision and guidance
Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach
Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to interact effectively and positively in a fast-paced environment
Understanding of current and future visual trends
Aptitude for art direction
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor's degree/College diploma (preferably in Graphic Design and/or related discipline)*
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop
5+ years of relevant experience
Ideally, you’ll also have
Intermediate/basic knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Interactive PDF, Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics
Team management experience
Technologies and Tools
Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop
What we look for
Passion to tell stories through the power of visuals
Creative problem-solving mindset with a flexible can-do attitude
Self-starter with the ability to understand and translate verbal ideas into impactful, cohesive outputs
Hands-on experience in developing brochures, newsletters, flyers, banners, business presentations, animated presentations, and various types of marketing collaterals
Experience working with global clients
Confidence, maturity, and ability to build strong client relationships
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Clients & Industries: Global C&I Strategic Operations Specialist
About EY
At EY, we re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
The Opportunity
The Global Operations Specialist plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
This position sits within the Business Enablement - Business Management Office and supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
Success in this model depends on agility-the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the Domain Leader and the rest of the Domain team.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Operations
Partner with leadership to help translate strategic objectives into actionable operational plans within the aligned domain.
Support the design and implementation of short- and long-term initiatives/projects that deliver on strategic priorities, monitoring progress against milestones.
Oversee domain-specific processes, driving clarity, consistency, and timely execution across stakeholders.
Prepare strategic inputs for leadership (e.g., decks), synthesizing content into clear narratives and recommendations to support decision-making.
Collaborate with the Strategic Operations Team Lead and counterparts, plus other Domain teams, to coordinate cross-domain priorities, ensuring operational delivery supports strategic impact.
Support performance monitoring and governance alongside Core Services.
Leverage Performance & Data Insights for analytics and intelligence to guide decisions and monitor impact.
Operational Excellence
Identify and drive efficiencies in relevant areas through automation, standardization, and best practices.
Assess emerging technologies and tools to enhance operational agility and responsiveness.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the Strategic Operations team.
Support governance forums and prepare executive-ready updates leveraging data analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Essentials, Dynamics, etc.) in coordination with Performance & Data Insights.
Drive quality and alignment with Core Services and Performance & Data Insights across domain processes, ensuring clarity in roles, handoffs, and workflows.
Assist with additional reporting and analysis requests, help manage stakeholder expectations, and reinforce self-service options.
Stakeholder Engagement
Build strong relationships across domains, functions, and pods to foster collaboration and alignment.
Act as a trusted advisor to leadership, providing recommendations based on operational insights.
Facilitate communication and coordination across domains, functions, and pods for smooth execution of initiatives.
Skills & Attributes for Success
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience in operational process creation, improvement, and handoff.
Proficiency in reporting tools, data visualization, and storyboarding to create impactful prompts for decision-making.
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities, delivering high-quality outputs under tight timelines.
A client-focused mindset, with the ability to manage expectations and redirect activity as required.
Credible, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at Global/Area leadership level.
Resilient, embraces ambiguity, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.
What we offer you
At EY, we ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

As a Senior Technical Superintendent at BSM, you will be responsible for ensuring the safe, efficient, and cost-effective technical operation of assigned vessels. This role is pivotal in maintaining operational excellence and environmental compliance while fostering strong collaboration between ship and shore. You will play a key part in supporting strategic goals, delivering high-quality ship management services, and upholding safety and regulatory standards.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor and control the technical performance of assigned vessels to ensure safety, efficiency, and compliance with contractual obligations.
Maintain close communication with clients and build strong working relationships to support operational needs.
Provide technical and operational support to vessels, including troubleshooting and implementing solutions for performance improvement.
Develop and oversee maintenance and repair plans, including drydock activities, ensuring timely and accurate execution.
Prepare, monitor, and report vessel budgets, ensuring cost efficiency and commercial viability.
Ensure compliance with maritime legislation, safety regulations, and certification requirements.
Plan and execute vessel inspections, audits, and follow-up actions to enhance operational standards.
Promote and implement health, safety, environmental, and quality policies onboard vessels.
Support and mentor sea staff, identify training needs, and provide onboard training during visits.
Manage purchasing activities and ensure timely handling of ship requisitions.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the Company Management System.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or equivalent, OR Chief Engineer s qualification.
Minimum 3 years of sailing experience as Senior Officer OR 3 years of shore experience as Technical Superintendent in a ship management or owning company.
Experience with Container vessels is essential.
Skills & Competencies
Strong knowledge of vessel technical requirements and voyage regulations.
Excellent project management and organizational skills.
Effective negotiation and people management abilities.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
Ability to communicate effectively in English with diverse stakeholders.
Proficiency in PC applications and digital tools.
Why You Should Join Us!
We offer a supportive environment, competitive compensation, and meaningful opportunities. By joining us, you will enjoy:
On-the-job training.
First-hand exposure to the growing maritime technological industry.
Diverse workforce.
Technology-driven company.
Be a part of the ever-growing Schulte group family!

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
EY GDS Creative Center of Excellence (CoE) is an inhouse agency that helps EY teams build a better working world by delivering high-impact, high-quality and on-brand creative solutions. People in the CoE help create experiences that are not just creatively inspiring, but also strategically precise and deeply human - across multiple media platforms.
As a Senior Associate - Senior Graphic Design, you ideate and deliver best-in-class creatives that intrinsically align with the EY brand and business objectives. You liaise with workflow coordinators, art director, and content teams to render creative concepts strategically and tactically into effective collaterals (MS-based applications, print and interactive collaterals). Your primary work involves creating design solutions for impactful proposals, illustrations, layouts and enhanced user experiences, across multiple streams. You have an astute understanding of design principles and highly refined sense of aesthetics. So, you comfortably work within the brand specifications, yet push the boundaries to deliver compelling and inspiring creative solutions to customers.
Your key responsibilities
Conceptualize and design branding materials, such as brochures, placemats, illustrations, layouts, infographics, on-screen presentations, proposals and social media collaterals
Adhere to EY brand guidelines, meet and exceed defined expectations in terms of aesthetics, quality, turnaround time and efficiency
Familiar with the latest design trends and advocate the same to team members and customers
Mentor junior team members on best design practices
Prioritize deadlines and effectively manage multiple creative projects parallelly
Communicate effectively with customers while understanding design briefs and sharing ideas
Provide unique and innovative design solutions to customers and convince them to make the right design choices
Take ownership and work as a design consultant independently
Be responsive to customers on calls and emails
Be a part and contribute towards various organizational initiatives
Skills and attributes for success
A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach
Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
Flawless typography skills and keen sense of balance and intuition when it comes to layout
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to interact effectively and positively in a fast-paced environment
Understanding of current and future visual trends
Aptitude for art direction
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree or college diploma (preferably in Graphic Design or related discipline)
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
Strong visual design capability
5+ years of relevant experience
Ideally, you ll also have
Preferable knowledge of Adobe After effects, Premier Pro and motion graphics skills
Team management experience
Technologies and Tools
Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe InDesign, and Adobe Document Cloud (Interactive Media)
What we look for
Passion to tell stories through the power of visuals
Creative problem-solving mindset with a flexible can-do attitude
Self-starter with the ability to understand and translate verbal ideas into impactful, cohesive outputs
Hands-on experience in developing brochures, newsletters, flyers, banners, business presentations, animated presentations, and various types of marketing collaterals
Experience working with global clients
Confidence, maturity, and ability to build strong client relationships
A strong team player who is comfortable working collaboratively with others
What we offer
EY GDS is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to creative consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
