Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Support the preparation of periodic financial statements, including the Balance Sheet, Statement of Operations, Statement of Changes in Equity, Cash Flow Statement, and related disclosures in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
Assist in preparing financial statements supporting schedules, lead schedules, reconciliations, and audit-ready working papers to ensure completeness and accuracy.

Assist in the calculation and review of management fees, incentive/carried interest allocations, and related supporting schedules in accordance with fund governing documents.

Perform analytical reviews and tie-outs between financial statements, supporting schedules, trial balance, and underlying accounting records.
Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, including journal preparation, balance sheet reconciliations, and reporting deliverables.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders, auditors, and onshore teams to address queries and provide supporting documentation during financial reporting and audit cycles.
Maintain high standards of accuracy, documentation, and internal controls while supporting process improvement initiatives and undertaking ad-hoc accounting and reporting assignments as required

MBA (Finance), CFA (Level I/II), CA (Inter), or an equivalent qualification with a strong academic background in Accounting and Finance.
Strong conceptual understanding of financial accounting, financial statement preparation, and accounting principles.
Familiarity with Private Equity, Private Credit, or Alternative Investment Fund structures will be an added advantage.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and data analysis. Exposure to accounting or ERP systems will be an advantage.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Location: Mumbai / Pune /Chandigarh / Bangalore
Industry: EdTech / Education / Online Learning
Department: Sales, Admissions & Student Counselling
Experience: 1 to 3 Years (Freshers with Excellent Communication Skills are also Welcome)

Job Description

We are looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented professionals to join our growing EdTech team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for counselling prospective students, promoting educational programs, managing leads, and driving admissions and course enrolments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Connect with prospective students through inbound and outbound calls, emails, chats, and online platforms.

- Understand students' career goals and recommend suitable educational programs.
- Follow up with interested leads and convert enquiries into admissions and enrolments.
- Schedule video counselling sessions, online demos, and program discussions where required.
- Manage the complete sales funnel, from lead engagement to conversion.
- Achieve monthly admission and revenue targets.
- Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and sales reports using CRM tools and Excel.

Requirements
- Graduate in any discipline.

- Experienced candidates with backgrounds in EdTech Sales, B2C Sales, Admission Counselling, Academic Counselling, or Business Development are preferred for experienced positions.
- Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple leads.
- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and dialer operations.
- A customer-focused attitude with a passion for education and career counselling.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary as per experience, skills, and company norms.
- Attractive performance-based incentives.
- Opportunity to work in the growing EdTech and online education sector.

Reports to: Lead HR Retail (North and East)

Note: This role is on one year contract. Based on performance we can convert this role on-rolls, but if not then after one year the contract will terminate after one year

Location: Chandigarh (First two months in Gurgaon office)

Position Summary:
The Retail HR role partners closely with retail operations to support people-related initiatives across stores. The role focuses on driving hiring, employee engagement, capability development, and compliance while building a strong connect with store teams and supporting the overall employee experience in the region

Key Objectives:
Manage the end-to-end employee lifecycle for retail employees including recruitment, onboarding, engagement initiatives, training and development, and exit interviews.
Drive hiring across retail stores by identifying and leveraging both internal and external recruitment sources to ensure timely closure of open positions.
Partner with retail operations stakeholders and store managers to understand manpower requirements and support people-related decisions across stores.
Assess behavioral and capability development needs of store employees and coordinate relevant training programs with internal or external trainers.
Plan and manage the monthly employee engagement calendar across stores to strengthen employee connect and morale.
Coordinate and ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs for retail employees.
Conduct regular store visits to interact with employees, gather feedback, understand on-ground challenges, and support resolution of employee concerns.
Track attrition trends and employee feedback across stores and work with business leaders to drive retention and employee experience initiatives.
Ensure effective implementation of company policies across stores and monitor compliance with statutory requirements, including maintenance of statutory registers and documentation.
Actively participate in various company forums and people initiatives within the organization.

Eligibility Criteria and Functional Competencies Required:
MBA / PGDM students specializing in HR or related fields.
2-4 years of HR experience, preferably in retail, hospitality, or other customer-facing industries.
Prior experience in managing store hiring, employee engagement, and HR operations will be an advantage.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with multiple stakeholders.

Job Description: The Client Service Associate at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.

Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries and drive regular engagement/quick response
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions)
CS Engagement via Ticketing module, getting timely response; Keep active track of timely closure of tickets
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements, claim monitoring
Analyzeandsupport with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels

Customer-centric approach: A deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to keep focus on their issue is a fast paced and complex environment
Problem-solving skills: You must be adept at analyzing customer issues, identifying root causes, and providing appropriate solutions or escalating matters as needed.
Time management: The ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple inquiries simultaneously, and meet deadlines is essential for efficient customer service delivery.
Familiarity with customer-relationship management (CRM) software programs

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV). Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate. Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition.


Qualifications
Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Summary
Provides technical expertise and serves as a primary customer support contact for diagnosing, troubleshooting, and executing complex repairs and maintenance of engine products at customer sites. Applies advanced diagnostic skills, specialized tools, service procedures, and product knowledge to ensure timely and effective resolution of customer issues while maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and customer service.
Key Responsibilities
Establishes and maintains productive customer relationships, ensuring prompt, professional, and efficient attention to customer needs.
Diagnoses and completes complex repairs on engine products at customer sites using specialized tools, diagnostic equipment, service publications, and documented procedures.
Performs preventive maintenance activities on engines and related components in accordance with documented schedules, standards, and service requirements.
Troubleshoots mechanical, electrical, electronic, fuel, cooling, exhaust, aftertreatment, driveline, controls, and sensor-related systems to identify root causes and resolve product issues.
Uses electronic service tools, software, and diagnostic equipment to interpret fault information, identify failed components, and determine appropriate repair actions.
Validates completed repairs by confirming that the original customer concern has been resolved and the product is operating as expected.
Escalates unresolved or complex technical issues to product specialists, technical experts, or supervisors, providing complete troubleshooting details and relevant technical information.
Provides technical guidance, coaching, and knowledge transfer to technicians and apprentices; may provide work direction and review repair plans, parts lists, and related technical requirements.
Completes accurate service documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents, customer/equipment information, and technical records through applicable systems or forms.
Identifies additional service and sales opportunities based on customer requirements and product/service needs.
Completes required technical and functional training in line with business and skill requirements and actively develops technical capabilities.
Maintains service vehicles, tools, equipment, and work areas in a clean, safe, and operational condition.
Ensures compliance with all applicable Health, Safety Environmental policies, procedures, standards, and legislation.
Reports safety concerns, incidents, and other HSE issues to site management and the appropriate supervisor.
Supports continuous improvement by sharing technical knowledge, field insights, and opportunities to improve service processes and customer experience.
Key Responsibilities:
Service Delivery Monitoring :
Oversee Service Delivery Process (SDP) at dealerships, conduct audits, identify gaps, and drive improvements for a robust process.
Daily review and closure of critical breakdown and running-with-problem events by coordinating with customers, dealerships, and process owners.
Customer and Dealer Relationship Management :
Build strong relationships with key customers, proactively conduct customer visits, and address their concerns effectively.
Conduct monthly/quarterly meetings with OEMs/GOEMs and document actions for closure.
Performance Management :
Monitor Net Promoter Score (NPS) at dealerships, analyze detractors/passives, and implement improvements.
Review service KPIs, initiatives like SQM, Service Touch, Warranty, CEIT, and customer escalations with stakeholders.
Process Improvement :
Ensure compliance with NEPI BCD requirements and facilitate dealership visits for alignment.
Conduct dealer score audits, share improvement recommendations, and work towards target achievement.
Enhance Preventive Maintenance Compliance of Alternators / NGPI Compliance
Technical Support and Knowledge Sharing :
Investigate product/system problems, identify causes, recommend solutions, and document findings.
Share knowledge via Knowledge Management Systems (KMS), QSOL tickets, and training sessions.
Provide onsite technical expertise as needed and assist in field action campaigns and VPI programs.
Implement proactive and efficient SRN review and monitoring process to minimize downtime of electrical and controls components.
Training and Capability Building :
Identify skill gaps in dealership engineers and collaborate with HODs to enhance technical team capabilities.
Product Quality and Feedback :
Report product quality issues and unusual observations to relevant teams for resolution.
Audit and Compliance :
Conduct FSR/FSPR audits to ensure quality and hygiene, focusing on global failed codes.
Qualifications and Competencies
Competencies:
Field Investigation and Support : Gathers and communicates technical information, both internally and externally, between technical problem solvers and the service channel about product or process-related issues using proven problem-solving techniques.
Product Failure Reporting and Corrective/Preventive Action Systems : Defines and leads a process to record, prioritize, and resolve product failures using cross-functional reviews, rigorous problem-solving methods, failed parts transfer processes, data management tools, and project management practices.
Product Problem Solving : Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.
Technical Customer Management : Represents Cummins to customers by being the interface for all technical aspects; provides engineering data, documentation, and training to customers to support the design and integration of equipment.
Being Resilient : Rebounding from setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations.
Collaborates : Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
Communicates Effectively : Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
Customer Focus : Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
Drives Results : Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
Manages Complexity : Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
Resourcefulness : Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
Diagnostics Application : Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plans; troubleshoots issues following guided workflows, procedures, specialized equipment, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What Youll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity: Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to conduct research and interpret information from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong learning mindset, professional attitude, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.


Qualifications
"Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline."


Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Designer

Manager
Parallel Jobs

Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Student Counselling: Provide expert guidance to students regarding course selection and

Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
GOV: Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Minimum 5 years of experience in consulting, advisory, strategy, research, analytics, policy, or project management. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in conducting research, stakeholder engagement, interviews, and quantitative and qualitative analysis. Excellent communication, report-writing, and presentation development skills. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage diverse stakeholders. Strong client management and project coordination skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other analytical and reporting tools. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes. Experience in government advisory, public policy, economic development, institutional strengthening, or transformation projects will be an added advantage. Engage with clients to understand business challenges and deliver practical, evidence-based solutions. Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of consulting and advisory assignments across government, public sector, and private sector engagements. Conduct market assessments, policy research, stakeholder consultations, and data analysis to generate meaningful insights and recommendations. Prepare high-quality reports, presentations, strategy papers, business cases, and other client deliverables. Develop financial, operational, and impact assessments to support informed decision-making. Work closely with project teams, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Build and maintain strong client relationships while ensuring high standards of service and professionalism.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
Any Post Graduation
Experience
5+ years of overall experience
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Summary
Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh


Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to conduct research and interpret information from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong learning mindset, professional attitude, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.


Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have
Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements.
You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.
We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Title: Interior Designer Livspace
Locations: Chandigarh | Indore | Bhopal
About Livspace
Livspace is a leading home interiors and renovation platform that simplifies the home interiors journey for homeowners. We combine design, technology, and execution excellence to create beautiful, functional spaces.
Role Overview
As an Interior Designer at Livspace, you will own projects end-to-end, from the first client interaction to final closure. You will combine design expertise, customer empathy, and business ownership to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve business goals.
Key Responsibilities
Translate customer requirements into functional and aesthetically appealing space plans.
Own and deliver complete interior design deliverables.
Provide an exceptional, trust-led customer experience.
Manage the project pipeline and achieve monthly revenue targets.
Ensure a smooth and seamless handover of projects to execution teams.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of experience in residential interiors, including modular interiors and space planning.
Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, B.Arch, or equivalent qualification; alternatively, a 2–3 year diploma with 2+ years of residential interiors experience.
Proficiency in AutoCAD or similar design tools.
Experience in client-facing roles or design-and-build environments.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
High ownership mindset and comfort working in a target-driven environment.
Interested candidates can share their profiles at:

OXYZO Financial Services Ltd is a leading Fintech NBFC headquartered in Gurugram.

Description:
Were Hiring: DevOps Engineers & Cloud Reliability Experts
(40+ Openings | 3 - 20 Yrs Exp | Multiple Roles)

Location: Mumbai / Pune / Chandigarh / Gurugram / Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Chennai
Specific location, shift timings, and work model may vary by position and role.
Industry: Fortune 500 Client Projects (Staffing via Hatchtra)
Employment Type: Full-Time | Permanent | Contract

About the Opportunity
Join us as we scale DevOps and Cloud Reliability practices for multiple Fortune 500 companies. We are looking for experienced professionals (3 - 20 years) to architect, build, and optimize enterprise-grade DevOps ecosystems.

If youre passionate about automation, cloud, reliability engineering, and scaling deployments, this is your chance to work on high-impact projects with global enterprises.

Open Positions & Designations
Were hiring across multiple seniority levels:
DevOps Engineers
(3 5 Yrs) – Engineer, Senior Engineer
Site Reliability Engineers (SRE)
(5 – 10 Yrs) – SRE, Senior SRE
Cloud & Platform Engineers
(5 – 10 Yrs) – AWS/Azure/GCP Specialists, Cloud Automation Engineers
DevSecOps Engineers
(5 – 12 Yrs) – Security-Focused DevOps, Cloud Security Engineers
Infrastructure Engineers
(5 – 10 Yrs) – Systems Engineers, Network Automation Engineers
Leadership Roles
(10 – 20 Yrs) – DevOps Manager, Head of Cloud Engineering, Director – DevOps

Key Responsibilities (Scale with Level)
Professional (3 – 5 Yrs)
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for applications and microservices.
Support cloud-based infrastructure provisioning and automation.
Troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis.
Collaborate with QA, development, and operations teams for smooth deployments.
Write scripts (Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation and monitoring.
Contribute to DevOps documentation and playbooks.

Mid-Level (5 – 10 Yrs)
Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments.
Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning using IaC tools (Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi).
Manage Kubernetes clusters, containerized workloads, and microservices deployments.
Implement observability solutions with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Splunk.
Lead incident management, production troubleshooting, and escalation processes.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to DevOps best practices.

Senior/Leadership (10 – 20 Yrs)
Define and execute DevOps/SRE strategy for enterprise-scale, multi-cloud ecosystems.
Drive cloud migration, cost optimization, and governance initiatives for clients.
Oversee security automation and DevSecOps integration at all delivery stages.
Establish standards for CI/CD, observability, reliability, and automation at scale.
Collaborate with client executives, architects, and engineering heads to define tech roadmaps.
Build and lead high-performing DevOps teams, coaching engineers and architects to deliver excellence.

Tech Stack & Tools
CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Spinnaker
Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
Containerization & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift
IaC & Automation: Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi, Helm
Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, Datadog
Security & DevSecOps: Aqua, Prisma, HashiCorp Vault, Snyk
Scripting & Programming: Python, Bash, PowerShell, Go
Version Control: Git, Bitbucket

Qualifications
Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or equivalent
3+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering
Hands-on expertise in CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and IaC
Strong knowledge of Linux/Windows systems, networking, and cloud computing
Understanding of observability, SRE principles, and incident response
For senior roles: proven leadership in driving DevOps culture in enterprises
Certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes) are a strong plus
AboutCompany:
About Hatchtra Innotech

Hatchtra Innotech is a growing organization focused on IT services, staffing, and corporate training. We help businesses succeed while creating meaningful career opportunities for professionals like you.

From end-to-end IT project delivery (development, testing, deployment, and support) to flexible staffing solutions, we work across diverse domains and technologies. We also offer certified training programs, customized learning paths, and expert-led sessions to help you continuously upgrade your skills.

With 70+ clients, we provide a platform where you can gain real-world experience, learn from industry experts, and grow in a supportive and collaborative environment.

Why Join Us

Work on real, impactful projects
Learn continuously and grow your skills
Collaborate with experienced professionals
Build a strong and rewarding career path

If you're looking to learn, grow, and make an impactwe’d love to have you with us.

Description:
We're Hiring: Cloud Engineers AWS | Azure | GCP

(Multiple Openings | 4 - 10 Years Experience | Multiple Levels)
Location: Pune / Mumbai / Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Gurugram / Chandigarh / Chennai
Specific location and work model may vary by position and role.
Industry: Fortune 500 Client Projects (Staffing via Hatchtra)
Employment Type: Permanent | Contract

About the Role
We are looking for experienced Cloud Engineers specializing in AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to design, implement, manage, and optimize scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure.

The ideal candidates will have strong hands-on experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure provisioning, networking, security, automation, monitoring, and cloud operations. Candidates should be capable of managing cloud environments, troubleshooting infrastructure issues, optimizing performance and costs, and supporting enterprise-scale cloud transformation initiatives.

Open Positions & Designations
AWS Cloud Engineering
AWS Cloud Engineer (4 - 6 Years)
Senior AWS Cloud Engineer (6 8 Years)
Lead AWS Cloud Engineer (8 10 Years)
AWS Cloud Architect / Technical Specialist (8 – 10 Years)

Microsoft Azure Cloud Engineering
Azure Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Lead Azure Cloud Engineer (8 – 10 Years)
Azure Cloud Architect / Technical Specialist (8 – 10 Years)

Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Engineering
GCP Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Senior GCP Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Lead GCP Cloud Engineer (8 – 10 Years)
GCP Cloud Architect / Technical Specialist (8 – 10 Years)

1. AWS Cloud Engineer (4 – 10 Years)

Key Responsibilities
AWS Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Provision, configure, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure.
Work with EC2, S3, EBS, VPC, IAM, RDS, ELB, and Auto Scaling.
Configure cloud networking, subnets, route tables, security groups, and network access controls.
Implement infrastructure automation using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or similar tools.
Monitor cloud resources using Amazon CloudWatch and configure alerts.
Manage backups, snapshots, patching, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
Implement IAM roles, policies, encryption, and security best practices.
Support application deployment, cloud migration, and operational activities.

Senior AWS Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Design and implement scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant AWS environments.
Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules using Terraform or CloudFormation.
Configure advanced networking, including Transit Gateway, VPC peering, VPN, and Direct Connect.
Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated infrastructure deployment.
Optimize cloud performance, availability, resource utilization, and costs.
Implement disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity strategies.
Work with ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, and other cloud-native services as required.
Establish monitoring, logging, security controls, and operational best practices.
Mentor junior engineers and conduct technical reviews.

Lead AWS Cloud Engineer / Architect ( 8 – 10 Years)
Architect enterprise-scale AWS cloud environments and landing zones.
Define cloud architecture standards, governance policies, and deployment patterns.
Lead cloud migration, modernization, and infrastructure transformation initiatives.
Design multi-account strategies, hybrid cloud connectivity, and disaster recovery solutions.
Drive security, compliance, resilience, and FinOps initiatives.
Establish automation frameworks and standardized IaC practices.
Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, and cloud engineering teams.
Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and enterprise architecture teams.

AWS Skills & Tools
Core Services: EC2, S3, EBS, EFS, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda
Networking: VPC, Route 53, ELB/ALB/NLB, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect
Security: IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, Security Groups, AWS Organizations
Containers: Docker, ECS, EKS, ECR
IaC & Automation: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Python, Bash
Monitoring: CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS Config
DevOps: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline
Additional Services: SQS, SNS, API Gateway, Systems Manager, AWS Backup

2. Azure Cloud Engineer (4 – 10 Years)
Key Responsibilities
Azure Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Provision, configure, and manage Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure.
Work with Azure Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL, and Virtual Networks.
Configure subnets, NSGs, route tables, VPN Gateway, and network connectivity.
Manage Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, and access policies.
Automate infrastructure deployment using Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep.
Monitor resources using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and alerts.
Support backup, recovery, patching, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
Assist with application deployment, cloud migration, and operational support.

Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Design scalable, resilient, and secure Azure cloud environments.
Implement enterprise networking using VNet peering, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, and Azure Firewall.
Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code modules using Terraform or Bicep.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments.
Configure Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure App Service, Functions, and container services.
Implement monitoring, logging, security policies, and compliance controls.
Optimize resource utilization, performance, availability, and cloud expenditure.
Design backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to cloud architecture decisions.

Lead Azure Cloud Engineer / Architect (8 – 10 Years)
Architect enterprise-grade Azure environments, landing zones, and subscription structures.
Define cloud governance, security baselines, resource organization, and policy standards.
Lead Azure migration, modernization, and hybrid cloud initiatives.
Design identity, network, security, and connectivity architectures.
Establish automation frameworks, reusable IaC modules, and deployment standards.
Drive cost optimization, resilience, compliance, and operational excellence.
Lead architecture reviews, technical planning, and engineering teams.
Collaborate with enterprise architecture, security, DevOps, and application teams.

Azure Skills & Tools
Core Services: Azure VMs, Storage Accounts, Azure SQL, Azure Files
Networking: VNet, NSG, Azure Firewall, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute
Identity & Security: Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Key Vault, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud
Containers: AKS, Azure Container Registry, Docker
IaC & Automation: Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, Ansible, PowerShell, Azure CLI
Monitoring: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights
DevOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines
Additional Services: Azure Functions, App Service, Azure Backup, Site Recovery

3. GCP Cloud Engineer (4 – 10 Years)
Key Responsibilities
GCP Cloud Engineer (4 – 6 Years)
Provision, configure, and manage Google Cloud Platform infrastructure.
Work with Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
Configure VPC networks, subnets, firewall rules, routes, and Cloud NAT.
Manage IAM roles, service accounts, and access permissions.
Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and Google Cloud deployment tools.
Monitor cloud resources using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging.
Support backups, recovery, patching, and cloud infrastructure troubleshooting.
Assist with application deployment, migration, and cloud operations.

Senior GCP Cloud Engineer (6 – 8 Years)
Design scalable, highly available, and secure GCP environments.
Implement advanced networking, including Shared VPC, VPC peering, Cloud VPN, and Cloud Interconnect.
Build reusable Infrastructure as Code modules using Terraform.
Deploy and manage workloads using GKE, Cloud Run, and Compute Engine.
Implement CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.
Configure centralized logging, monitoring, alerting, and operational dashboards.
Optimize cloud performance, resource utilization, and infrastructure costs.
Implement backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
Support security, compliance, and cloud governance initiatives.
Mentor junior engineers and review technical implementations.

Lead GCP Cloud Engineer / Architect (8 – 10 Years)
Architect enterprise-scale GCP infrastructure and cloud landing zones.
Define organization structures, folder hierarchies, project strategies, and governance controls.
Lead cloud migration, modernization, and hybrid connectivity initiatives.
Design secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures.
Establish reusable Terraform modules and standardized deployment frameworks.
Drive cost optimization, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
Lead technical architecture reviews and provide guidance to cloud engineering teams.
Collaborate with data engineering, application development, security, and DevOps teams.

GCP Skills & Tools
Core Services: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Firestore
Networking: VPC, Shared VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud NAT, Cloud VPN, Cloud Interconnect, Cloud DNS
Identity & Security: Cloud IAM, Service Accounts, Cloud KMS, Secret Manager, Organization Policy
Containers: GKE, Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Docker
IaC & Automation: Terraform, Google Cloud CLI, Ansible, Python, Bash
Monitoring: Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, Cloud Audit Logs
DevOps: Cloud Build, Cloud Deploy, Jenkins, GitHub Actions
Additional Services: Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Backup and DR services

Common Skills Across All Cloud Platforms
Operating Systems: Linux, Windows Server
Cloud Fundamentals: Virtualization, networking, compute, storage, identity, and access management
Infrastructure as Code: Terraform and platform-native provisioning tools
Scripting: Python, Bash, PowerShell
Networking: DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN, firewalls, load balancing
DevOps: Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes
Monitoring & Operations: Logging, alerting, incident management, root cause analysis
Security: Least-privilege access, encryption, vulnerability management, compliance
ITSM: Incident, change, problem, and service request management
Documentation: Architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and technical documentation

Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
4 – 10 years of professional experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, cloud operations, or cloud architecture.
Strong hands-on expertise in at least one primary cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or GCP.
Experience designing, deploying, and maintaining secure and scalable cloud environments.
Proficiency in cloud networking, IAM, compute, storage, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform and/or platform-native tools.
Understanding of CI/CD, automation, containerization, and DevOps practices.
Experience with cloud security, backup, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Relevant cloud certifications are preferred.
Experience with enterprise environments, cloud migration, hybrid cloud, and distributed systems is an advantage.

Preferred Certifications
AWS: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate
Azure: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert
GCP: Associate Cloud Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect

Description:
ABOUT SAPCON STEELS PRIVATE LIMITED
At Sapcon, we don't just trade steel - we power the backbone of India's industrial growth. As one of the country's leading names in steel and industrial commodities, we've built our reputation on a simple promise: the right material, to the right customer, at the right time, every time.
With 35+ strategically located supply hubs across India and trusted partnerships with industry titans like JSPL, AMNS, SAIL and JSW, we sit at the intersection of scale and agility. From automotive plants and shipyards to solar farms, HVAC manufacturers, and the infrastructure shaping India's skylines, our steel moves industries forward.
Join us, and your work will directly fuel the projects transforming a nation.
Key responsibilities
Administer and configure the CRM: users, roles, permissions, profiles, fields, page layouts, and picklists
Build and maintain automations, including workflows, approval processes, assignment rules, and email templates
Own data quality: run regular de-duplication, imports and exports, validation rules, and data cleanup
Create and maintain reports and dashboards for sales pipeline, lead conversion, forecasting, and team performance
Reconcile CRM data with ERP and finance systems (orders, invoices, collections)
Research and build targeted lead lists by industry, region, company size, and product fit
Enrich leads with company data such as turnover, capacity, products, GST/registration details, and location
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field
2–4 years of hands-on experience administering a CRM such as Salesforce, Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Frappe CRM
Strong grasp of sales processes: lead to order cycle
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 especially Excel, including lookups, pivots, and data cleaning
Experience building reports and dashboards
Nice to have
CRM certification (e.g. Salesforce Certified Administrator, Zoho CRM Certified)
Basic knowledge of AI, SQL, APIs, or low-code automation tools (Zapier, Power Automate)
Detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable managing multiple requests

Description:
Role Description:
This is a full-time, on-site Product Promotion Manager role based in Chandigarh, with a field-based business development focus. As a key member of the BMA team, you will be responsible for driving the strategic expansion of Bharat Medtec Ascents innovative and patented product portfolio across Chandigarh and the adjoining northern region. This leadership-oriented role requires a seasoned professional who can navigate complex hospital procurement cycles, build high-level clinical partnerships, and execute effective market-entry strategies for new medical technologies. The role also involves engaging with hospitals and healthcare providers, gathering market and customer feedback, and sharing insights with product and leadership teams to refine product positioning and strategy. The Product Promotion Manager will track key performance metrics, prepare regular reports, and contribute to building scalable and repeatable business development frameworks for multiple Medtec products.

Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Market Expansion: Identify and penetrate untapped market segments within corporate hospital chains, government institutions, and private nursing homes across the assigned region.
Key Account Management: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), hospital administrators, and procurement heads.
Clinical Collaboration: Partner with surgical and medical teams to conduct product demonstrations, coordinate clinical training, and promote specialised devices through value-based selling.
Regulatory & Compliance: Ensure all business activities comply with applicable guidelines and international ethical standards for medical device marketing.
Tender Management: Lead the end-to-end institutional tender process, from technical specification development to commercial bid submission.

Required Qualifications & Skills:
Experience: Minimum 8-10 years of proven experience in medical device sales or business development. Experience in Neurology, Cardiology, Diagnostics, or other therapy areas is welcome.
Education: Bachelors degree in Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, or Pharmacy. An MBA in Marketing or Healthcare Management is highly desirable.
Regional Expertise: An established professional network within the Chandigarh healthcare ecosystem is highly desirable.
Technical Proficiency: Ability to discuss complex clinical outcomes and technical specifications with senior surgeons and specialists.
Analytical Prowess: Proficiency in market mapping, competitor analysis, and CRM-driven sales forecasting.
AboutCompany:
About Bharat Medtec Ascent (BMA)
Bharat MedTec Ascent (BMA), an initiative of HS Foundation India, is a product promotion platform dedicated to helping Indian MedTech startups successfully commercialise their innovations. We bridge the gap between product development and market adoption by enabling validated medical technologies to reach healthcare providers and patients across India.
Through a structured Product Promotion Program, BMA supports startups in building commercial readiness, strengthening clinician engagement, expanding sales and distribution networks, facilitating product adoption in both government and private hospitals, and enabling access to institutional procurement and tender opportunities. Backed by 40+ experienced product promotion professionals, clinical experts, and industry partners, we help innovators navigate the complexities of the healthcare market and accelerate sustainable growth.
Our mission is to enable indigenous MedTech innovations to scale faster, strengthen India's healthcare ecosystem, and contribute to a self-reliant future in medical technology.

NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde is one of the largest healthcare systems in the UK employing around 40,000 staff in a wide range of clinical and non-clinical professions and job roles
We deliver acute hospital, primary, community and mental health care services to a population of over 1
15 million and a wider population of 2
2 million when our regional and national services are included
In order to apply to for this position you must have a live pin with the NMC UK
The shift pattern for this position is rotational, days, nights and weekends
(Please note the salary is Pro Rata) for part time hours
Due to service expansion an exciting opportunity has arisen for Band 5 Registered Nurses to join our growing Orthopaedic elective surgery unit within Gartnavel General Hospital
The successful candidate will be an integral member of the elective in-patient team, providing high quality nursing care for those undergoing elective orthopaedic procedures
You will have delegated responsibilities for assessing, planning, implementing and evaluating care
You will work to support the nursing team in the provision of safe and effective clinical practice and assist in enhancing the patient experience
You will work collaboratively within a well-established and supportive multi-disciplinary team to meet standards in elective orthopaedic care

Within the department we offer a comprehensive programme of education and support to enhance your development within the specialty
You will demonstrate a willingness to undertake in-service training in order to gain competency in areas such as pain management & wound care
You will be responsible to the Senior Charge Nurse and should be able to work on your own merit supported by the wider nursing team
You should be educated to degree level or equivalent
Experience in a surgical specialty is desirable but not essential

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Account Partner Relationship Management

Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English

Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.

Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.

Steel Sales and Business Development
Strategic Sales Planning
B2B Sales and Key Account Management
Team Leadership and Sales Team Management
Customer Relationship Management
Negotiation and Commercial Skills
Market Analysis and Competitor Research
Revenue Growth and Sales Target Achievement
Sales Forecasting and Business Planning
Strong Communication and Interpersonal Skills


Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate will be a proactive sales professional with strong industry connections, a customer-focused approach, excellent leadership abilities, and the capability to develop long-term business relationships while driving sustainable revenue growth.

Interested candidates with relevant experience in steel sales and business development are encouraged to apply.

Education: A bachelor's degree is usually required, with a preference for degrees in Supply Chain Management or Logistics.

Description:
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.
Position Overview
The Government of Jharkhand, in partnership with Room to Read and Jharkhand Education Project Council (JEPC), is establishing a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) to enhance the quality of education in the state, with a specific focus on Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN). As part of this initiative, Balvatika will focus on early childhood learning interventions for children in the 3-6 age group. The Associate will report directly to Officer, Literacy at State and will support the planning, implementation, and monitoring of Balvatika-related interventions across the state.
Responsibilities
Support the design and rollout of Balvatika interventions aligned with NCERT guidelines and NIPUN Bharat mission.
Contribute to creating developmentally appropriate, contextualized curriculum and other instructional material with the adaptation of the National Early Childhood Education Curriculum, Adhaarshila , to the Jharkhand context.
Coordinate with JEPC, SCERT, and DIETs to align early learning goals with the state s academic calendar and training plans.
Assist in developing the Training content, including framework, training modules.
Organize and support training programs for teachers, Anganwadi workers, and master trainers at state, district, and block levels.
Participate in classroom observations and learning assessments at selected sites.
Provide feedback to improve ECE delivery and the learning environment based on the observation findings.
Monitor implementation progress of Balvatika components in identified schools and Anganwadi-linked Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE) centers.
Conduct field visits and collect qualitative and quantitative data on early learning indicators.
Prepare documentation, progress reports, and case studies highlighting best practices and challenges.
Provide administrative and technical support to the SPMU team related to early childhood education.
Liaise with stakeholders including government bodies, partners, and academic institutions.
Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in Education, Child Development, Social Work, or relevant field. Master s degree preferred.
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in early childhood education, FLN projects, or related development sector roles.
Strong understanding of pedagogy in Early childhood years. Effective learning ways for children, the role of the classroom environment in learning.
Understanding of ECCE curriculum and NIPUN Bharat guidelines.
Proficient in data collection, analysis, and report writing.
Experience working with government systems, particularly in Jharkhand or similar contexts.
Strong communication skills in Hindi and English.
Willingness to travel extensively within the state.
