Job Summary
The Government of Jharkhand, in partnership with Room to Read and Jharkhand Education Project Council (JEPC), is establishing a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) to enhance the quality of education in the state, with a specific focus on Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN). As part of this initiative, Balvatika will focus on early childhood learning interventions for children in the 3-6 age group. The Associate will report directly to Officer, Literacy at State and will support the planning, implementation, and monitoring of Balvatika-related interventions across the state.
Responsibilities
Support the design and rollout of Balvatika interventions aligned with NCERT guidelines and NIPUN Bharat mission.
Contribute to creating developmentally appropriate, contextualized curriculum and other instructional material with the adaptation of the National Early Childhood Education Curriculum, Adhaarshila, to the Jharkhand context.
Coordinate with JEPC, SCERT, and DIETs to align early learning goals with the state s academic calendar and training plans.
Assist in developing the Training content, including framework, training modules.
Organize and support training programs for teachers, Anganwadi workers, and master trainers at state, district, and block levels.
Participate in classroom observations and learning assessments at selected sites.
Provide feedback to improve ECE delivery and the learning environment based on the observation findings.
Monitor implementation progress of Balvatika components in identified schools and Anganwadi-linked Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE) centers.
Conduct field visits and collect qualitative and quantitative data on early learning indicators.
Prepare documentation, progress reports, and case studies highlighting best practices and challenges.
Provide administrative and technical support to the SPMU team related to early childhood education.
Liaise with stakeholders including government bodies, partners, and academic institutions.
Qualifications
Bachelor s degree in Education, Child Development, Social Work, or relevant field. Master s degree preferred.
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in early childhood education, FLN projects, or related development sector roles.
Strong understanding of pedagogy in Early childhood years. Effective learning ways for children, the role of the classroom environment in learning.
Understanding of ECCE curriculum and NIPUN Bharat guidelines.
Proficient in data collection, analysis, and report writing.
Experience working with government systems, particularly in Jharkhand or similar contexts.
Strong communication skills in Hindi and English.
Willingness to travel extensively within the state.

Description:
About the role
The Specialist Supplier Quality - provides subject matter expertise within the area of QA/QC at supplier s premises to ensure that all raw material & packaging material supplied by the vendors are within the specification tolerance limit and improve the consistency in Quality of RM/PM.
What you will be doing
Develop the specifications of all the RM and PM, implement at supplier s premises.
Find the gap in supplier/vendor manufacturing process and fill the gaps.
Increase the awareness about the need and expectations about Quality among suppliers of Orica.
Act as change management for cultural change at suppliers premises.
Assure that raw material and packaging material provided is fit to purpose, consistent, and meets internal and external requirements including legal requirements and internal/external customers expectations.
Develop cost effective solutions in quality, safety and process performance ensuring that the effort and cost of achieving engineering safety and quality is commensurate with risk.
Adequate and effective communication with suppliers, customers and Internal and External stakeholders regarding complaints, quality issues, expectations, delivery standards and actions to solve each nonconformity.
Develop and implement a strategy (training plan, training materials, techniques, tools, Alerts & Snippets systems) as the SME where applicable (Subject Matter Expert) in order to assure that suppliers deliver material as per the specification.
Lead the site in process improvement (MPI) strategies and One Manufacturing implementation, developing, and implementing LEAN & Six Sigma thinking methodologies (5S, Kaizen, A3s, VSM, work & time studies, etc.) across Manufacturing process.
Assist Quality Manager on improvement idea generation and execution in collaboration with production plant owners, to guarantee all personal is aware of performance and information is showed in a standard manner through the plant.
Develop and maintain knowledge and skills by networking and collaboration with other relevant Quality, Technology and Product line Leaders globally and regionally.
Manages and supports implementation of Quality Management System according to ISO 9001 at supplies premises.
Develop the test methods for critical hazardous Chemicals and raw materials.
Demonstrate and instill a fundamental commitment to all Quality & SHE standards. Identify and evaluate all the major hazards of operations, as well as participate in critical controls and risk mitigation activities. Act as a role model in Quality & Safety-related behaviors.
Contribute to the incidents (including process safety incidents) investigation and participate in the action plan implementation to reinforce a Safety Culture at Plants.
Develop and train lab operators on daily sample analysis and fast decision-making process.
Coordinate with procurement, plant, SCM, supplier and resolve the issued related to RM, PM, intermediate and finish goods
What you will bring
M.Sc in Chemistry, B.Sc in Chemistry, or B.Tech in Chemical Engineering.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in Supplier Quality or Supplier Quality Management within the Chemical, Fertilizer, Pharmaceutical, Explosive, or Industrial sectors.
At least 3 years of laboratory experience in Chemical Analysis.
Certified Lead/Internal Auditor for ISO 9001:2015.
Proficient in Statistical Analysis and Tools (SPC, SQC, Sampling, Root Cause Analysis, etc.).
Willingness to travel to vendor/supplier locations.
Strong leadership skills to motivate and inspire others.
Excellent communication abilities.
Commitment to standards and performance metrics.
Proactive and results-oriented.
Analytical mindset with a structured approach.
Ability to think conceptually.
Customer service-focused.
Detail-oriented and thorough.
Driven to enhance operational performance.
What we offer
As part of a truly global company, you will have the ability to grow and learn in a diverse, collaborative culture. We foster relationships and learning through connected global and local teams, promote flexible and diverse career paths and support the development of your knowledge and skills.
You will be paid a competitive salary, learn from talented individuals across multiple disciplines and be able to thrive in a safe workplace within a collaborative culture. Ignite your career at a place where your distinct potential can find its home.
We respect and value all
Orica promotes and fosters a culture of inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment everywhere we operate. We treat our people and applicants with fairness, dignity, and respect, getting the best of everyone s contributions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, nationality, age, military or veteran, marital or disability status.

Description:
Job Summary:
The Territory Sales - Field Sales Account Executive - Senior is responsible for driving business growth by identifying new sales opportunities, developing strong customer relationships, and executing account strategies within the assigned territory. The role focuses on achieving sales targets, delivering customer-centric solutions, managing key accounts, and collaborating with dealers and internal stakeholders to maximize business performance while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities:
Prospect, identify, research, and develop new business opportunities within the assigned territory.
Develop and execute account plans to grow existing business and acquire new customers.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships to understand business needs, buying behavior, and future requirements.
Present and position Cummins products, solutions, and services by clearly articulating the value proposition.
Conduct customer meetings, sales presentations, and negotiations in line with company policies and commercial guidelines.
Achieve assigned sales targets while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
Monitor sales forecasts, pipeline health, and account performance through CRM tools.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely product availability, service support, and delivery commitments.
Support collections and maintain healthy receivables by working with customers on overdue payments.
Resolve customer concerns promptly and strengthen long-term customer relationships.
Follow the Cummins Sales Process and utilize CRM systems and other sales tools effectively.
Mentor and provide guidance to less experienced sales professionals whenever required.
Territory-Specific Responsibilities
Drive Cummins aftermarket channel sales across the Bihar and Jharkhand region.
Lead dealer teams to improve per-engine revenue and overall business performance.
Drive sales campaigns, promotional activities, and business growth initiatives through dealer networks.
Act as the key interface between Cummins and customers to ensure superior customer experience and satisfaction.
Manage strategic key accounts, including large industrial and mining customers such as Tata Steel, Thriveni Earthmovers, and other major private mining customers.
Apart from above pre-requisites, the candidate will have responsibility of below points:-
Driving Cummins after-market channel sales in Bihar & Jharkhand Region
Leading dealer team for improving per Engine revenue
Leading dealer team for running sales campaigns and business initiatives
Ensuring Customer satisfaction by acting as a bridge between Cummins and Customer
Key account management of big ticket customers, such as Tata Steel, Thriveni Earthmovers, Private mining customers etc.
Competencies:
Customer Focus
Business Insight
Effective Communication
Articulating Value Proposition
Channel Awareness
Pricing Strategy
Negotiation Excellence
Account Planning
Developing Account Strategy
Sales Forecasting
Sales Pipeline Management
Sense Making and Customer Discovery
Integrating Customer Perspective
Ability to adapt communication to different audiences
Collaboration and Stakeholder Management
Values Differences and Inclusive Leadership


Education, Licenses, Certifications:
Bachelors degree in Marketing, Sales, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant sales experience.
Export control or sanctions-related licensing may be required depending on business requirements.
Skills & Experience
Intermediate level of relevant sales or business development experience.
Proven experience in territory sales, account management, or channel sales.
Experience managing dealer networks and driving aftermarket business is preferred.
Strong customer relationship management and key account management skills.
Experience handling commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, and contract execution.
Ability to analyze sales data, forecast demand, and manage sales pipelines effectively.
Working knowledge of CRM systems and sales management tools.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams.
Experience in industrial, automotive, heavy equipment, mining, or related sectors will be an added advantage.

About Swiggy: 
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city.
You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants - learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement.
This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success.
You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
-Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
-Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
-Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
-Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
-Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
-Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
-Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
-Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
-80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
-0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
-Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
-Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
-Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
-Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Summary:
Prospects and develops new opportunities to grow the business. Develops/Executes account plans with coaching support. Achieves sales goals within the assigned sales territory, market segment or channel partners.
Key Responsibilities:
Develops opportunities to increase sales by identifying, researching and contacting prospective customers. Develops and executes account plans for top prospects and conducts agreed upon face to face sales calls. Builds positive customer relationships that enable identification of a customer s needs, business model and buying process. Uses understanding of customer needs and priorities to identify and offer Cummins solutions. Gains agreement on the differential advantage of Cummins solutions by helping the customer understand and evaluate existing data and information and the value proposition. Conducts negotiations according to company guidelines, including payment terms. Assists with collection of accounts receivables. Maintains acceptable level of past due accounts. Collaborates with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve delinquent payments. Drives sales, achieving sales targets and ensuring customer satisfaction. Maintains and strengthens customer relationships to generate future sales and repeat business. Responds to customer concerns in a timely fashion. Consistently uses the Cummins Sales Process as well as Cummins tools, processes, and initiatives that support sales, customer satisfaction, and customer value, e. g. Customer Relationship Management and special projects. Reports activity via the Customer Relationship Management tool per management direction. Maintains Sales forecasts and tracks progress and accuracy against forecast As applicable, works with internal stakeholders and customers to balance inventory, service, and delivery capabilities with customer expectations.
Handling key mining accounts in Jharkhand, Railways account in Bihar.
Driving retail sales in Bihar and Jharkhand.
Competencies:
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Persuades - Using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others.

Articulating Value Proposition - Interprets internal and external customer needs based on relevant application; explains and demonstrates products, solutions, and services to distinguish strengths and weaknesses to meet customers specific needs to differentiate against competition.

Channel Awareness - Explains and contextualizes industry structure, dynamics, and path to market in order to advance organizational goals.

Pricing Strategy - Develops prices by aligning and building consensus with key stakeholders across functions to achieve business targets.

Negotiations Excellence - Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.

Account Planning - Identifies objectives to drive execution of business and/or account strategy by reviewing the status relative to where it needs to be and enabling tracking of progress against targets.

Adapts to target audience - Explains complex topics (significant technical data, subject matter expertise, etc. ) in such a way that the target audience (e. g. sales professionals, customers, training vendors, etc. ) can understand, retain, and use the information

Integrates Customer Perspective - Incorporates an understanding of the customers perspective on our products and sales efforts to develop sales content that improves our ability to meet their needs and increase revenue.

Sales Forecasting - Collects and assesses customer data from internal and external sources; compares against historical data to determine useful inputs and create a forecast of future consumption patterns.

Sales Pipeline Management - Plans proactively for successful execution of account/territory-level sales strategies and plans based on current pipeline; evaluates pipeline health (size, contents, progress); adjusts sales strategy, plans, or high impact activities accordingly; as applicable coaches sellers in order to achieve sales objectives.

Sense Making - Through a series of diagnostic and probing questions and research, develops and/or supports an intimate understanding of the customer needs, behaviors, and/or their buying journey. Synthesizes complex information from internal and external resources to deliver tailored solutions for the internal or external customer.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
Required: College, university, or equivalent degree in Marketing, Sales or a related subject, or acceptable sales related work experience, or an acceptable combination of education and experience.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Basic relevant work experience preferred.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick[1] up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Following the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority .

Description:
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance
Job Title: Manager - Training

The Manager - Training will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing training programs aimed at enhancing the skills and knowledge of employees within the organization. This role involves conducting training needs assessments, designing training materials, and delivering engaging training sessions. The Manager will work closely with various departments to ensure alignment of training programs with company objectives and employee performance metrics. Additionally, the role requires tracking and reporting on training effectiveness and participating in continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Conduct training needs assessments to identify gaps in employee skills and knowledge.
2. Design and develop training programs and materials tailored to various employee groups.
3. Deliver engaging and effective training sessions using various instructional techniques.
4. Collaborate with department heads to ensure training aligns with business goals.
5. Evaluate training effectiveness through surveys, assessments, and performance metrics.
6. Provide coaching and support to employees to reinforce learning outcomes.
7. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in training and development.
8. Manage training budgets and resources efficiently.

Skills and Tools Required:
1. Strong communication and presentation skills.
2. Ability to design and develop training materials and programs.
3. Knowledge of adult learning principles and training methodologies.
4. Proficiency in using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and training software.
5. Analytical skills to assess training effectiveness and make data-driven decisions.
6. Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
7. Project management skills to oversee training initiatives and meet deadlines.
8. Familiarity with performance management systems and tools.
9. Innovative thinking to create engaging and effective training solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
2. Proven experience in training and development within the insurance or financial services industry.
3. Certification in training or instructional design is a plus.

Description:
Job Responsibilities VAPT Engineer
Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) for web applications, APIs, networks, and IT infrastructure.
Conduct authenticated and unauthenticated vulnerability assessments to identify security weaknesses.
Execute manual penetration testing to validate vulnerabilities and assess their exploitability.
Use security testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Identify and validate security vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10 risks and common network security weaknesses.
Prepare detailed VAPT reports covering identified vulnerabilities, severity levels, technical evidence, risk impact, and remediation recommendations.
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to support vulnerability remediation.
Perform retesting after remediation and verify vulnerability closure.
Support secure code review and application security assessments.
Maintain VAPT documentation, testing procedures, and assessment records.
Support security compliance audits and assessments in accordance with applicable security standards and organizational policies.
Ensure all penetration testing activities are conducted within the approved scope and follow established security testing methodologies.
Required Technical Skills
Hands-on experience in VAPT and manual penetration testing.
Knowledge of web application, API, network, and infrastructure security testing.
Experience with Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus/Tenable, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, and Postman.
Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG).
Ability to prepare technical VAPT reports and recommend remediation measures.
Experience with vulnerability validation, remediation tracking, and retesting.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with practical experience executing penetration tests, validating vulnerabilities, preparing technical reports, and conducting remediation retesting are preferred. Candidates with experience limited to GRC, compliance, or reviewing third-party VAPT reports may not be suitable for this hands-on role.

Description:
About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
Operations Manager - The Vanda Hotel
Position: Operations Manager
Location: The Vanda Hotel
Reporting To: General Manager
Experience Required: 7-10 Years in the Hospitality Industry
Salary Package: 50,000 - 60,000 per month
Employment Type: Full-Time
About the Role
The Vanda Hotel is seeking a dynamic and experienced Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day hotel operations, ensure exceptional guest experiences, optimize operational efficiency, and support business growth. The incumbent will work closely with the General Manager and lead all operational departments to maintain high standards of service, profitability, and compliance.
______________
Key Responsibilities
Hotel Operations Management
Oversee daily operations of all hotel departments including Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Maintenance, Security, and Guest Relations.
Ensure smooth functioning of hotel operations while maintaining service excellence.
Monitor occupancy levels, guest satisfaction scores, and operational performance.
Guest Experience & Service Quality
Ensure superior guest service standards and prompt resolution of guest complaints.
Develop and implement service improvement initiatives.
Maintain high hospitality standards aligned with the hotel's brand image.
Team Leadership & People Management
Supervise, mentor, and motivate department heads and operational staff.
Conduct regular staff meetings, training sessions, and performance reviews.
Ensure adequate staffing and efficient workforce utilization.
Financial & Business Performance
Assist the General Manager in achieving revenue and profitability targets.
Monitor departmental budgets, operational costs, and inventory controls.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and revenue enhancement.


Compliance & Safety
Ensure compliance with hotel policies, statutory regulations, health & safety standards, and hospitality industry guidelines.
Conduct regular inspections and audits of hotel facilities and operations.
Maintain proper documentation and operational records.
Vendor & Facility Management
Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and service providers.
Ensure proper maintenance of hotel infrastructure and equipment.
Monitor procurement activities and stock management.
______________
Required Qualifications & Skills
Education
Bachelor's Degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Tourism Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Professional hospitality certifications will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 7-10 years of experience in the hospitality industry.
At least 3-5 years in a managerial or operational leadership role within hotels, resorts, or hospitality establishments.
Skills & Competencies
Strong leadership and team management abilities.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Sound knowledge of hotel operations and hospitality standards.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Financial acumen and budget management expertise.
Proficiency in hotel management systems and MS Office.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
______________
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Guest Satisfaction Scores
Occupancy and Revenue Performance
Service Quality Standards
Cost Control and Budget Adherence
Employee Productivity and Retention
Compliance and Safety Standards
______________
Compensation & Benefits
Monthly Salary: 50,000 - 60,000
Performance-based incentives (as per company policy)
Paid leave and statutory benefits
Career growth opportunities within The Vanda Hotel
How to Apply
Interested candidates with relevant hospitality experience and strong operational leadership capabilities may apply by submitting their updated resume along with current and expected salary details to Vandahotelbalpang@gmail.com

Description:
Position: Community Program & Skill Development Officer
Department: Hospital Administration / Community Outreach
Reporting To: Medical Superintendent
Location: Tura, Meghalaya
Gender: Male or Female (Both can apply)
Position Summary
The Community Program & Skill Development Officer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and implementing community outreach programs, health awareness campaigns, and skill development initiatives in villages and surrounding areas of Tura, Meghalaya. The role requires building strong relationships with local communities, government agencies, NGOs, schools, and village leaders to improve public health awareness and healthcare accessibility.
Key Responsibilities
Community Outreach & Awareness
Plan and conduct health awareness programs in villages, schools, community centres, and local institutions.
Organize health camps, screening programs, and preventive healthcare awareness drives.
Educate communities on topics such as maternal and child health, nutrition, sanitation, hygiene, communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Develop strategies to increase community participation in hospital-led health initiatives.
Design and implement skill development and capacity-building programs for community members.
Conduct training programs for community volunteers, healthcare workers, and self-help groups.
Identify local skill gaps and create relevant development initiatives.
Coordinate with government departments and development agencies for training support.
Build and maintain relationships with village heads, local authorities, NGOs, schools, and community-based organizations.
Liaise with government departments and healthcare agencies for collaborative programs.
Represent the hospital in community meetings and public events.
Develop IEC (Information, Education, and Communication) materials for awareness campaigns.
Promote hospital services and healthcare initiatives within target communities.
Utilize local languages and culturally appropriate communication methods to maximize outreach impact.
Required Qualifications
Graduate degree in Social Work, Community Development, Public Health, Sociology, Rural Development, Healthcare Management, or related field.
Postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
Experience
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in community development, healthcare outreach, CSR projects, rural development, skill development, or social sector initiatives.
Experience working with rural communities in Meghalaya or the Northeast region is preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and public speaking abilities.
Ability to conduct community mobilization and awareness programs.
Good networking and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational and reporting capabilities.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Ability to travel extensively to villages and remote locations around Tura and Meghalaya.
Knowledge of local languages and cultural practices will be an advantage.
Preferred Attributes
Passion for community service and public health improvement.
Leadership skills and ability to work independently.
Problem-solving and initiative-taking mindset.
Strong interpersonal and team-building abilities.
Those interested can share their cv to hrgen@acarehospitals.com

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1. Job Purpose
To ensure efficient operation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and breakdown maintenance of mechanical equipment in the cement plant, with specific responsibility for crushers and associated material-handling equipment to minimize downtime and ensure smooth plant operations.
2. Key Roles and Responsibilities
A. Crusher Operation and Maintenance
Perform preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of crushers, including jaw crushers, hammer crushers, impact crushers, and other crushing equipment, as applicable to the plant.
Monitor crusher performance, vibration, temperature, noise, lubrication, and equipment condition to identify potential faults.
Inspect and maintain crusher components, including hammers, blow bars, liners, jaw plates, bearings, shafts, rotors, and drive assemblies.
Identify and troubleshoot mechanical issues related to crushing equipment and ensure timely rectification of breakdowns.
Monitor wear parts and coordinate their replacement to maintain crushing efficiency and equipment availability.
Assist in maintenance and troubleshooting of crusher feed systems, belt conveyors, vibrating screens, feeders, and associated material-handling systems.
Ensure proper alignment, clearance, lubrication, and assembly of crusher components after maintenance activities.
B. Mechanical Maintenance
Execute scheduled preventive maintenance and equipment inspections as per the maintenance plan.
Maintain and troubleshoot mechanical equipment such as conveyors, gearboxes, motors, pumps, fans, bearings, couplings, and hydraulic systems.
Assist in equipment erection, installation, alignment, dismantling, and commissioning activities.
Identify recurring mechanical failures and support root cause analysis to prevent repeated breakdowns.
Ensure the availability of critical spares and maintain records of maintenance activities, breakdowns, and equipment history.
C. Safety and Compliance
Follow plant safety procedures, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and applicable PPE requirements.
Ensure safe execution of maintenance activities, particularly during crusher inspection, cleaning, and repair.
Identify unsafe conditions and report equipment abnormalities, hazards, and near misses.
Maintain good housekeeping and ensure compliance with plant safety standards.
D. Coordination and Reporting
Coordinate with production, electrical, instrumentation, and other maintenance teams for planned maintenance and breakdown resolution.
Maintain daily maintenance reports, inspection checklists, and breakdown records.
Support efforts to improve equipment reliability, reduce downtime, and optimize maintenance costs.
2.. Educational Qualification
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
Relevant technical qualifications in mechanical maintenance may be considered based on experience and company requirements.
3. Required Technical Skills
Practical knowledge of crusher maintenance, wear parts, bearings, shafts, lubrication, and drive mechanisms.
Understanding of preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and basic troubleshooting techniques.
Knowledge of conveyors, feeders, gearboxes, couplings, and material-handling equipment.
Ability to read mechanical drawings, equipment manuals, and maintenance checklists.
Basic knowledge of maintenance planning, spare parts management, and root cause analysis.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and maintenance reporting systems.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile
Candidates with hands-on experience in crusher maintenance within a cement manufacturing plant, particularly limestone/raw material crushing, are preferred. The candidate should possess sound mechanical troubleshooting skills and the ability to support preventive and breakdown maintenance activities independently under the guidance of the senior maintenance team.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Project Identification and Scope
Build and maintain a pipeline of stores, markets or business areas that may require focused project intervention.

2. Business Diagnosis and Opportunity Assessment
Analyse sales, target achievement, market potential, competitor performance, product mix, stock availability, promoter productivity, display, finance penetration and retailer engagement when relevant to the project.
Conduct field visits and structured discussions with store owners, promoters, TLs, Sales, Retail and other teams to identify the actual causes of weak performance.

3. Project Planning
Prepare practical 30-day, 60-day or 90-day project plans with targets, activities, owners, deadlines, resources and expected results.
Recommend project-specific interventions involving manpower, stock, product mix, display, training, finance, retailer schemes, local activation, relationship improvement or process correction.

4. Retailer Negotiation and Stakeholder Alignment
Present the business opportunity and proposed solution to store owners, distributors and other external partners.
Negotiate measurable commitments related to sales, stock investment, display space, promoter placement, branding, finance, local activity or other project requirements.

5. Cross Functional Execution
Coordinate with Sales, Retail, GTM, Marketing, Branding, Training, Affordability, Supply Chain and branch teams according to the needs of each project.

6. Fortress Store and Core Store Projects
Support the opening, ramp-up, performance improvement and turnaround of Fortress Stores.
Lead structured breakthrough projects for high-potential core outlets where vivo has a meaningful opportunity to improve sales or share.

7. Monitoring and Project Closure
Maintain a project tracker covering the baseline, target, actions, owners, deadlines, risks, support required and current status.
Review performance weekly and distinguish completed activity from actual business impact.
Provide concise management updates focused on results, major risks, unresolved dependencies and decisions required.

Preferred candidate profile
Graduate degree in Business, Marketing, Retail Management or a related discipline. An MBA is preferred but not essential.
Four to seven years of relevant experience in smartphones, consumer electronics, telecom, FMCG, retail operations, channel development or field-project execution.
At least two years of experience independently managing store improvement, channel development, territory improvement or another measurable business project.
Evidence of completing projects with a clear baseline, personal actions and measurable before-and-after results.
Experience working with retailers, distributors, promoters or field-sales teams.
Ability to analyse store-level or territory-level data and convert findings into practical actions.
Strong communication, retailer negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple departments even when the project owners do not report directly to the role holder.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, including project trackers and business-review presentations.
Willingness to travel frequently and spend significant time in the market.
Good English and Hindi communication. Knowledge of Assamese or other Northeast Indian languages will be an advantage.
AboutCompany:
Rongsheng Mobile India Private Limited is the Super Distributor of vivo Smartphones for the North-East region of India. Established on 24 November 2014 and operational since December 2014, the company has consistently played a vital role in strengthening vivo's presence across the region through an extensive distribution network and customer-focused operations.

Over the years, Rongsheng Mobile India Pvt. Ltd. has expanded its business operations across Assam and the North-Eastern States, including Sikkim, creating significant employment opportunities and contributing to the growth of the region's retail and distribution ecosystem.

Our North-East Head Office is strategically located at First Floor, Nikita Pinnacle, Khanapara, Guwahati, Assam, providing a comfortable, collaborative, and professional environment for our employees.

To ensure seamless supply chain operations, our central warehouse is located at Lokhra, Guwahati. Equipped to support efficient inventory management and timely product distribution, the warehouse works in close coordination with our Marketing Distributors (MDs), branch offices, and sales teams across the region.

At Rongsheng, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We are committed to fostering a culture of integrity, teamwork, innovation, and continuous learning while providing rewarding career opportunities for professionals who aspire to grow in the dynamic mobile and consumer electronics industry.

Join Rongsheng Mobile India Pvt. Ltd. and be a part of a fast-growing organization driving innovation and connectivity across North-East India.

The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust working towards creating an equitable society and enhancing the quality of life of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. THF works to improve the health and wellbeing of remote and underserved populations, with additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women, alongside education and livelihood development.
2. Project Overview: Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre project aims to strengthen access to essential healthcare for rural and hard-to-reach communities in Meghalaya. In its first phase, THF has committed to supporting 50 Sub-Centres through gap assessment, provision of equipment and facilities, deployment of skilled human resources, training, regular operations and monitoring. The project seeks to improve grassroots health services and contribute to better health outcomes, including maternal health.
3. General Information Position MIS Associate Project Hans Health & Wellness Centre (HWC), Meghalaya Location To be specified based on project requirement (e.g., assigned HSC / Project Office) No. of Positions 1 (or as per approved project requirement) Employment Type Contractual for one year; renewable based on performance and project requirements Reporting To Project Manager 4. Key Duties and Responsibilities A. Data Collection, Entry and Management
Collect, compile and enter data received from HSCs in approved registers, Excel sheets, MIS platforms and reporting formats.
Provide data-entry and documentation support to HSC staff, Project Manager and MEL Manager, as required.
Maintain an updated and organised database of HSC-wise service delivery, beneficiary and programme information, as applicable to approved project indicators.
Ensure that records are complete, legible, accurate and updated within prescribed timelines.
B. Data Quality and Verification
Review submitted data for completeness, consistency, duplication, missing entries and obvious errors; seek clarification or corrections from the concerned HSC staff.
Cross-check digital data with source registers and records wherever required.
Maintain proper documentation and an audit trail for corrections and updates; do not alter clinical records without authorisation.
Flag data gaps, discrepancies and delayed submissions to the Project Coordinator for timely resolution.
C. Reporting and MIS
Prepare and submit regular HSC-wise and consolidated project progress reports as per the reporting calendar and formats approved by THF.
Compile monthly and periodic data on service delivery and project indicators, as applicable and approved by the project team.
Support preparation of summary tables, charts, dashboards and presentations for internal reviews and management meetings.
Share verified data with the Project Coordinator and authorised stakeholders within stipulated timelines.
D. Record and Document Management
Maintain and organise registers, reporting files, attendance records and other programme documentation assigned to the role.
Ensure systematic filing, version control, safe storage and timely retrieval of records, in both digital and physical formats.
Support documentation of data-related observations, follow-up actions and reporting submissions.
E. Coordination and Field Support
Coordinate with MLHPs, GNM/ANMs and other HSC personnel to obtain timely and accurate data and clarify reporting requirements.
Follow up on pending reports and support staff in understanding prescribed data formats and reporting timelines.
Participate in project review meetings, trainings and data-verification visits as assigned.
Undertake other MIS, data management and administrative responsibilities relevant to the HWC project, as assigned by the reporting officer.
F. Confidentiality and Compliance
Maintain confidentiality and protect personal and health-related information of beneficiaries in accordance with THF policies and applicable requirements.
Share data only with authorised personnel and use approved systems and formats for storage and transmission.
Adhere to THF policies, professional conduct standards and instructions issued by the project management team.
5. Educational Qualifications
Graduate in any discipline from a recognised institution.
Diploma or certificate in Computer Applications / IT is preferred.
6. Experience and Technical Skills
Preferably 2-3 years of experience in MIS, data entry, reporting, programme support or a related role. Fresh graduates with strong computer skills may also be considered.
Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, email and data-entry systems; ability to maintain structured spreadsheets and prepare basic summaries is essential.
Experience in health programmes, public health reporting or work with healthcare facilities would be an advantage.
Ability to check data for accuracy, maintain organised records and meet recurring reporting deadlines.
7. Behavioural and Other Requirements
Good communication, coordination and follow-up skills.
Attention to detail, integrity, reliability and respect for confidentiality.
Ability to work with frontline health staff and manage multiple reporting tasks within deadlines.
Proficiency in English and Hindi; knowledge of the local language/dialect is desirable.
Willingness to travel to assigned HSCs or project locations, as required.

Description:
Field Associate - West Garo Hills (Garo Language)
Location: West Garo Hills, Meghalaya (Onsite)
Experience Level: 1-3 years (Relevant fellowships in enterprise/livelihoods considered)
Salary Band: 5-6 LPA
Job Summary
Ground Zero is looking for an independent, field-driven Field Associate based in West Garo Hills to strengthen women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) through our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). Working directly with community members and state livelihood frameworks, this role provides handholding support in day-to-day business operations, member engagement, governance, procurement, and market linkages across rural enterprises (agri-business, spices, etc.).
Responsibilities
Community Mobilization & Member Engagement: Mobilize and engage women producer group members (~20 members per group) for collective business actions, including produce procurement, aggregation, and marketing.
Business Operations & Planning: Help set up ground-level business operations for agri-business and value chains. Coordinate with input suppliers, buyers, transporters, and local service providers.
Governance & Financial Records: Assist PG leaders in maintaining accurate books of accounts, meeting resolutions, governance registers, and financial discipline.
Capacity Building & Training: Facilitate block and district-level training sessions for producer groups and community cadres.
Strategic Linkages & Coordination: Build institutional linkages with local government departments, market actors, and financial institutions under the guidance of the senior team.
Reporting & Field Surveys: Conduct ground-level surveys, market studies, and maintain routine field reports on operational progress, issues, and financials.
Qualifications & Candidate Profile
Education: Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Rural Management, Development Studies, or a related field (Master s/MBA preferred).
Experience: 1-3 years of experience in rural development, SHGs/PGs, collective enterprises, or livelihood promotion. Candidates with recognized fellowships in rural enterprise development will also be considered.
Language Mandatory: Excellent written and spoken command of Garo is mandatory. Basic ability to communicate in English and Hindi is preferred.
Key Competencies: Strong community mobilization skills, basic computer literacy (MS Word, Excel), and willingness to conduct rigorous field travel.
Logistics: Having a personal two-wheeler/bike is highly advantageous for field mobility. Candidates must be open to occasional travel to Shillong and Guwahati for official meetings.
Diversity: Female candidates are preferred, though qualified male candidates are also encouraged to apply.
Hiring Process
Round 1: HR & Program Team Interview
Round 2: Practical Assignment
Round 3: Final Interview based on Assignment (with Program Lead)
Hiring Note: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.

Field Associate - West Jaintia Hills (Khasi Language)
Location: Meghalaya
Experience Level: 1-3 years (Relevant fellowships in enterprise/livelihoods considered)
Role Overview
Ground Zero is seeking an energetic Field Associate to empower women-owned Producer Groups (PGs) under our Women s Enterprise Support System (WESS). The candidate will work independently on the ground, driving member participation, enterprise governance, local business operations, procurement, and market linkages in agri-business and rural commodities.
Key Responsibilities
Community Mobilization & Member Engagement: Mobilize women producer group members (~20 members per group) for collective business activities, procurement, aggregation, and local marketing.
Business Operations & Planning: Assist PG leaders in executing business plans across local value chains (agri-commodities, spices, etc.). Coordinate with input suppliers, buyers, and logistics service providers.
Governance & Financial Records: Guide PG leaders in maintaining financial discipline, books of accounts, meeting documentation, and governance records.
Capacity Building & Training: Organize and conduct block- and district-level training sessions for women entrepreneurs and producer group leaders.
Strategic Linkages & Stakeholder Support: Facilitate market, credit, and institutional linkages with government departments and community institutions with strategic guidance from senior leadership.
Field Monitoring & Reporting: Conduct needs assessments, value chain studies, and submit regular updates on field progress, financials, and operational challenges.
Qualifications & Candidate Profile
Education: Bachelor s degree in Business Administration, Rural Management, Social Work, or a related discipline (Master s/MBA preferred).
Experience: 1-3 years of experience in rural development, livelihood promotion, SHGs/PGs, or enterprise development. Candidates from development/enterprise fellowship programs are also eligible.
Language Mandatory: Fluency in written and spoken Khasi is mandatory. Basic proficiency in English and Hindi is desirable.
Key Competencies: Strong field facilitation skills, basic computer proficiency (MS Excel, Word), and a proactive approach to solving field challenges.
Logistics: Owning a personal two-wheeler/bike is highly preferred for rural movement. Periodic travel to Shillong and Guwahati for strategic reviews will be required.
Diversity: Female candidates are preferred, though eligible male candidates are welcome to apply.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on Commercial function. Key responsibilities include:

Business Process Re-engineering
Review the existing process of reporting of key commercial parameters of the Distribution utility.
Prepare a Standard Operating Procedure for reporting of the key parameters along with responsibility matrix.
Engage with all the Stakeholders and get the feedback from them on the proposed SOP including middle and lower management.
Assist in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure within timeframes as approved by the Management.
Provide on recommendations on digital interventions along with the probable solutions along with the cost benefit analysis.
Formulate standardized daily, weekly and monthly reporting formats on key parameters with diagnostic analysis along with probable interventions to capture adverse deviations.

Billing and Collection
Monitoring the effective of billing and facilitating in ensuring 100 % billing.
Formulating Process of Billing Quality check. like- Under billed consumers, Overbilled, never billed.
Preparing of Billing, Collection & customer data Management Information reports from the billing Master data.
Billing & Collection Analysis of consumers of various categories.
Suggesting Changes & improvement of Billing system to minimize errors and system gaps.
Work in close coordination with the Unified Billing System provider.
Analyze the data of Smart Metered Consumers in terms of key parameters and prepare a report on the deviations along with the corrective actions. The report is to be circulated to all lower, middle and top management and vigilance team for corrective actions.
Suggesting the utilities on best practices in the industry for billing and collection checks.
Coordinate with Distribution Franchisee operator for submission of monthly MIS as per the contract document.

Management Review
Prepare presentation at sub-division level for the review meeting by management highlighting the key parameters along with the diagnostic analysis and suggestions for improvement.
Coordinate with the sub-divisions level officers for the Action Taken Report after each review meeting.

C. Required skill set:
Strong technical and commercial knowledge about the power distribution business.
Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
Experience in handling smart meter data
Working knowledge of key regulatory interventions effecting the commercial parameters of DISCOM.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
BE/ B. Tech/ MBA/ M. Tech (Candidates with B. Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
Knowledge of advanced MS Excel and Microsoft Power point is highly preferred.
Atleast 5 Years experience in Commercial Matters of DISCOM or consultancy company.

E. Location:
Shillong, Meghalaya.
The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.

Description:
A. About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced Manager/ Senior Analyst Management Consulting (Procurement &Tendering) to support the implementation of a consultancy assignment with Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) and its subsidiaries viz. Meghalaya Power Generation Corporation Limited, Meghalaya Power Transmission Corporation Limited and Meghalaya Power Distribution Corporation Limited. The role involves supporting procurement and tendering activities for utility projects, ensuring compliance with procurement procedures, facilitating bid management, vendor coordination, contract finalization, and monitoring procurement-related project deliverables.

B. Detailed expectations from the role:
The Manager shall be responsible for providing strategic and operational consulting support on procurement and tendering functions. Key responsibilities include:

Procurement & Tendering Support
• Provide day-to-day support to MeECL and its subsidiaries on procurement and tendering activities.
• Review the existing Operating Procedure of MeECL for bidding of services and goods.
• Prepare Request for Proposals (RFPs) for procurement of materials and services as per client requirements and in line with the State and Central Procurement Guidelines.
• Coordinate with the State E Procurement management team.
• Advise the client from time to time on updation of the procurement process and digital intervention in the procurement.

Vendor Identification & Bid Management
• Identify and facilitate the selection of suitable vendors in line with MeECL procurement processes.
• Support release of RFPs and tender documents.
• Coordinate pre-bid meetings and manage clarifications with prospective bidders.
• Facilitate all procurement activities through to contract award.

Bid Evaluation
• Review all the technical and commercial bids.
• Find out the deviations in the submitted bids from the conditions in the RfP.
• Prepare comparative statements, bid evaluation reports, and recommendations for tender finalization.
• Support evaluation committees during the bid assessment process.

MIS & Reporting
• Prepare, review, and validate MIS reports, dashboards, progress reports, and periodic submissions.
• Prepare a database for the bids with details of technical requirement, deviations allowed, revisions in the tenders done if any etc.
• Maintain procurement documentation and ensure timely reporting to the Client.
• Ensure quality and accuracy of reports, presentations, and Minutes of Meetings (MoMs).

Stakeholder Coordination
• Coordinate with officials MeECL, contractors, vendors, and internal consulting teams.
• Monitor procurement milestones and facilitate timely resolution of issues.

Additional Responsibilities
• Prepare a Standard Operating Procedures with timelines for each type of procurement and ensure compliance of the approved procedure.
• Support any other procurement and tendering activities assigned by the Client.
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives and procurement best practices within the project.

C. Required skill set:
• Strong understanding of procurement and tendering processes in the Power Sector including, distribution, generation and transmission.
• Experience in preparation of RFPs, bid evaluation, vendor selection, and contract award processes.
• Knowledge of public procurement procedures and utility procurement practices.
• Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
• Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and MS Office applications.
• Experience working with State DISCOMs, Government Utilities, or Power Sector Consulting organizations will be preferred.

D. Education and Experience:
• BE/ B. Tech or MBA (Candidates with B.Tech and MBA may be preferred but not mandatory).
• Atleast 5 Years experience in Procurement, Tendering & Contracts Management in a Power Utility / Discom company or Power utility consultancy company.

E. Location:
• Shillong, Meghalaya.
• The role will involve regular interaction with utility officials and may require field visits within Meghalaya based on project requirements.

F. Remuneration Structure:
• We offer a motivation-based and competitive reward package aligned with international consulting industry benchmarks.

Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Since the beginning of its operations in India in 2008, Mercados has been supporting clients across the energy sector value chain. We strive to promote efficient and sustainable energy markets; design effective regulations and assist energy businesses to succeed. Our approach integrates innovative, state-of-the-art techniques with practical, tailor-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurugram, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Lucknow and various Project offices across India.
Mercados has a dedicated team of over 185+ (and counting) professionals and has successfully completed 800+ assignments for its esteemed clients. Description:
1. Shift In-Charge CPP Operations :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in DCS-operated Captive Power Plant operations
Key Responsibilities:
Manage and monitor day-to-day CPP operations through DCS, ensuring safe, reliable and efficient plant performance.
Lead shift operations, coordinate with Boiler, Turbine and E&I teams, and ensure smooth power generation.
Monitor plant parameters, troubleshoot operational issues and ensure compliance with safety and operational standards.

2. Engineer Boiler :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in Boiler Operations
Preferred: BOE Certificate
Key Responsibilities:
Monitor and operate boiler systems to ensure safe, stable and efficient steam generation.
Coordinate with shift teams for boiler start-up, shutdown, load management and troubleshooting.
Monitor key boiler parameters and ensure adherence to operational, safety and maintenance standards.
3. Engineer Turbine :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in Turbine Operations
Key Responsibilities:
Operate and monitor turbine systems to ensure reliable and efficient power generation.
Handle turbine start-up, shutdown, load changes and operational troubleshooting as per SOPs.
Monitor turbine parameters and coordinate with Boiler and E&I teams for smooth plant operations.

4. Engineer Turbine Field Operator :
Qualification: ITI/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in Turbine Operations
Key Responsibilities:
Conduct field monitoring and operation of turbine equipment and associated systems.
Perform routine equipment inspections, identify abnormalities and support troubleshooting activities.
Coordinate with the control room team during start-up, shutdown and load variation activities while maintaining safety standards.

5. Shift In-Charge E&I, CPP :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering
Experience: 5-7 years in E&I operations within a Captive Power Plant
Key Responsibilities:
Lead shift-wise Electrical & Instrumentation operations and ensure reliable functioning of CPP systems.
Monitor electrical and instrumentation equipment, identify faults and coordinate troubleshooting with maintenance teams.
Ensure proper preventive maintenance, safety compliance and availability of critical E&I systems.

6. Engineer Instrumentation :
Qualification: Degree/Diploma in Instrumentation Engineering
Experience: 57 years in Instrumentation, preferably in a Captive Power Plant
Key Responsibilities:
Monitor and maintain instrumentation systems, control loops, sensors and field instruments across the CPP.
Troubleshoot instrumentation and control system issues to minimize downtime and ensure plant reliability.
Support calibration, preventive maintenance and smooth functioning of DCS/PLC and associated instrumentation systems.

Common Preference & Application :
Industry Preference: Candidates from Cement / Steel / Heavy Manufacturing industries will be preferred.

Location: Khliehriat, Meghalaya

Summary
The Area Sales Manager is a key strategic leader within the solar energy industry, responsible for driving revenue growth and expanding market presence across a defined geographic region. This role focuses on building and managing a high-performing B2B sales team, cultivating relationships with commercial and industrial clients, and executing targeted sales strategies to achieve aggressive quarterly and annual targets. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in B2B sales within the renewable energy sector, with a proven ability to navigate complex procurement processes, negotiate long-term contracts, and deliver scalable solar solutions. As a critical link between the organization and its enterprise clients, the Area Sales Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable energy adoption, contributing to corporate sustainability goals, and strengthening the companys position as a leader in the solar industry.

Responsibilities
Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with company growth objectives and market opportunities in the solar energy sector.
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of B2B sales representatives, ensuring performance excellence through coaching, goal setting, and regular feedback.
Identify, qualify, and pursue new commercial and industrial B2B prospects, focusing on solar PV system installations for businesses, manufacturing facilities, and institutional clients.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with key decision-makers at enterprise accounts, including facility managers, sustainability officers, and procurement teams.
Collaborate with technical and project development teams to deliver customized solar solutions that meet client energy needs and financial objectives.
Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer behavior to refine sales approaches and improve win rates.
Prepare and present detailed proposals, financial models, and ROI analyses to support client decision-making.
Track and report on sales pipeline, forecast accuracy, and KPIs using CRM platforms to ensure transparency and data-driven planning.
Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies throughout the sales and project handoff process.

Requirements
Requirements:
Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Proven experience (5+ years) in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding sales targets in the renewable energy, clean tech, or construction industry.
In-depth knowledge of solar energy systems, including photovoltaic (PV) technology, financing models (PPA, lease, cash purchase), and incentive programs (e.g., ITC, state rebates).
Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multi-stakeholder decision-making and long-term contracts.
Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite for reporting, forecasting, and client presentations.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at the executive level.
Valid drivers license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.
Experience in team leadership and performance management, including hiring, training, and performance evaluation.
Familiarity with sustainability metrics and ESG reporting is a plus.

401(k) plan with company match
