Description:
Block Functional Specialist Financial Inclusion
Shillong, Meghalaya
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Block Functional Specialist Financial Inclusion to drive financial access, literacy, and empowerment initiatives for rural communities and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
Key Responsibilities
Bank Linkage & Loan Facilitation: Facilitate SHG-bank linkages, streamline loan application processing, and monitor sanctioning, disbursement, and repayment.
Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise closely with local banks, Bank Sakhis, and Business Correspondents (BCs) to improve financial delivery networks.
Financial Literacy & Awareness: Conduct structured awareness programs on financial management and promote key government social security schemes (PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY).
Enterprise Support & Insurance: Assist SHG members in securing financial access for local enterprises, and support insurance enrollment and claim settlements.
Data & Community Management: Organize bank coordination meetings, foster community engagement, and maintain detailed data and reporting on financial inclusion metrics.
Key Qualifications & Eligibility
Education: Post-graduate degree or diploma in Science, Business Management (Finance), or Commerce from a recognized university or institution.
Age Limit: Below 30 years.
Experience: 1-2 years of experience in Rural Development and Poverty Alleviation programs.
1-2 years of experience working in Banks, Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), or Microfinance Institutions (MFIs).
Technical Skills: Proficient in computer applications, with strong knowledge of MS Office and Google Sheets.

Description:
Job Summary
Programme Lead - Community Libraries
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya, India
Contract: Fixed term consulting contract
Based on previous CTC and experience
Project Background
Sauramandala Foundation is an NGO founded in 2018 with a vision to bring about systemic change in the lives of remote communities through empathetic, collaborative, and contextual solutions that are co-created with the communities themselves.
About the Project (CM Youth Center):
The Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Sauramandala Foundation, has established 22 rural community centres for youth, called the Chief Ministers Youth Centers (CMYC) with an aim to build resilience, agency and problem-solving skills in the community. The key programmes in the CMYCs are - Self Designed Learning, Entrepreneurship Development, Sports Coaching, Arts and Theatre and a Community Library Programme. The learning is open to all ages to have more involvement from the community. The CMYCs are set to expand from 22 centers to cover all 55 blocks of Meghalaya over a 2 year period.
Objective of the Engagement
To design and operationalize well-resourced, welcoming libraries in CMYCs that:
Build a culture of reading by working closely with children, young adults and youth in the community.
Serve as learning hubs supporting adolescent well-being and development.
Scope of Work
Curation
Build vibrant, culturally rooted, multilingual collections for children, young adults and youth.
Curate collections across themes of well-being, mental health, coming of age, gender, environment, sci-fi, indigenous knowledge and local culture and so on.
Ensure enough reading materials for beginner to confident and advanced readers.
Programme Design
Support the design of libraries and child and youth-friendly spaces.
Design a joyful community library programme that makes reading social, engaging and meaningful.
Create spaces for dialogue and self expression - reading circles, book discussions, open mics, writing labs, movie screenings and debrief reflections.
Integrate life skills and SEL into the library programme to build empathy, self-confidence, critical thinking etc.
Design for the library activities to travel to nearby villages around the Youth Center and to engage with existing Youth Clubs.
Building Community Ownership
Position the CMYC and the libraries as a community asset by engaging the community especially the adults to build a connection with the space.
Organise reading festivals, youth showcases, and community celebrations.
Create systems to encourage youth to play an active role in shaping the libraries - youth volunteers, library leaders and so on.
Strengthening libraries as safe, welcoming, learning hubs
Develop a simple monitoring framework for smooth operations.
Train first-time libraries with tools and techniques on youth engagement, creating safe spaces, facilitating shared reading experiences in the libraries.
Bring in low-cost digital tools and offline e-resources where possible.
Document learnings and adolescent and youth stories from the libraries.
Expected area of expertise
Master's Degree in Education/Library & Information Science or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
8-9 years of experience in setting up community libraries, training librarians and educators to build a culture of reading.
Any certifications on library science or engagements with organisations working in the field is preferred.
Strong knowledge of curation for different age groups from children to young adults and youth.
Ability to design and facilitate training workshops for first-time librarians.
Adaptability to an agile, cross-functional, collaborative working environment.

Job Summary
Recruitment Associate. Location: Meghalaya, India. Contract type: Fixed term consulting contract up to . Negotiable as per experience.


Role Overview
The Recruitment Associate will assist the Recruitment Manager in managing recruitment processes. This role involves coordinating candidate interviews, assisting with onboarding processes, maintaining recruitment databases and ensuring smooth recruitment operations. The Associate will also provide administrative support to the HR team as needed.


What will you do as the Recruitment Associate

Supporting a Positive Work Environment
Assist in implementing practices that support a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace.
Help coordinate staff recognition efforts and team engagement activities.
Support efforts to gather employee feedback and share insights with the HR team for cultural improvements.


Recruitment & Onboarding Support
Assist with posting job openings, screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and preparing interview documentation.
Coordinate reference checks and support onboarding logistics for new hires.
Maintain accurate records of recruitment and onboarding processes.


Employee Relations Assistance
Support the HR Team in handling employee concerns and maintaining clear documentation.
Help coordinate and document discussions related to workplace issues or grievances.
Promote open communication by helping to manage feedback tools and suggestion channels.


Performance Management Support
Assist in coordinating the performance appraisal cycle, including scheduling and document preparation.
Help track the completion of employee KRAs and appraisals.
Provide administrative support for performance discussions and performance improvement processes.


Training & Development Coordination
Support the planning and logistics of training sessions (e.g., booking venues, managing attendance, sharing materials).
Collect participant feedback and compile summaries for review.
Assist in the development of basic training content related to values, inclusion, and workplace conduct.


HR Administration
Prepare and maintain HR documents such as offer letters, contracts, and confirmation letters.
Keep employee records up to date, including attendance, leave, and personnel files.
Assist in the administration of employee benefits, leave tracking, and policy communication.


Who are we looking for
Experience: 2-3 years of experience in recruitment or HR support roles.
Qualifications: Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related fields.
Strong organizational, communication and administrative skills.
Experience in recruitment processes, interview scheduling and candidate coordination.

Job Description

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15+ central and state government partners.

Our economic inclusion journey for 25 million Indians, has reached 10 states with $250M of government funding to cover 1.25M people. Our incubator, accelerator and grand challenges have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs including 17 Forbes 30U30, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, 1 Time Magazine cover and more.

Set up with support from 90+ eminent philanthropists , 40+ corporates and 15+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and LOreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty-free India, within our lifetime".

What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals a contributing member to the economy:

Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale with quality.

What will you do
The/Nudge is working with various state SRLMs to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting vulnerable rural women through community institutions.
To understand and practice the Spirits of The/Nudge Institute and the respective SRLMs
Ensure all project activities are implemented on time with utmost quality as per approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP)/ Standard Operating Procedure (SoP)/ Package of Practice (PoP)/ Community Operational Manual (COM) in the respective districts.
Support the district in projects under PVTG Domain.
Coordinate with DMMU and BMMU to ensure smooth implementation of the project .
Coordinate and facilitate in organizing capacity building training of project team and community.
Coordinate and lead in organizing any project related event at regional and district.
Coordinate and support in any field visits of dignitaries and officials.
Ensure timely planning and implementation of project activities.
Ensure proper documentation and reporting related to the project to respective offices.
Facilitate the timely collection/ entry, processing and reporting of data.
Support and practice monitoring evaluation of projects.
Good stakeholder management at the grassroots level.

Who are we looking for in this role
Candidate must be graduate; post-graduate will be preferred, in relevant streams like rural development, rural management, agriculture, forestry, social work, anthropology etc.
Candidate must have 4-6 years of relevant experience in the development sector/ rural development projects/ poverty eradication projects/ livelihood promotion projects/ tribal development projects.
Candidate with work experience working in district-level positions in National Rural Livelihood Mission/ State Rural Livelihood Missions in Institution Building, Capacity Building, Social Inclusion, Social Development, and Livelihood promotion will be preferred.
The candidate must have her/his own two-wheeler with a valid driving license as it is a field job.
The Location for this role is based in Eastern West Khasi Hills

What s in it for you

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

You can learn more about what we do and how we do it through this deck .

.

government liaison Decision-Making Field Readiness field operations Teamwork Problem-Solving Communication Skills

Description:
About Virohan

Founded about a decade ago by Kunaal Dudeja, Nalin Saluja, and Archit Jayaswal , Virohan is an education-to-industry partner building the workforce powering India s healthcare future. We partner with universities and colleges across India to deliver industry-aligned programs in Healthcare and management, helping students bridge the gap between education and real-world employability.

At Virohan, we believe healthcare education needs to go beyond classrooms. Our model combines academic learning with hands-on industry exposure and strong healthcare partnerships, ensuring students are prepared for real roles. Today, Virohan has trained 13,000+ healthcare professionals, with a growing network of university and industry partners across the country.
Backed by global investors including Blume Ventures (India), Mynavi Corporation (Japan), Rebright Partners (Japan), Elea Foundation (Switzerland), Artha Impact (Switzerland), Bharat Inclusive Technologies Seed Fund (India), and Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance Venture Capital (Japan) , we are building at the intersection of education and healthcare - two of India s fastest-growing sectors.

At our core, we are guided by a strong set of values that define how we work, build, and grow together - from ownership and bias for action to empathy, continuous learning, and raising the bar. If you re excited about building something meaningful at scale and solving real-world problems, you ll find yourself at home at Virohan.

Role Overview

The City Admission Manager will own Virohan s end-to-end performance in the assigned city-driving admissions, centre operations, team productivity, student experience, partner coordination, and local brand growth. This person will act as the single accountable business owner for the city, ensuring that all city-level teams deliver against growth, quality, and profitability goals.

What you ll be responsible for

Conduct market surveys alongside competitors.
Identify additional offerings for students.
Establish connections with educational institutions (schools, junior colleges, coaching classes).
Initiate discussions with HODs for seminar opportunities and other BTL activities.
Identify, onboard, and manage channel partners to expand offline sales reach and drive business growth.
Engage students, highlighting Virohans advantages.
Connect with parents during house visits.
Collect data from 12th board exam centers for attracting fresh students.
Plan canopy activities strategically for better outreach.
Plan and execute marketing activities, generating sales leads.
Manage local BTL activities effectively.
Reach monthly sales targets by nurturing agent relationships and networks.

An ideal candidate should have:

Comfortable with field sales; committed to daily market presence.
Proficient in consultative sale, adept at building trust without being forceful.
Capable of handling sales pressures.
Strong communication skills, particularly in regional languages.
Receptive to feedback, embracing learning from mistakes and setbacks.
Presentable appearance and previous fieldwork experience, preferably in education.
Strong presentation skills with the ability to effectively represent the company to diverse audiences.
Holds 2 to 5 years of marketing experience.

Required Skills
Counselling channel sales B2B partnership Telecalling Channel partnering

Description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development. The role requires a candidate with practical knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic products market and experience in handling channel sales.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers.
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products.
Candidates with experience as Medical Representatives (MRs) may be considered only if their experience includes retail, distributor, dealer, stockist, or channel sales.
Experience in dealer/distributor handling and market development is mandatory.
Experience in local store/pharmacy visits and product promotion will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with B.Pharm / D.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / equivalent qualifications may be preferred, depending on relevant sales experience.
Key Skills
Pharma Sales Business Development
Dealer Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand Product Promotion
Channel Sales Market Development
Sales Target Achievement
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets.
Budget: Maximum 30,000 net per month, depending on experience and suitability.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to customer service processes.
Configure and support SAP CS functionalities including:
Service Notifications
Service Orders
Service Contracts
Warranty Management
Repair and Returns Processing

Work closely with business stakeholders to understand service operations and recommend best practices.
Integrate SAP CS with:
SAP SD (Sales & Distribution)
SAP PM (Plant Maintenance)
SAP MM (Materials Management)
SAP FI/CO (Finance & Controlling)
Prepare functional specifications and support development teams during enhancements.
Conduct unit testing, integration testing, UAT, and production support.
Provide end-user training and create process documentation.
Support incident resolution and continuous process improvements.
Required Skills
4+ years of hands-on experience in SAP CS module.
Strong knowledge of:
Service Notifications
Service Orders
Installed Base Management
Equipment Master
Functional Locations
Service Contracts
Warranty Claims Management
Experience in SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA.
Good understanding of customer service and after-sales service processes.
Knowledge of integration with SD, PM, MM, and FI modules.
Experience in implementation, rollout, support, or migration projects.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Description:
Job description of this profile as follows:
Credit Manager will be responsible for evaluating, underwriting, and managing the credit risk associated with vehicle loans (including new/used CV loans, two-wheelers, 3-Wheelers, Electric vehicles). This role focuses on assessing creditworthiness, ensuring zero fraud, streamlining loan turn-around-time (TAT), maintaining a healthy portfolio quality, and achieving a sustainable balance between business growth and risk mitigation.

Core Responsibilities:
1. Credit Underwriting & Risk Assessment:
Evaluate loan applications for wheels products based on internal credit policies, financial statements, bank statements, Bureau records (e.g., CIBIL), and field verification reports.
Identify potential red flags, financial stress, or fraudulent documentation early in the underwriting lifecycle.
Assess the buyer's repayment capacity, cash flows (especially for self-employed individuals and commercial operators), and the valuation/LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio of the vehicle being financed.

2. Portfolio Quality & Monitoring:
Track early mortality accounts and manage the non-performing asset (NPA) percentages within the assigned geography or product category.
Monitor monthly bounce rates, overdue accounts, and collection trends to proactively alter credit guidelines if specific segments show high risk.
Conduct periodic portfolio reviews and sample audits of disbursed cases to ensure absolute policy compliance.

3. TAT Management:
Ensuring quick Turn-Around-Time (TAT) from application login to final credit sanction without compromising risk standards.

Key Candidate Requirements:
Candidates should have 4-5 years' experience in credit underwriting of Wheels product.
Relevant experience in credit underwriting within an NBFC or bank.
Good understanding of bureau reports, income assessment, banking analysis, credit policies, and lending processes.
Ability to independently evaluate credit proposals and recommend appropriate credit decisions within delegated authority.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound credit judgment.

Job Summary
Our creative and talented Physical Design team in Bangalore, India. As a member of this team you will be involved in creating next generation state-of-the-art networking chips in advanced process node. You will drive the backend process through the entire RTL 2 GDS Implementation flow including hierarchical floor planning, place route, timing closure, power integrity, static timing verification, physical verification and equivalence checks, with special focus on performance die size optimization.


Your Impact
Analyzes current generation quality and efficiency gaps to identify proper incremental or evolutionary changes to the existing physical design related Tools, Flow and Methodology.
Work closely with various teams such as physical design, RTL, DFT, tool/flow owners, and EDA vendors to improve physical design methodologies.
Good understanding of different CTS strategies and providing the feedback to Implementation Team.
As member of physical design team, drive methodologies and best known methods to streamline and automate physical design work.
STA setup, convergence methodology, reviews and sign-off for Multi-Mode and Multi-corner designs.
Good at Timing ECO Implementation strategy development/convergence. Should have an experience in enabling the Tweaker/Primetime based ECO flows.
Work on Automation scripts within STA tools for Methodology development Excellent debugging skills in implementation issues and ability to produce creative solutions.
Evaluate multiple timing methodologies/tools on different designs and technology nodes.
Good scripting skills (TCL/SHELL/PERL/Python) is a MUST


Minimum Qualifications
Bachelors or a Master s Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering required
You are an ASIC engineer with 11+ years of related work experience with a broad mix of technologies including:
All aspects of ASIC Physical implementation including Floor planning, Clock and Power distribution, global signal planning, I/O planning and hard IP integration.
Hierarchical design implementation approach, Timing closure, physical convergence.
Power Integrity Analysis
Experience with large designs (>100M gates) utilizing state of the art sub 16/14/7/5/3nm technologies.
Familiarity with various process related design issues including Design for Yield and Manufacturability, multi-Vt strategies.


Preferred Qualifications
Floor planning and PR tools: Cadence Innovus Synopsys ICC2
Synthesis Tools: Synopsys DC/FC
Formal Verification : Synopsys Formality and Cadence LEC
Static Timing verification: Primetime-DMSA
Power Integrity : Apache Redhawk
Physical Design Verification Synopsys ICV, Mentor Calibre
Scripting: TCL, Perl is required; Python is a plus

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced and leadership-driven Team Leader to manage a high-performing field sales team in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 5+ years of experience in CV financing, with at least 3-4 years in a supervisory or team-handling role. This position is responsible for driving the team to achieve collective sales targets for used CVs and all new CV products introduced by the company.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
Drive Team Targets: Manage, mentor, and motivate a team of field executives to consistently achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual disbursement targets for Used CV and auxiliary products.
Market Expansion: Identify new market clusters, dealer networks, and broker hubs to expand the companys footprint in the assigned territory.
On-the-Field Joint Calls: Accompany field staff on high-ticket client meetings, complex dealer negotiations, and critical field visits to close deals.
Portfolio Risk Management: Monitor the team's portfolio health, ensure high-quality sourcing, and maintain a low Non-Performing Asset (NPA) / Delinquency rate through rigorous field checks.
Process Compliance: Ensure the team strictly adheres to company credit policies, document verification guidelines, and KYC compliance norms from login to disbursement.
Performance Reviews: Conduct daily/weekly review meetings, track individual executive productivity, and provide continuous on-the-job training.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: Minimum 5 to 8 years of experience in Commercial Vehicle Finance, with a strong preference for used CV market experience. At least 1–2 years of experience managing a field sales team is mandatory.
Education: Graduate / Post-Graduate in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field.
Leadership Skills: Proven ability to manage, train, and retain a field-oriented sales force.
Analytical Skills: Strong understanding of local asset valuations, credit risk profiles, and market dynamics.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal vehicle for regular field monitoring and dealer visits.
What We Offer
Competitive fixed CTC with team-performance linked incentives / overrides.
Comprehensive travel allowances.
Opportunities to transition into regional management roles.

market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.

building skills.

extensive field travel.

structure.

• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

bout the Role
Are you a strategic recruiter who thrives in high-volume, dynamic environments? We are looking for a Recruitment Lead to drive end-to-end frontline manpower hiring across west region. Direct Recruitment Planning (20%)

Optimize sourcing channels, combining walk-ins, mass drives, digital recruitment, and specialized outreach programs (e.g., homecoming drives).
Identify resource requirements for hiring events and gain alignment/sign-off with leadership.
Recruitment Process Execution & Monitoring (80%)
Mobilize recruitment teams and lead execution of scheduled hiring drives and events.
Ensure full compliance with internal company policies, statutory regulations, and labor laws governing recruitment.
Issue Letters of Intent (LOI) to selected candidates and actively follow up to ensure seamless transition to training centers with required documentation.
Coordinate directly with training schools on candidate rosters and arrival schedules.
Track hiring event effectiveness, course-correct plans as needed, and maintain accurate recruitment MIS and reporting.
Stakeholders & Relationships
Internal: Hub & Branch Operations Teams, ISM Officers, Recruitment Lead.
External: Prospective candidates, Government/State agencies, Gram Panchayats, local community authorities, and NGOs.
What We Are Looking For
Qualifications & Experience
Education: Graduate degree or equivalent (minimum required).
Experience: 5-7 years of relevant HR experience with a strong background in managing volume recruitment processes.

For Sartorius India Pvt. Ltd, we are looking for a Field Account Manager to join our team in Ahmadabad Pune Mumbai. Job Summary
For Sartorius India Pvt. Ltd, we are looking for a Field Account Manager to join our team in Ahmadabad Pune Mumbai. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the growth of revenue by proactively managing a range of accounts throughout Maharashtra, Gujrat, and Goa by developing and maintaining strong KOL relationships. The goal is to achieve individual and assigned group sales target within the financial year for BioAnalytics product portfolio.
Main Responsibilities Tasks:
Initiate and manage the full sales process within the assigned territory and product range
BioAnalytics group consist of BLI (Octet), SPR (SF3), Live Cell Analysis system (Incucyte), Flow Cytometer (iQue), and Cell Selection and retrieval system (CellCelector).
Maintain the CRM with relevant and up-to-date customer and sales opportunity information in SFDC.
Develop and achieve account targets understanding customer needs and future plans.
Be customer-centric ensuring customer satisfaction without compromising the business.
Expand networks and sellupsell additional products and services.
Provide trainings, technical and commercial support to Sales Reps and customers in relevant products and processes.
Actively contribute to sales growth by identifying new opportunities at customer site.
KOL Management and development.
Identify and implement appropriate action plans to track key accounts consumption patterns.
This is an Individual contributor role.
Qualification Skills:
Master in life sciences (Biotechnology, Microbiology or Biochemistry), With a PhD preferred. Experience in the industry from Bioasay group or Biosimilar groups preferred.
Minimum 5 years of field sales experience in the west region. Candidates with international experience are an addition.
Experience in handling Live Cell imagers, Confocal microscopes, Flow Cytometry, SPR or from the Cell Biology field will be preferred.
Relevant technical knowledge and extensive industry knowledge (eg. Biotech, Pharma, etc.)
Experience in selling capital instrumentation is an addon.
Result-oriented and highly motivated.
Capable of providing outstanding customer service.
Ability to manage complex issues using innovation and processes.
A track record of strong compliance and customer reference is required.
Ability to manage and work in Matrix organization.

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.


Role Summary
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV). Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate. Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

As a Field Service Rep, you are responsible for coordinating with customers in field issues, warranty complaints and resolutions. You will carry out and support site commissioning, service and repair jobs at customer sites. This position will be based at Vadodara QRC.

Perform in-house and on-site repairs and service activities
Assess problems and take actions to resolve promptly.

Able to travel throughout India

- Strong verbal and written communication skills
-Instrumentation & Electrical failure analysis background is a plus

About the Role
Livspace is looking for energetic and customer-focused MBA graduates to join our Alliances & Partnerships team.
As a **Marketing Specialist*, you will be stationed at assigned premium builder projects and will act as the face of Livspace at the property. You will own the complete customer journey—from the first interaction at the builder site to the final home interior booking.

---
Key Responsibilities
 Project Ownership
* Own one or more assigned builder projects end-to-end.
* Build strong working relationships with builder sales, CRM, and project teams.
* Ensure seamless execution of all Livspace partnership activities at the assigned property.
Customer Engagement
* Represent Livspace at the builder sales office.
* Engage with prospective homebuyers visiting the project.
* Explain Livspace's exclusive partnership benefits, offers, and interior solutions.
* Capture customer information and qualify potential interior requirements.
Experience Centre (ECV) Conversion
* Drive customers to visit the Livspace Experience Centre.
* Schedule appointments and coordinate customer visits.
* Follow up consistently to maximize Experience Centre visit conversions.
 Sales Coordination
* Work closely with Livspace Design Consultants and Sales teams after the customer's Experience Centre visit.
* Ensure smooth handover and continuous customer engagement.
* Track customer progress through every stage of the sales funnel until booking.
Customer Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact for customers throughout their interior journey.
* Resolve customer concerns by coordinating with internal stakeholders.
* Deliver an outstanding customer experience to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction.
Stakeholder Management
* Maintain strong relationships with builder stakeholders.
* Coordinate marketing activities and partnership initiatives at the project.
* Share regular project performance updates with internal teams.

Job Description & Candidate Preparation Guide
Career Development Ocer (CDO)
1. About Jaro Education
Jaro Education is India's most trusted online higher education company and a pioneer in the executive
and online education industry. Founded in 2009 by Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe, the company has been self-
funded and protable since inception. Jaro Education has been honored with the EdTech Leadership
Award and recognized as a National Best Employer by the World HRD Congress.
Jaro Education bridges the gap between top-tier global academic institutions and ambitious
professionals. The organization nurtures entrepreneurs and working executives across entry-level to C-
Suite roles through strategic aliations with globally renowned universities and business schools,
including:
IIMs: IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Indore, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Mumbai, IIM Nagpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli,
IIM Visakhapatnam
IITs and IIT-linked institutions: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Jammu, IIT Palakkad, IIT Roorkee,
E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, E&ICT Academy IIT Guwahati, IITM Pravartak IIT Madras
Technology Innovation Hub
Other premier Indian institutions: IISc, XLRI, IMT Ghaziabad, Loyola Institute of Business
Administration (LIBA), IFEEL Institute for Future Education, Entrepreneurship and Leadership,
MIT Institute of Design / MIT IDSS, Niranjan Hiranandani School of Real Estate & HSNC University
Indian Universities and Higher Education Partners: Adani Institute of Digital Technology
Management, Amity University, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Bharati Vidyapeeth / BVDU,
Chandigarh University, Dayananda Sagar University (Bengaluru), Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth
Centre for Online Learning (DPU-COL, Pune), Dr. M.G.R. Educational and Research Institute, JAIN
Online, MAHE Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Manipal University, Manipal University
Jaipur, Parul University, Sikkim Manipal University, Symbiosis International (Deemed University) /
SSODL
Global Academic and Executive Education Partners: Deakin University (Australia) & KPMG
in India, Harvard Business Impact, Imperial College Business School Executive Education, Rotman
School of Management (University of Toronto) & IITM Pravartak, Wharton Interactive
Company Vision: To be globally recognized for providing a seamless learning platform for professionals
around the world.
Page 1 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Company Mission: To make high-quality, outcome-oriented executive education accessible to every
student and professional at all stages of their career.
2. Role Overview & Snapshot
The Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist plays a critical role in driving
business growth by engaging with working executives, assessing their career goals, and counseling them
on higher education options. This is an end-to-end sales and counseling role that combines lead
generation, relationship building, and consultative program matching.
Designation
Career Development Ocer (CDO) / Inside Sales Specialist
Admissions & Executive Education Sales
Department
Target Audience
Working Days
Working Professionals, Corporate Executives & Freshers
Monday to Saturday (Sunday Weekly-O)
10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (Note: Shift may stretch basis business
requirements)
Working Hours
Dress Code
Mon Fri: Business Formals | Saturday: Smart Casuals
Primary CRM Tool
LeadSquared
3. Key Responsibilities & Performance Expectations
High-Volume Lead Outreach & Prospecting
¢ Connect daily with a minimum of 80 working professionals sourced from the LeadSquared CRM
database to build a healthy sales pipeline.
¢ Initiate conversations using cold-calling and warm lead nurture strategies, establishing rapid rapport
with high-potential prospects.
Consultative Counseling & Needs Analysis
¢ Analyze candidate professional backgrounds, current skills, domain expertise, and future career
aspirations.
¢ Identify skill gaps and recommend optimal executive programs, degree courses, diplomas, or
certications from Jaros university partners.
¢ Conduct structured telephonic, virtual, or in-person counseling sessions detailing curriculum
highlights, faculty credentials, learning methodologies, and career outcomes.
Page 2 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
End-to-End Sales Execution & Enrolment
¢ Guide prospects through the complete sales funnelfrom cold calling to lead nurturing, objection
handling, fee negotiation, and nal enrolment closures.
¢ Maintain consistent, personalized follow-up schedules with high-intent leads to maximize conversion
rates.
¢ Meet or exceed assigned daily activity deliverables, weekly conversion targets, and monthly revenue
metrics.
Operations & Data Management
¢ Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead statuses, meeting notes, follow-up dates, and payment
stages in LeadSquared.
¢ Coordinate closely with internal Admissions, Student Support, and Operations teams to ensure a
seamless onboarding experience for enrolled learners.
¢ Stay up-to-date with evolving EdTech trends, institutional accreditation updates, and competitor
oerings.
4. Candidate Prole & Prerequisites
¢ Education & Experience: Bachelors degree in any discipline. Freshers with exceptional
communication skills or candidates with prior sales/EdTech outreach experience are preferred.
¢ Communication Skills: Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, and persuasive articulation
capabilities.
¢ Sales Mindset: High competitive drive, negotiation skills, objection-handling capability, and comfort
working in target-driven environments.
¢ Interpersonal Skills: Empathy, active listening, and the ability to build immediate rapport with mid-to-
senior working professionals.
¢ Technical Savvy: Basic familiarity with Microsoft Oce (Excel, Word) and CRM applications like
LeadSquared.
5. Career Growth Pathway
¢ Structured Career Path: Opportunities to transition from CDO to Senior CDO, Team Leader,
Assistant Manager, and Business Manager based on performance and target achievements.
Page 3 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
Interview Preparation Kit
Please review the following instructions and preparation guidelines before attending your interview with
Jaro Education.
A. General Interview Hygiene & Rules
1. Professional Appearance: Dress in business formals (MonFri style) to demonstrate
professionalism.
2. Technical Setup: Ensure a stable high-speed internet connection, functional camera/microphone,
and a silent, distraction-free environment for virtual meetings.
3. Communication Delivery: Keep answers crisp, structured, and focused. Avoid lengthy anecdotes
or o-topic details.
4. Energy & Condence: Demonstrate high energy, enthusiasm, and articulate speech throughout
the conversation.
5. Past Employer Etiquette: Maintain a strictly positive, objective, and factual approach when
discussing previous employers. Do not speak negatively about former companies or colleagues.
B. Fundamental Concepts to Master
1. What is EdTech?
Denition: EdTech (Educational Technology) refers to the integration of technology, software, and
hardware tools into educational processes to enhance learning accessibility, engagement, and
eectiveness.
Industry Context: Explain why online higher executive education is essential todayallowing
working professionals to upskill without pausing their full-time careers.
2. What is Consultative Selling?
Denition: A sales approach focused on prioritizing the buyer's needs, challenges, and goals rather
than aggressively pushing a product.
Application at Jaro Education: As a CDO, you do not simply "sell a course." You rst identify a
professionals career bottlenecks, understand their skill gaps, and then recommend the specic
executive program that aligns with their career growth.
Page 4 of 5



Jaro Education | CDO Role Guide
C. Sample Interview Questions & Preparation Strategies
Important Note: Interview questions may change from person to person depending on individual
candidate proles and interviewer evaluation. The questions below are representative FAQ example
types to aid your preparation.
¢ "Walk me through your resume and key achievements."
Tip: Focus on your outreach metrics, target achievements, past sales/counseling experience, and
everyday responsibilities.
¢ "Why do you want to build a career in the EdTech industry?"
Tip: Highlight the rapid growth of the online education sector, your passion for career counseling, and
the impact of upskilling working professionals.
¢ "How do you handle a candidate who says the program fee is too high?"
Tip: Demonstrate consultative sellingreframe the fee as a long-term career investment, highlight the
prestige of partner institutes (e.g., IIMs, IITs, Wharton Interactive, Harvard Business Impact), and
discuss nancial exibility (EMIs, loan support).
¢ "What is your reason for leaving your current/previous role?"
Tip: Provide an honest, professional, and growth-oriented answer (e.g., seeking better exposure,
career progression, or entry into the EdTech industry).
¢ "How do you explain gaps in your career (if applicable)?"
Tip: Be transparent, condent, and concise. Explain how you utilized the gap period productively
(certications, skill-building, personal responsibilities).
D. Quick Checklist Before Joining the Interview
Researched Jaro Educations company background, leadership (Dr. Sanjay Salunkhe), vision, and
mission.

Memorized key partner institutions across categories (e.g., IIMs, IITs, IISc, XLRI, Wharton Interactive,
Harvard Business Impact).

Prepared to explain past key performance indicators (KPIs), call targets, and sales achievements.

Reviewed the core denition of Consultative Selling and EdTech.

Dressed in crisp business formal attire.

All the best for your interview!

Execute FI configuration & build (incl. controls) and manage documentation/approvals (Rev-Trac, FRICEW SRs).
Plan and run testing: unit formal; manage defects and sign-offs.

Contribute to market/test support and early go-live activities.
Plan and support cutover (technical & business) and stabilization; deliver KT to BAU, business, and other consultants.

Partner with Product/Program stakeholders to define requirements, scope deliverables, and ensure timely, high-quality outcomes.

Must-have skills
SAP FICO (FI-primary) on S/4HANA: GL/AP/AR/AA, period close, recurring/accrual journals, approvals, and Fiori apps (e.g., My Inbox).
Month-end close expertise and journal posting/controls (policy compliance & audit trail).
Master data: CoA/GL, vendors/customers, assets, cost objects.
Tables & reports: ACDOCA, BKPF/BSEG, BSID/BSAD, BSIK/BSAK, SKA1/SKB1, LFA1/LFB1, KNA1/KNB1, ANLA/ANLC; staples like FAGLL03, FS10N, FBL1N/FBL3N/FBL5N.
Workflow basics and integration awareness.
Basic Enterprise Architecture understanding (how FI interacts with different systems and modules).
Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and change control discipline.

Nice to have
Blackline hands-on (Tasks, Recs, Journals) and/or Tagetik exposure.
Tooling: SAP ALM/SolMan, Jira/Confluence, Rev-Trac, SAP CPI/PO.
Data migration tooling exposure (Migration Cockpit LTMC/LTMOM; ETL/BODS ).

Qualifications & profile
Min 5+ years SAP FICO (S/4 preferred); consulting experience ideal (total 8+ years professional).
Degree required; Masters a plus (business/econ/data analytics, etc.).
Curious, quality-driven, structured/critical thinker; comfortable with ambiguity; excellent Excel/PowerPoint for analysis & storytelling.
Entrepreneurial
mindset with a strong work ethic; enthusiastic about learning new tech aligned to strategy.

Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting monthly disbursement targets.

Key Responsibilities & KRAs
Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by the company.

Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-building skills.
Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for extensive field travel.
What We Offer
Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive structure.
Travel allowances.
Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial institution.

Job TitleSenior Manager - EMEA Transformation & Operational ExcellenceLocationIndia, Ahmedabad Reports ToAssociate Director - Business Partner, EPDM + Africa & AsiaOur Culture
It takes great people to dream big dreams. Extraordinary results define our work. We are looking for ambitious, results-focused and hardworking people who can turn ideas into reality.
At Kraft Heinz, we value ownership, collaboration, agility and the ability to simplify complex challenges. We provide an environment where strong performers can make an impact, grow their careers and contribute to the future of our business.
About the Position
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced transformation and operational excellence professional to execute the GBS Supply Chain transformation roadmap across EMEA and the broader EPDM, Africa and Asia scope. This role supports the integration of Order Management and Supply Chain Management into a single operating model and translates the transformation agenda across people, process and digital into measurable operational and business value.
Based in India, the Senior Manager will lead continuous improvement, digital adoption, governance and service expansion initiatives in close partnership with Business Units, the Global Center of Excellence and Global GBS Capability teams. The role is an individual contributor position with significant cross-functional leadership and influencing responsibility.
Primary Responsibilities
Support the regional Supply Chain transformation agenda across people, process and digital, partnering with Business Units, the Global Center of Excellence and Global GBS Capability teams to prioritize and execute the roadmap.
Lead the Continuous Improvement and Operational Excellence framework across Supply Chain and Order Management processes, identifying opportunities, mobilizing delivery teams and tracking sustainable value realization.
Support the digital transformation agenda, with particular focus on change management, adoption and the effective embedding of new capabilities into operational ways of working.
Execute GBS expansion initiatives into new capabilities and markets, supporting service transition, operating model design and benefits realization.
Define and own GBS, GCC and Business Unit governance routines that strengthen partnership, accountability, transparency and decision-making.
Define and implement the regional Supply Chain management and operating system, including the Log.os competency model and deployment plan.
Coordinate multifunctional initiatives across Order Management, Planning and Logistics, resolving delivery barriers and ensuring transformation priorities remain aligned to business needs.
Support the delivery of annual productivity, business value and expansion targets through process redesign, prioritization and transformation execution.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Engineering or a related discipline.
8+ years of Supply Chain experience, ideally spanning both operational and transformational roles.
Experience working in a GCC, GBS, regional or Center of Excellence environment.
Strong knowledge of Order Management, S&OP/IBP, Logistics and end-to-end Supply Chain principles.
Demonstrated expertise in process improvement, operational excellence and transformation execution.
Strong knowledge of Supply Chain systems, software and analytics tools.
FMCG or CPG industry experience is preferred.
Professional Attributes
Strong problem-solving capability, with the ability to structure complex challenges and translate them into practical solutions.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including engagement with senior leadership.
Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to lead multifunctional teams without direct authority.
Proven change management capability, including addressing resistance and driving adoption of new ways of working.
Effective influencing, negotiation and consensus-building skills across internal and external stakeholders.
A continuous-improvement mindset, strong ownership and the ability to simplify, solve and implement at pace.
Ability to communicate clearly during operational disruption or transformation risk and maintain stakeholder alignment.

Role Overview
You (Payroll, Compliance & Operations) will oversee end-to-end payroll management, statutory compliances, attendance & leave administration, employee life-cycle operations, PMS, and HRMS management (KEKA). The role also requires managing payroll for multiple SPVs, ensuring labour law adherence, handling employee exits including full & final settlements, and managing employee insurance/mediclaim processes.

Key Responsibilities
1. Payroll Management.
Manage end-to-end payroll processing for the parent organization and multiple SPVs.
Ensure accuracy in earnings, deductions, arrears, variable pay, and reimbursements.
Coordinate with Finance for salary disbursement, payroll reconciliation, and statutory payouts.
Maintain payroll records and ensure confidentiality at all times.
Generate and review monthly payroll MIS, dashboards, and compliance reports.
2. Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws.
Ensure PF, ESIC, LWF, PT and other statutory compliance across all units/SPVs.
Manage PF compliance: UAN management, challan generation, returns, audits, and grievance handling.
Stay updated on state and central labour laws relevant to construction/real-estate (CLRA, Shops & Establishment, Minimum Wages, Payment of Wages, Bonus Act, Gratuity Act, Maternity Act, etc.).
Handle labour-related inspections, audits, and notices in coordination with legal teams.
Ensure compliance for on-roll and contract staff deployed at project sites.
3. Attendance & Leave Management.
Manage and monitor attendance, leave policies, and roster compliance across sites and corporate office.
Reconcile biometric attendance data with payroll inputs.
Handle leave encashment, LOP calculation, and continuous tracking of late marks/absenteeism.
Regularly update attendance policies as per management direction and labour law changes.
4. HRMS (KEKA) Administration.
Oversee complete KEKA HRMS administration including onboarding, attendance, leave, PMS, and payroll modules.
Troubleshoot system issues, coordinate with KEKA support, and drive system adoption across teams.
Maintain updated employee master data and system hygiene.
5. Employee Life Cycle Management (Onboarding to Exit).
Handle onboarding documentation, background verification, employee file management, and HR induction.
Manage exit process, including clearance forms, documentation, and full & final settlements (FnF).
Process gratuity, leave encashment, and other statutory components during exits.
Prepare and issue letters: offer, appointment, increment, transfer, relieving, and experience letters.
6. Performance Management System (PMS).
Support the annual and mid-year performance review cycles through KEKA.
Coordinate goal-setting, review meetings, and rating finalization with department heads.
Maintain PMS records, generate reports, and support performance-linked compensation.
7. Insurance/Mediclaim Administration.
Manage employee Mediclaim, group health insurance & accidental insurance for employees and dependents.
Coordinate with TPA/insurance providers for claims processing, additions/deletions, and renewals.
Conduct periodic insurance awareness sessions for employees.
8. HR Operations & Employee Support.
Manage employee queries related to payroll, leave, compliance, benefits, and HR policies.
Maintain employee files, HR documentation, trackers, and statutory registers.
Support manpower planning, site HR coordination, and HR audits.
Assist in HR policy formulation, process improvements, and HR reporting.
Key Skills & Competencies.
Strong knowledge of Payroll, PF/ESIC, labour laws, and statutory requirements.
Experience working with KEKA HRMS or similar HRMS tools.
Understanding of real estate or construction sector HR operations (preferred).
High accuracy in data handling and MIS reporting.
Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to multitask and manage HR operations across SPVs and multiple sites.
Qualification & Experience
Bachelors/Masters degree in HR, Commerce, or related field (MBA/PGDM preferred).
Min 8-10 years of experience in HR operations, payroll & compliance, preferably in real estate, infrastructure, or construction.
Hands-on experience with PF portals, payroll software, and HRMS tools.

Description:
Job Title: Relationship Manager - CAT - Loyalty
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance

As a Relationship Manager in the Loyalty department, your primary responsibility will be to maintain and enhance relationships with existing customers while also identifying opportunities for cross-selling and upselling various insurance products. You will work closely with clients to understand their financial goals and needs, providing them with tailored solutions that align with their objectives. Your role will involve regular communication with customers, conducting follow-ups, resolving issues, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. You will also collaborate with internal teams to improve service offerings and enhance the overall customer experience.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain strong client relationships to foster loyalty and retention.
- Conduct regular reviews with clients to assess their insurance needs and provide appropriate recommendations.
- Cross-sell and upsell insurance products to existing clients based on their evolving needs.
- Act as the primary point of contact for clients and manage client inquiries, complaints, and requests effectively.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of client issues and enhance service delivery.
- Track and report on client interactions and outcomes to management.
- Stay updated on industry trends, market conditions, and new products to provide informed advice to clients.

Skills Required:
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build and maintain client relationships.
- Customer-focused attitude with a commitment to providing exceptional service.
- Analytical skills to assess client needs and provide tailored financial solutions.
- Problem-solving abilities to address client issues and complaints effectively.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a team and across departments.

Tools Required:
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software for tracking client interactions and managing relationships.
- Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for reporting and presentations.
- Insurance industry software for managing client portfolios and transactions.
- Communication tools such as email, phone, and instant messaging platforms for client interactions.

This position offers an excellent opportunity to grow within a dynamic company that values employee development and a culture of excellence. Candidates should be driven, proactive, and passionate about helping clients achieve their financial goals.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a strategic and seasoned leader for the role of State Head Used Commercial Vehicle Finance. The State Head will hold complete Profit & Loss (P&L) responsibility for the state, managing multiple Team Leaders (TLs) and their respective field teams. The ideal candidate will have minimum 10+ years of experience in retail asset financing, with a deep focus on Commercial Vehicles, and a proven track record of scaling state-level operations while maintaining robust portfolio quality.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
State P&L Ownership: Drive the top-line and bottom-line business targets for the entire state, ensuring consistent growth across Used CVs and all newly introduced CV products.
Leadership & Team Management: Supervise, mentor, and evaluate Team Leaders. Build a high-performance culture and manage manpower planning, retention, and succession across branches.
Strategic Distribution & Expansion: Identify and set up operations in untapped geographies, cities, and rural clusters within the state to expand market share.
Strategic Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Credit, Risk, and Operations heads to optimize loan turnaround times (TAT) and refine underwriting policies based on state-specific market realities.
Portfolio Quality & Risk Mitigation: Maintain overall state portfolio health. Implement proactive strategies alongside the collections team to control early delinquencies (0-90 DPD) and minimize Net NPAs.
Key Relationship Management: Personally manage strategic relationships with top-tier multi-city vehicle dealers, large fleet operators, brokers, and channel partners across the state.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Experience: Minimum 10 to 15 years of experience in Commercial Vehicle Finance (with significant exposure to the Used CV market). At least 5 years in a regional or state-level leadership role managing supervisors/TLs.
Education: Graduate, Post-Graduate / MBA in Finance/Marketing or Business Management is highly preferred.
Core Competencies: Strong strategic planning, financial acumen, data-driven decision-making, and macro-level risk assessment skills.
Market Network: Deep geographic knowledge of the state's transport hubs, transit corridors, and major used vehicle markets.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Description:
Junior Revenue Cycle Representative (AR / EVBV / Authorization)

Kick-start your career in the US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) industry! We are looking for motivated graduates with strong English communication and analytical skills to join our healthcare operations team.

Eligibility Criteria
Graduates from Commerce and eligible Science streams only.
Postgraduates, diploma holders, and Life Science graduates are not eligible.
Good English communication and analytical skills are essential.
Willingness to work in a night-shift environment.

Job Responsibilities
Follow up with US insurance companies regarding unpaid medical claims and help resolve claim denials.
Review and analyze outstanding insurance claims to identify issues and support timely reimbursement to healthcare providers.
Investigate claim discrepancies, identify recurring errors, and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate with insurance representatives on behalf of healthcare clients to resolve claims within defined timelines and service-level agreements (SLAs).
Maintain accurate claim records and follow established quality and productivity standards.

Work Details
Shift: Night shift
Working Days: 5 days a week
Weekly Off: Saturday and Sunday fixed off
Work Mode: Work from Office
Transport Facility: Pick-up and drop provided

Job Details:
The Design Technology Platform team at Intel Foundry India is chartered with process technology definition, advanced methodology development, and design prototyping on Intels latest process nodes. We support Intels internal and external design customers and offer a unique opportunity to be among the first engineers working on cutting-edge process technologies. We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead - APR Design Automation to develop and optimize RTL-to-GDS (R2G) flows primarily using Cadence Innovus Implementation System, while supporting test chip and foundry IP needs. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Cadence Innovus-based PnR flow development, with working knowledge of Synopsys Fusion Compiler being a strong added advantage. A key aspect of this role will be enabling, deploying, and supporting Cadence Innovus-based APR flows for Intels internal product design teams as well as external foundry customers who are leveraging Intels process technology - ensuring robust, scalable, and production-ready flow solutions that meet the design and performance requirements across a diverse customer base. This is an individual contributor (IC) technical leadership role focused on physical design automation tools, flows, and methodologies on leading-edge process nodes. - Lead the development, deployment, and continuous improvement of RTL-to-GDS flows using Cadence Innovus as the primary PnR platform - Define and drive physical design tools, flows, and methodologies including: o Block-level implementation and integration o Floorplanning, placement, CTS, and routing automation o Timing closure methodologies - Develop and maintain Tcl-based scripting and automation to enhance layout productivity within Innovus and related Cadence tools - Evaluate and benchmark Cadence Innovus vs. Synopsys Fusion Compiler flows; provide data-driven recommendations on tool and methodology selection - Enable and support industry-standard static timing analysis (STA) tools for test chips and Foundry IPs (FIPs), and ensure continued support and enhancement - Collaborate with central CAD, design teams, local CAD teams, and EDA vendors (Cadence, Synopsys) to define next-generation PnR methodologies - Work closely with internal and external design customers to understand requirements and deliver robust, scalable automation solutions - Respond to customer/client requests proactively, developing solutions leveraging formal expertise and engineering judgment - Contribute to process node bring-up by validating and refining flows on Intels latest technology nodes
Qualifications: Educational Requirements Masters degree in M.Tech or MS in Microelectronics, Electronics Engineering, or an equivalent qualification from a reputed institute, with relevant industry experience in physical design and APR flow development Technical Qualifications Physical Design and APR Expertise Proven hands-on experience in block-level design closure using Cadence Innovus Implementation System as the primary APR tool for end-to-end RTL-to-GDS flows Strong working knowledge of all key physical design stages including Floorplanning covering die size estimation, macro placement and pin assignment, Power Planning covering power grid design, IR drop awareness, ring and stripe strategies, Placement covering timing-driven and congestion-aware placement optimization, Clock Tree Synthesis covering clock tree design, skew and latency optimization, and Routing covering global and detailed routing and DRC-clean routing closure Well-versed with multiple optimization techniques available in Cadence Innovus for achieving design closure, including timing, area, power, and congestion optimizations Ability to guide and mentor the team in resolving complex implementation challenges and providing structured solutions Timing and Constraints Strong understanding of digital timing concepts including setup, hold, clock domain crossing CDC, and multi-mode multi-corner MMMC analysis Ability to analyze and validate design constraints SDC and understand their impact on timing closure Experience with industry-standard STA tools such as Cadence Tempus or equivalent for timing sign-off Layout Closure and Sign-off Demonstrated experience in achieving full layout closure for blocks, ensuring compliance with DRC Design Rule Check, LVS Layout vs. Schematic, Density requirements and Antenna violation fixes Familiarity with physical verification tools and sign-off flows as per process technology specifications Top-Level Integration Good understanding of top-level integration challenges and ability to ensure block-level deliverables meet project-level requirements for both timing and layout closures Experience in managing block-to-top handoffs and resolving integration-level issues effectively Domain Knowledge Strong foundation in VLSI design, digital electronics, and semiconductor device fundamentals Good understanding of digital design timing closure principles and methodologies Knowledge of semiconductor fabrication and process technology will be a distinct added advantage Familiarity with Intel process technology or advanced node design environments is a plus Soft Skills and Behavioral Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to debugging complex physical design issues Proactive and transparent communication style with the ability to articulate technical challenges and solutions clearly to stakeholders Collaborative mindset with demonstrated ability to work effectively in a diverse, cross-functional, and geographically distributed team environment Ability to work across multiple domains including design, CAD, and EDA vendor teams Leadership and Experience Leadership experience in driving block-level closure and physical design sign-off for tape-out is strongly preferred Demonstrated track record of silicon success having contributed to or led designs that have been successfully taped out and validated in silicon is highly desirable

Prospect Identification: Identify and engage potential business opportunities.

drive conversions.

Revenue Generation: Focus on closing sales and meeting revenue goals.

Health insurance: Rs 1 lakh per year, fully paid by the company.
Free lunch and snacks: Provided to all employees.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding
performers eligible for promotions every quarter.

years.

all employees.

numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making skills.

comfortable working 6 days a week, with a weekday off.

At Nobroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a
dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape.

Description:
Project Analyst

Job Summary

If you are a Finance professional, Emerson has an exciting role for you! We are looking for a Project Analyst to work with our Financial Services Group in Pune.
We value autonomy, self-reliance, fast movers, a passion for robust and ability to maintained quality of financial reporting.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

Managing the monthly reporting process, ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial information to internal and external stakeholders.
Responsible for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closes, meeting reporting deadlines.
Preparing the Daily/ monthly flash for Orders and Sales at SYSS/ Site level
Determining Correct revenue recognition method for Projects
Revenue & COS Recognition in Oracle system for Projects
Control Account (WIP/UBR/UER) Reconciliations between PA (sub ledger) vs General Ledger
Conducting month-end checks (EAC movements, Loss Accruals, Cost Corrections)
Working of pre close accruals, re-class of timesheets and time sheet analysis
Projects maintenance responsibilities in Oracle, including:
Perform timely closure of projects, including cost and revenue reconciliations and clearance of differences based on internal approvals prior to project closure
Clearance of cost interface errors, PA module closure
Ensure foreign currency exposures are reviewed and validated on monthly basis.
Generate project financial reports, including:
Inception To Date (ITD) Invoice reports by project
Run Project Status Inquiry (Noetix & Oracle) and compile reports for period close
Other invoice and expenditure inquiry reports as specified
Regularly review accuracy and completeness of project costs and revenues
Backlog reconciliation & correct reporting of FX Backlog
WIP and UBR Aging analysis
Perform monthly variance analysis (GP Tracking including Non-Project Orders)
Participate in monthly forecasting (POR) process ensuring correct Backlog phasing
Support segment reporting- Product Group & KOB
Responsible for post month-end reports for Site & BU management
Liaise with Business Unit Financial Analysts during month end close and provide them with financial details/explanations regarding variances
Support on Annual Budgets, mid-year reviews, Ops Reviews
Support on WIP Count & Inventory Analysis
Support on Annual Audit
Participation in Project Review (Monthly and Quarterly)

Who You Are:

You promote high visibility of shared contributions to goals. You quickly and significantly act in constantly evolving, unexpected situations. You actively seek input from pertinent sources to make timely and well-informed decisions. You handle the risk that comes with moving forward when the outcome is not certain.

For This Role, You Will Need:
Finance Professional up to 3 years of work experience in FP&A Domain
Hands on experience in ERP, MS Office, and reporting tools
Self-starter
Balance stakeholder, Situational adaptability, manages complexities & ambiguity.

We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. Role & responsibilities
